https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/ndc-.body: The National Leadership of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, has inaugurated its newly acquired national secretariat in Abuja as part of efforts to strengthen its operations ahead of the 2027 general election. In his remarks, the National Leader of the party, Senator Seriake Dickson, described the facility as its new “Noah’s Ark” ahead of the 2027 general elections as he congratulated members and supporters on the acquisition, describing the new secretariat as a unifying centre that would provide a befitting home for the party’s growing membership. He referred to the facility as the NDC’s newly acquired “Noah’s Ark,” a description underscoring its importance as a rallying point for members and supporters as the party pursues its political ambitions. The inauguration attracted the party’s National Chairman, Senator Moses Cleopas; National Leader, Senator Seriake Dickson; and Senator Victor Umeh, representing Anambra Central in the National Assembly. Also present was the party’s Rivers State governorship candidate, Dumo Lulu-Briggs, alongside other party leaders and members. With this, the NDC has positioned itself as an alternative political platform for Nigerians seeking a change from the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). With the new facility, the party is expected to strengthen coordination between its national leadership, state chapters and other structures as election preparations continue. https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.title: Sammy Gyamfi’s mining formalisation remarks do not warrant resignation – Centre for Mining Research and Policy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.summary: The Centre for Mining Research and Policy has rejected the Minority’s call for the resignation of Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) Chief Executive Officer Sammy Gyamfi over his comments on the formalisation of small-scale mining. The Centre said the call was not justified, arguing that Mr Gyamfi’s position focused on bringing eligible small-scale miners into the formal regulatory system rather than allowing illegal mining to continue.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.summary_zh: 矿业研究与政策中心驳回了少数族群要求加纳黄金局（GoldBod）首席执行官 Sammy Gyamfi 辞职的呼吁，原因是其就小规模采矿正规化发表的言论。该中心表示，这一要求没有依据，并认为 Gyamfi 先生的立场旨在推动符合资格的小规模采矿者纳入正式监管体系，而非纵容非法采矿继续存在。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.body: The Centre for Mining Research and Policy has rejected the Minority’s call for the resignation of Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) Chief Executive Officer Sammy Gyamfi over his comments on the formalisation of small-scale mining. The Centre said the call was not justified, arguing that Mr Gyamfi’s position focused on bringing eligible small-scale miners into the formal regulatory system rather than allowing illegal mining to continue. Senior Research Fellow at the Centre, Dr Ofori Kodua, said Mr Gyamfi had made it clear that eligible operators must obtain the necessary documentation, permits, certification and training to operate legally. He added that the GoldBod CEO had condemned mining activities that destroy water bodies, encroach on forest reserves or endanger communities. The Ghana National Association of Small Scale Miners, which co-organised the engagement at which the disputed remarks were made, has also defended their context. According to the association, the excerpt circulated from the event gave a misleading impression of a discussion about registering and regularising eligible operators. The Centre said the Minority’s demand for Mr Gyamfi’s resignation did not adequately consider that explanation. It also cited GoldBod’s reported performance in the small-scale gold trading sector as a reason to continue supporting the board’s reforms. According to the figures provided by GoldBod, the institution aggregated and exported 85.4 tonnes of small-scale gold valued at US$11.6 billion between January and October 20, 2026. The Centre said the figures demonstrated the economic importance of the sector and the need to strengthen official channels for gold trading. It further pointed to GoldBod’s reported support for anti-illegal-mining operations and funding for the reclamation of 50 hectares in the Tano Nimiri Forest Reserve. The board is also procuring a traceability system intended to establish the lawful origin of gold moving through the supply chain. The Centre acknowledged that the initiatives would require effective implementation and scrutiny but argued that they provided grounds for continued engagement with GoldBod’s reform agenda. It maintained that small-scale mining formalisation must be tied to compliance with licensing requirements, safer practices and regulatory supervision, while destructive mining should be subject to enforcement action. The Centre therefore called on the Minority to focus on scrutinising the implementation and results of the reforms rather than demanding Mr Gyamfi’s removal. It also cited GoldBod’s engagement with the World Gold Council on formalisation, traceability and responsible processing as evidence of efforts to align Ghana’s domestic priorities with international expertise. The Centre said Mr Gyamfi should be allowed to continue leading the reforms, while his performance and the outcomes of the initiatives remain subject to public and parliamentary scrutiny
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.title_zh: 采矿研究与政策中心：Sammy Gyamfi关于采矿正规化的言论不足以构成辞职理由
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sammy-gyamfi.body_zh: 矿业研究与政策中心驳回了少数派要求加纳黄金局（GoldBod）首席执行官 Sammy Gyamfi 辞职的呼吁，原因是他就小规模采矿正规化发表的言论。该中心表示，这项要求没有依据，并称 Gyamfi 先生的立场重点是推动符合条件的小规模采矿者纳入正式监管体系，而非纵容非法采矿继续进行。该中心高级研究员 Ofori Kodua 博士表示，Gyamfi 先生已明确指出，符合条件的经营者必须取得合法运营所需的文件、许可证、认证并接受培训。他还表示，加纳黄金局首席执行官谴责了破坏水体、侵占森林保护区或危及社区的采矿活动。共同组织争议言论发生交流活动的加纳全国小规模矿工协会，也为其发表言论的背景进行了辩护。据该协会称，活动结束后流传的节选内容使人误以为，讨论的是为符合条件的经营者办理登记和正规化手续。该中心表示，少数派要求 Gyamfi 先生辞职时，未充分考虑这一解释。该中心还援引加纳黄金局公布的小规模黄金交易行业业绩，作为继续支持该局改革的理由。根据加纳黄金局提供的数据，2026年1月至10月20日，该机构共汇集并出口了85.4吨小规模黄金，价值116亿美元。该中心表示，这些数据证明该行业具有重要的经济意义，也说明有必要加强黄金交易的官方渠道。该中心还指出，加纳黄金局据报支持打击非法采矿的行动，并为塔诺尼米里森林保护区50公顷土地的修复提供资金。该局还在采购一套可追溯系统，用于确定进入供应链的黄金的合法来源。该中心承认，这些举措需要有效实施和监督，但认为它们为继续参与加纳黄金局的改革议程提供了依据。该中心坚持认为，小规模采矿正规化必须与遵守许可要求、采用更安全作业方式和接受监管监督相结合，同时应对破坏性采矿采取执法行动。因此，该中心呼吁少数派把重点放在审查改革措施的实施情况和成效上，而不是要求 Gyamfi 先生下台。该中心还援引加纳黄金局与世界黄金协会就正规化、可追溯性和负责任加工开展合作的事例，证明其正努力推动加纳国内优先事项与国际专业经验相衔接。该中心表示，应允许 Gyamfi 先生继续领导改革，同时其履职表现和各项举措的成果仍应接受公众和议会的监督

https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.title: Gender Data Ghana calls for GES policy on child abuse investigations to be scrapped
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.summary: Gender Data Ghana (GDG), a think tank focused on gender equality through research and advocacy, has called for the abolition of the Ghana Education Service (GES) policy that allows it to investigate allegations of abuse internally and transfer accused staff to other communities.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.summary_zh: 性别数据加纳（GDG）是一家致力于通过研究和倡导实现性别平等的智库，呼吁废除加纳教育局（GES）允许其内部调查虐待指控并将被控职员调往其他社区的政策。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.body: Gender Data Ghana (GDG), a think tank focused on gender equality through research and advocacy, has called for the abolition of the Ghana Education Service (GES) policy that allows it to investigate allegations of abuse internally and transfer accused staff to other communities. According to the organisation, the policy must be brought in line with existing child protection laws. The organisation says the handling of allegations involving the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) and female students highlights the need for a coordinated government response and stronger safeguards to protect children in schools. “Laws supersede policies. Therefore, the current policy of the Ghana Education Service which permits self-investigation of alleged cases of abuse and grants itself powers of transfer of alleged perpetuators to other communities must be interrogated in the light of the Children’s Act, which derives its source from Article 28 of the 1992 Constitution. "Since a policy cannot override a law and the Constitution, the policy of the Ghana Education Service is redundant if not unconstitutional and must be abrogated,” Gender Data Ghana said in a statement dated October 26, 2026. The organisation argued that the GES policy must be assessed against the Children’s Act, 1998 (Act 560), as amended, and Article 28 of the 1992 Constitution, which provides for the protection of children. It maintained that the best interests of the child must guide the handling of the case, alongside respect for due process for the accused. Gender Data Ghana has proposed deploying professional social welfare officers in every public educational institution to strengthen the prevention and reporting of child abuse. It said the officers should operate independently of the GES to enable them to respond promptly and professionally to suspected cases. The organisation also urged the Ministry of Finance to adequately resource the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection and the Domestic Violence and Victim Support Unit (DOVVSU) of the Ghana Police Service to enable them to perform their statutory responsibilities effectively. The organisation expressed concern that the Obuasi SHTS case had largely been treated as a “women’s issue” rather than a national child protection concern. It called on President John Dramani Mahama to publicly demonstrate the government’s commitment to ending child sexual exploitation and abuse. It also urged Parliament to exercise its oversight responsibilities more visibly, arguing that a unified, non-partisan response would strengthen calls for accountability and justice. While commending statements issued by the Minority Women’s Caucus, the Public Accounts Committee and the Human Rights Committee, Gender Data Ghana questioned the absence of a unified statement from the Parliamentary Women’s Caucus. Beyond the Obuasi SHTS case, the organisation proposed transforming the 2015 Child and Family Welfare Policy into a comprehensive Child Protection Policy. It said the proposed framework should improve coordination among ministries, departments and agencies and clearly define their respective responsibilities. Gender Data Ghana stressed that Ghana’s status as the first country to ratify the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child carries obligations that require stronger institutional safeguards and effective enforcement of existing laws
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.title_zh: 加纳性别数据组织呼吁废除GES关于调查儿童虐待的政策
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gender-data-.body_zh: 加纳性别数据组织（Gender Data Ghana，GDG）是一家致力于通过研究和倡导推动性别平等的智库。该组织呼吁废除加纳教育服务局（GES）允许其内部调查虐待指控，并将被指控员工调往其他社区的政策。该组织表示，这项政策必须与现行儿童保护法律相衔接。该组织说，对奥布阿西高级中学技术学校（SHTS）校长及女生相关指控的处理，凸显了政府需要采取协调一致的行动，并采取更有力的保障措施保护在校儿童。加纳性别数据组织在一份日期为2026年10月26日的声明中表示：“法律高于政策。因此，必须依据《儿童法》重新审视加纳教育服务局现行政策；该政策允许自行调查涉嫌虐待案件，并授权将涉嫌侵权者调往其他社区。《儿童法》的法律依据源自1992年《宪法》第28条。‘既然政策不能凌驾于法律和《宪法》之上，加纳教育服务局的政策即使尚未构成违宪，也已属多余，必须予以废除。’”该组织主张，必须根据经修订的《儿童法》（1998年，第560号法）和1992年《宪法》第28条评估GES政策；这些法律规定了儿童保护。它坚持，处理此案时必须以儿童最佳利益为指导，同时尊重对被指控者的正当程序权利。加纳性别数据组织建议在每所公立教育机构部署专业社会福利官，以加强儿童虐待的预防和举报。该组织表示，这些官员应在不受GES管辖的情况下独立工作，以便迅速、专业地应对疑似案件。该组织还敦促财政部为性别、儿童与社会保护部以及加纳警察局家庭暴力与受害者支援处（DOVVSU）提供充足资源，使它们能够有效履行法定职责。该组织对奥布阿西SHTS案件大多被当作“妇女问题”，而非全国性儿童保护关切表示担忧。它呼吁约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马总统公开展现政府终结儿童性剥削和虐待的决心。它还敦促议会更加明显地履行监督责任，并认为统一、无党派的应对措施将有助于强化问责和正义诉求。加纳性别数据组织赞扬了少数党妇女 caucus、公共账目委员会和人权委员会发表的声明，但质疑议会妇女 caucus为何没有发表统一声明。奥布阿西SHTS案件之外，该组织建议将2015年《儿童与家庭福利政策》转变为一项全面的儿童保护政策。该组织表示，拟议框架应改善各部委、部门与机构之间的协调，并明确界定各方职责。加纳性别数据组织强调，加纳作为首个批准《联合国儿童权利公约》的国家，负有相应义务，需要强化制度保障并有效执行现行法律

https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.title: UPSA urges graduates to embrace entrepreneurship amid graduate unemployment
https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.summary: The University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA), is urging graduates to embrace entrepreneurship and job creation as Ghana’s young people continue to face competition for limited employment opportunities. The university says it is shifting from teaching students the principles of entrepreneurship to helping them turn business ideas into viable enterprises.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.summary_zh: 阿克拉专业研究大学（UPSA）敦促毕业生 embracing 创业和创造就业机会，因为加纳年轻人仍在有限的就业机会竞争中。该大学表示，正从教授学生创业原则转向帮助他们将商业创意转化为可行企业。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.body: The University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA), is urging graduates to embrace entrepreneurship and job creation as Ghana’s young people continue to face competition for limited employment opportunities. The university says it is shifting from teaching students the principles of entrepreneurship to helping them turn business ideas into viable enterprises. Speaking at the second session of UPSA’s 18th Congregation, Vice-Chancellor Professor Kwaku Mensah Mawutor said the institution wanted graduates to identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions and establish businesses capable of creating jobs. “Our responsibility is not only to teach students how to write business plans but to shape them to identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions, establish viable businesses and create jobs,” he said. The approach, he explained, is intended to prepare students not only to seek employment but also to create opportunities for themselves and others. Director-General of the Cyber Security Authority, Professor Divine Selase Agbeti, also challenged the graduates to reconsider relying solely on paid employment. He encouraged them to collaborate, develop innovative ideas and explore business opportunities that could translate into sustainable enterprises. He cited software development as one area where graduates could pool their skills to create products and seek customers. “Three, four, five, six of you can come together and decide to be software developers, develop your software, approach people and I can guarantee you that you will sell your software,” he said. His remarks highlighted collaboration and innovation as possible routes for graduates seeking to establish themselves in the economy. For Nancy Edem Atsu, who emerged as the overall best graduating student at the second session of UPSA’s 18th Congregation, the achievement represents years of hard work and perseverance. She recounted the difficulties she faced with some courses, saying determination and consistent effort helped her overcome the challenges. Despite her academic success, Nancy is still weighing her options as she prepares for life after university. She is interested in pursuing opportunities in public relations while also considering her passion for baking as a possible business venture. “I also love to bake when it comes to entrepreneurship, but I am also looking to secure a job in PR firms,” she said. Her plans reflect the different paths graduates may consider as they navigate the transition from university to the world of work. Nancy’s achievement was also a source of pride for her mother, Madam Bertha, who said her daughter’s academic journey involved significant challenges and sacrifices. She expressed gratitude at seeing her daughter graduate with distinction after years of supporting her education. “We want to thank God for what I have seen today, that my daughter too has this appointment,” she said. For the graduates, the congregation marks the completion of years of academic work. https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.title_zh: UPSA敦促毕业生在失业压力下积极投身创业
https://www.myjoyonline.com/upsa-urges-g.body_zh: 阿克拉职业研究大学（UPSA）敦促毕业生 embracing 创业和创造就业岗位，因为加纳年轻人仍在争夺有限的就业机会。该大学表示，正从讲授创业原理转向帮助学生将商业创意转化为可行的企业。UPSA第18届毕业典礼第二场活动上，校长夸库·门萨·马武托教授表示，该机构希望毕业生发现机遇、开发创新解决方案，并建立能够创造就业岗位的企业。他说：“我们的责任不仅是教导学生如何撰写商业计划书，还要引导他们发现机遇、开发创新解决方案、建立可行的企业并创造就业岗位。”他解释说，这一做法旨在让学生不仅能够寻找就业机会，也能为自己和他人创造机会。网络_security局总干事迪瓦因·塞拉塞·阿格贝蒂教授也向毕业生发出挑战，要求他们重新考虑仅依赖有薪就业的做法。他鼓励毕业生开展协作、开发创新想法，并探索能够转化为可持续企业的商业机会。他以软件开发为例，指出这是毕业生可以汇聚技能、开发产品并寻找客户的领域之一。他说：“你们三四五六个人可以聚在一起，决定成为软件开发人员，开发自己的软件，找人推销，我可以保证你们能把软件卖出去。”他的讲话强调，协作与创新是毕业生在经济中立足的一条可行道路。对于在UPSA第18届毕业典礼第二场活动中当选全校最佳毕业生的南希·埃德姆·阿楚而言，这一成就体现了她多年的辛勤努力和坚韧。她讲述了自己在学习部分课程时遇到的困难，并表示决心和持续努力帮助她克服了这些挑战。尽管取得了学业成功，南希在为毕业后的生活做准备时，仍在权衡自己的选择。她有意寻求公共关系领域的机会，同时也在考虑将自己对烘焙的热爱作为一项可能的商业事业。她说：“说到创业，我也喜欢烘焙，但我也在考虑进入公关公司工作。”她的计划反映了毕业生在从大学走向职场过程中可能考虑的不同道路。南希的成就也让她的母亲伯莎夫人感到自豪。伯莎夫人说，女儿的求学生涯经历了巨大挑战和牺牲；在多年支持女儿求学之后，看到她以优异成绩毕业，她深表感激。她说：“我们要感谢上帝，让我今天看到了这一幕，我的女儿也获得了这份任命。”对毕业生而言，毕业典礼标志着多年学业修读的完成。下一项挑战是找到工作、建立可行的企业，或在迈向职业抱负的过程中将两条道路结合起来……

https://www.myjoyonline.com/university-o.body: The University of Gold Coast has launched the Gold Coast Society of Doctoral Fellows as part of efforts to strengthen research and prepare scholars to contribute to Ghana’s development. The initiative comes as the university matriculates 105 students into its inaugural PhD in Business Administration programme, with Chancellor Bishop Dr Gideon Tito-Offei urging Ghana to place greater emphasis on higher education, research and the development of national expertise. He made the call during the university’s matriculation ceremony on October 24, challenging the students to apply their education to address the country’s development needs. “We place a responsibility to every scholar in this room; let your education become useful to your nation,” he said. In an address titled From Natural Resources to National Resourcefulness , Bishop Tito-Offei urged the country to look beyond its mineral wealth and invest in the knowledge, character and competence needed to build productive businesses and drive national development. His remarks emphasised the importance of developing human capital and strengthening research as part of efforts to translate Ghana’s potential into sustainable economic progress. The university matriculated 105 students into its inaugural PhD in Business Administration programme on October 24. The three-year programme offers five specialisations: accounting and finance; human resource management; marketing and communications; leadership and governance; and strategic management. Director of the PhD programme, Dr Winnifred Coleman, said it was designed to provide students with rigorous academic training and equip them with the skills needed to contribute to national development. Some students also expressed optimism that the programme would strengthen their research, leadership and professional skills. The university expects the programme to build students’ research capacity and prepare them to apply their expertise to Ghana’s development challenges
https://www.myjoyonline.com/university-o.title_zh: 加纳大学成立黄金海岸博士学者会
https://www.myjoyonline.com/university-o.body_zh: 黄金海岸大学成立了黄金海岸博士研究员学会，旨在加强研究工作，并培养学者为加纳发展作出贡献。就在该校迎来首批105名学生注册攻读工商管理博士课程之际，该学会宣告成立。校监主教 Gideon Tito-Offei 博士呼吁加纳更加重视高等教育、研究以及本国专业人才的发展。他是在学校10月24日举行的注册典礼上提出这一呼吁的，并勉励学生运用所学知识应对国家发展的需求。他说：“我们要求在座的每一位学者都承担起责任；让你们的教育成为对国家有益的力量。”Tito-Offei 主教在题为《从自然资源到国家人才资源》的致辞中，呼吁加纳不要只关注矿产资源财富，还应投资于知识、品格和建设富有成效的企业及推动国家发展所需的能力。他的讲话强调，应把发展人力资本和加强研究作为把加纳潜力转化为可持续经济进展的重要组成部分。10月24日，该大学迎来了首批105名学生注册工商管理博士课程。这个为期三年的课程设有五个专业方向：会计与金融、人力资源管理、营销与传播、领导与治理，以及战略管理。博士项目主任 Winnifred Coleman 博士表示，该课程旨在为学生提供严谨的学术训练，并使他们掌握为促进国家发展所需的技能。一些学生也乐观表示，该课程将加强他们的研究能力、领导能力和专业技能。该大学希望这一课程能够提升学生的研究能力，并使他们准备好运用专业知识应对加纳面临的发展挑战

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nige.summary: Niger State Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago has declared that his party, the All Progressives Congress (APC), is targeting 2 million votes to defeat the opposition parties in the 2027 presidential and governorship elections.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nige.summary_zh: 尼日尔州州长穆罕马德·乌马鲁·巴戈宣布，他所在的进步大会党（APC）计划在2027年总统和州长选举中争取200万张选票，以击败反对党。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nige.body: Niger State Governor Mohammed Umaru Bago has declared that his party, the All Progressives Congress (APC), is targeting 2 million votes to defeat the opposition parties in the 2027 presidential and governorship elections. The governor made this known on Monday at the inauguration of a 525-member State Presidential/Gubernatorial Campaign Council of the APC in Minna, where he revealed that the council is drawn from commissioners, special advisers, local government chairmen, councillors, state and national lawmakers, ministers, directors-general and coordinators. Bago described the structure as spanning party units to the state level and including political appointees, with total membership exceeding 100,000 over the years. “If everybody would bring its own votes, it would give us more than 1 million votes. But our target is beyond that. The ambition this time around is to bring out over 2 million votes, and by the grace of God we will do that,” he said. The governor urged the party to welcome returnees who had earlier defected to other parties, crediting the APC’s emergence as a coalition of parties that defeated the main opposition. He called for constructive media coverage and warned against overheating the polity or triggering insecurity, saying the campaign would highlight the federal government’s economic policies, improved revenue and job creation. Minister of Information, Idris Malagi, in his remarks, praised the choice of leadership of the council and said the APC would campaign on the administration’s record of transforming the Nigerian economy over the past three and a half years. He urged the newly appointed members to prioritise the collective good of the state and party unity The chairman of the APC North Central, Hon. Mu’azu Rijau, while congratulating the council leadership, stressed that the 2027 campaign council should not underestimate opponents, saying the party aimed to re-elect Governor Bago alongside its senators, House of Representatives members and state assembly members. Director-General of the campaign council, Ahmed Ibeto, accepted the assignment on behalf of members, pledging hard work, strategic coordination, grassroots engagement, unity, discipline and compliance with electoral guidelines. He said the council would establish operational frameworks across directorates, local governments, wards and units, and would value experience while welcoming new ideas. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚APC成立525人竞选委员会，力争为Tinubu和Bago争取200万张选票
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔州州长穆罕马德·乌马鲁·巴戈宣布，他所在的进步大会党（APC）计划在2027年总统和州长选举中争取200万张选票，以击败反对党。州长于周一在米纳举行的APC第525届州级总统和州长竞选委员会就职仪式上宣布了这一消息。他透露，委员会成员包括各委员会委员、特别顾问、地方政府主席、议员、州级和国家级立法者、部长、总司长以及协调员。巴戈称，该组织架构从党内基层单位延伸至州一级，并吸纳政治任命人员，多年来成员总数超过10万。他说：“如果每个人都投出自己的一票，就能为我们带来超过100万张选票。但我们的目标不止于此。这一次的目标是争取超过200万张选票，在真主恩典的庇佑下，我们一定会做到。”州长敦促该党欢迎此前转投其他政党的回归者，并将APC的崛起归功于各党派组成联盟击败主要反对党。他呼吁媒体进行建设性报道，警告不要煽动政治过热或引发不安全局势，并表示竞选活动将突出联邦政府的经济政策、增加了的收入以及就业创造。新闻部长伊德里斯·马拉吉在发言中称赞了委员会领导层的选择，并表示APC将以政府在过去三年半里推动尼日利亚经济转型的政绩为依据开展竞选。他敦促新任成员把州和全党的集体利益置于优先位置，并维护党内团结。APC北中部地区主席穆阿祖·里贾奥议员在祝贺委员会领导层时强调，2027年竞选委员会不应低估对手，并表示该党的目标是在让巴戈州长连任的同时，也让该党参议员、众议院议员和州议会议员一同连任。竞选委员会总干事艾哈迈德·伊贝托代表成员接受任命，承诺勤奋工作、加强战略协调、深入基层、保持团结、遵守纪律并执行选举规则。他说，委员会将在各司局、地方政府、选区和基层单位建立工作框架，在重视经验的同时接纳新想法。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

In a statement by its spokesperson, Mohammed Haruna, INEC said the commission decided to upload the register following concerns from Nigerians and other stakeholders about its online accessibility.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 独立国家选举委员会（INEC）在错过依法公布选民名册供公众核查的期限数日后，将2027年大选选民初步名册发布到了网上。INEC发言人穆罕默德·哈鲁纳在一份声明中表示，鉴于尼日利亚国民和其他利益相关方对该名册网上获取便利性的关切，该委员会决定上传名册。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has published the preliminary register of voters for the 2027 general election online, days after missing the statutory deadline for making the register available for public scrutiny. In a statement by its spokesperson, Mohammed Haruna, INEC said the commission decided to upload the register following concerns from Nigerians and other stakeholders about its online accessibility. PREMIUM TIMES reported that the electoral commission violated electoral law by failing to publish the voter register on its website by the stipulated time. Section 19(1) of the Electoral Act 2026 mandates INEC to publish the voters’ register on its website, alongside a physical publication at every registration area, for seven days before the 90-day mark to the general election. Since the 2027 general elections are scheduled to begin on 16 January 2027, the deadline for INEC to appoint the seven days for displaying the voters’ register was 18 October. The election begins with the presidential and National Assembly elections on 16 January 2027, followed by the governorship and state Houses of Assembly elections on 6 February 2027, according to INEC’s timetable. In the Monday statement by its spokesperson, INEC said it conducted the physical display of the preliminary register at registration areas nationwide from 9 to 15 October, allowing registered voters to inspect their details and submit claims and objections. “Accordingly, and in furtherance of its commitment to transparency, accessibility and public confidence in the electoral process, the commission has decided to make available on its online platform the same Preliminary Register of Voters earlier displayed at the Registration Areas,” the commission said. INEC said the online publication was an additional measure to widen public access to the register, while the commission continued processing claims and objections ahead of publishing the final register. It added that the final register of voters will be published on 15 December. The register is available on the commission’s online platform . The preliminary register allows registered voters to check whether their names and personal details have been correctly captured ahead of an election. It also provides an opportunity to identify omissions, errors and questionable entries before INEC finalises the list. INEC said it remained committed to transparency, accountability and the implementation of the Electoral Act, 2026, as it prepares for the 2027 general election. The voter register has risen to 103 million voters, up from 93 million recorded ahead of the 2023 elections. Middle-aged Nigerians dominate the voter register, ahead of young Nigerians who dominated it before the 2023 elections. According to the breakdown provided by INEC, voters in the 35–49 age bracket number 43,265,946, representing 41.83 per cent of the 103.43 million registered voters. They are followed by voters aged 18 to 34, who number 29,777,576, or 28.79 per cent of the register. The commission said 22,982,900 voters, or 22.22 per cent, are aged 50 to 69 years, while those aged 70 and above make up the smallest age group, with 7,402,291 voters, or 7.16 per cent. The age distribution shows that voters aged 35 years and above account for about 71.2 per cent of the register, while those aged 18 to 34 years constitute less than one-third of registered voters. This differs from the 2023 voter data, where voters aged 18 to 34 dominated the register at 39.65 per cent
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 独立国家选举委员会错过法定期限后在线公布初步选民名册
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 独立国家选举委员会（INEC）已在网上公布2027年大选选民初步名册，此前该委员会错过依法公布名册供公众核查的截止期限。发言人穆罕默德·哈鲁纳在一份声明中表示，鉴于尼日利亚民众及其他利益相关方对名册在线查询便利性的关切，INEC决定上传选民名册。《PREMIUM TIMES》报道称，该委员会未能在规定时间内将选民名册发布在其网站上，违反了选举法。《2026年选举法》第19条第（1）款规定，INEC须在2027年大选举行前90天的节点到来前7天，将选民名册发布在其网站上，同时在每个登记区进行实体展示，供公众查阅。2027年大选定于2027年1月16日开始，因此INEC确定选民名册展示7天期限的截止日期为10月18日。根据INEC的时间表，大选于2027年1月16日以总统和国民议会选举开始，随后于2027年2月6日举行州长和州议会选举。INEC发言人周一在声明中说，该委员会于10月9日至15日在全国各登记区实体展示了初步选民名册，让已登记选民核查个人信息，并提交主张和异议。“因此，为进一步履行其在选举进程中对透明度、可及性以及公众信任的承诺，该委员会决定在线上平台提供此前在登记区展示的同一份选民初步名册。”该委员会表示，在继续处理相关主张和异议、为最终名册发布作准备的同时，网上公布名册是扩大公众获取名册渠道的一项额外措施。该委员会补充说，最终选民名册将于12月15日公布。选民名册可在该委员会的线上平台查阅。初步名册让已登记选民能够在选举前核查自己的姓名及个人信息是否被准确录入，也使其有机会在INEC敲定名单前发现遗漏、错误和可疑记录。INEC表示，在为2027年大选作准备的过程中，该委员会仍致力于落实透明度、问责制以及《2026年选举法》。选民名册已增至1.03亿人，而2023年大选前登记的选民人数为9300万。尼日利亚中年选民在选民名册中占主导地位，而在2023年大选前，年轻选民曾在名册中占据主导地位。根据INEC提供的数据，35至49岁年龄段选民有43,265,946人，占1.0343亿登记选民的41.83%。其次是18至34岁选民，共有29,777,576人，占名册的28.79%。该委员会表示，50至69岁选民有22,982,900人，占22.22%；70岁及以上选民则是人数最少的年龄群体，共有7,402,291人，占7.16%。年龄分布显示，35岁及以上选民约占名册的71.2%，而18至34岁选民占登记选民不足三分之一。这与2023年的选民数据不同，当时18至34岁选民以39.65%的比例在名册中占据主导地位

https://www.myjoyonline.com/gcb-bank-par.summary_zh: 加纳商业银行股份公司（GCB Bank PLC）与银联国际合作，推出加纳首张人民币借记卡和预付卡，使客户能够直接以人民币付款，无需进行中间货币兑换。该协议在中国上海的银联国际总部正式签署，加纳银行代表见证了签署仪式。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gcb-bank-par.body: GCB Bank PLC has partnered with UnionPay International to introduce Ghana’s first Renminbi (RMB) debit and prepaid cards, allowing customers to make payments directly in the Chinese currency without intermediate currency conversions. The agreement, formalised at UnionPay International’s headquarters in Shanghai, China, was witnessed by representatives of the Bank of Ghana. According to the two institutions, the arrangement marks UnionPay’s first RMB payment card designed to use the Chinese currency directly for clearing and settlement. The cards will enable Ghanaian businesses and travellers to make point-of-sale payments, withdraw cash from automated teller machines (ATMs) and conduct online transactions in China. The initiative comes amid increasing trade and travel between Ghana and China, with bilateral trade reaching US$14.1 billion in 2025, representing a 19.3 per cent increase over the previous year. China remains Ghana’s largest trading partner, with many Ghanaian businesses relying on Chinese markets for goods, machinery and raw materials. Speaking at the launch, the Managing Director of GCB Bank PLC, Farihan Alhassan, said the partnership would help address payment challenges faced by Ghanaian businesses operating in China. “For Ghanaian businesses trading with China, making payments should be a straightforward part of doing business. Our partnership with UnionPay International will enable customers to pay directly in RMB, reducing the need for intermediate currency conversions and making it easier to manage payments during procurement and business trips. “This reflects GCB’s commitment to supporting the ambitions of Ghanaian businesses, connecting them to global opportunities and strengthening trade ties between Ghana and China,” he stated. The General Manager of UnionPay International’s Africa Branch, Feng Chen, said the partnership would improve payment connectivity between Ghana and China while providing additional cross-border payment options. The development also comes amid growing travel between the two countries. According to the Ghana Tourism Authority’s 2025 Tourism Report, Ghana recorded 1.307 million international visitors, with business travel accounting for 31 per cent of visits. China ranked as Ghana’s sixth-largest source market, contributing nearly 20,000 arrivals annually. Meanwhile, more than 9,000 Ghanaians travelled to China in 2023 for business, trade, education and official engagements, while approximately 4,600 Ghanaian students were enrolled in Chinese institutions. The introduction of the cards is expected to provide an additional payment option for Ghanaian traders who frequently travel to China for procurement, accommodation, transport and other business-related expenses. GCB Bank, established in 1953 and listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange, operates more than 183 branches and 340 ATMs nationwide. UnionPay International operates a payment acceptance network spanning 183 countries and regions, with cards issued locally in more than 86 countries and regions through partnerships with over 2,600 institutions worldwide
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gcb-bank-par.title_zh: GCB Bank与UnionPay合作推出加纳首批人民币借记卡和预付卡
https://www.myjoyonline.com/gcb-bank-par.body_zh: GCB Bank PLC已与银联国际合作，推出加纳首套人民币借记卡和预付卡，使客户无需进行中间货币兑换，即可直接使用人民币付款。该协议在中国上海的银联国际总部正式签署，加纳银行代表见证了签署仪式。据两家机构介绍，这项安排标志着银联首套以人民币直接进行清算和结算的支付卡。这些卡将让加纳企业和旅客能够在中国进行销售终端付款、从自动取款机提取现金以及开展在线交易。鉴于加纳与中国的贸易和旅行往来日益频繁，2025年两国双边贸易额达到141亿美元，较上年增长19.3%。中国仍是加纳最大的贸易伙伴，许多加纳企业依靠中国市场采购商品、机械设备和原材料。GCB Bank PLC董事总经理Farihan Alhassan在发卡仪式上表示，此次合作将有助于解决在华经营的加纳企业面临的支付难题。她说：“对于同中国开展贸易的加纳企业而言，付款应当是经商过程中一项简单便捷的环节。我们与银联国际的合作将使客户能够直接以人民币付款，减少中间货币兑换的必要性，也让采购和商务出差期间的资金管理更加便捷。“这体现了GCB致力于支持加纳企业发展的承诺，帮助企业连接全球机遇，并加强加纳与中国的贸易联系。”银联国际非洲分公司总经理陈锋表示，此次合作将改善加纳与中国之间的支付互联互通，同时提供更多跨境支付选择。随着两国之间旅行人数不断增长，加纳旅游局《2025年旅游报告》显示，加纳接待了130.7万名国际访客，其中商务旅行占访客总数的31%。中国是加纳第六大客源市场，每年为加纳带来近2万人次。与此同时，2023年有超过9,000名加纳人前往中国从事商务、贸易、教育和公务活动，约有4,600名加纳学生在中国的院校就读。推出这些卡预计将为经常前往中国进行采购、住宿、交通及其他业务支出的加纳贸易商提供更多支付选择。GCB Bank成立于1953年，并在加纳证券交易所上市，在全国设有183家以上分行和340台自动取款机。银联国际运营的支付受理网络覆盖183个国家和地区，并通过与全球2,600多家机构的合作，在86个以上国家和地区当地发行卡片

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has denied owing its workers salaries, challenging the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council to provide evidence supporting the claim. The denial followed a statement by the APC campaign council spokesperson, Dele Alake, alleging that the ADC leadership had failed to pay its employees for more than 12 months. In a statement on Monday, the ADC National Publicity Secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, described the allegation as false and accused the ruling party of attempting to divert attention from the Tinubu administration’s record. “The ADC categorically rejects this allegation as an irresponsible falsehood, deliberately concocted to mislead Nigerians and distract attention from the monumental failures of the Tinubu administration,” he said. Mr Abdullahi said the APC should address the rising cost of living, unemployment and insecurity rather than make allegations about the opposition party’s internal affairs. He accused the ruling party of preparing to campaign for the 2027 elections by attacking its opponents instead of presenting its achievements in government. “It is becoming increasingly clear that the APC has decided to run its 2027 campaign on allegations against the opposition rather than achievements of its own,” he said. The ADC spokesperson urged Mr Alake and other APC campaign officials to explain the government’s economic policies and their effects on Nigerians. He said the ADC would keep focusing on the cost of living ahead of the elections. “This election is about one issue only: the cost of living that the Tinubu administration has pushed beyond the reach of the majority of Nigerians. The ADC will stay focused on this issue. We will not be distracted,” he said. In its earlier statement, the APC Presidential Campaign Council accused the ADC National Working Committee, led by David Mark and Rauf Aregbesola, of failing to pay party employees for more than 12 months. The council also raised allegations concerning the employment records of former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar and Mr Aregbesola, a former governor of Osun State. The ADC did not provide payroll records or other documentary evidence in its statement to substantiate its denial

https://www.myjoyonline.com/naimos-seize.summary: The new approach became evident during a major NAIMOS operation at Eshaem in the Nzema East Municipality of the Western Region, where enforcement personnel disrupted several illegal mining sites stretching from the Eshaem road towards the Ankobra River. During the operation, the Task Force destroyed 28 chanfang machines, 19 water pumps, and five makeshift structures used to support illegal mining.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/naimos-seize.summary_zh: 西部 region's Nzema East Municipality 的 Eshaem 开展了一次大规模 NAIMOS 行动，新的执法方式在此次行动中显现出来。执法人员捣毁了几处非法采矿点，这些矿点从 Eshaem 公路一直延伸至 Ankobra 河。行动期间，特别行动队摧毁了 28 台 chanfang 采矿机、19 台水泵以及 5 座用于支持非法采矿的临时搭建设施。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/naimos-seize.body: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has signalled a major expansion of its enforcement strategy against illegal mining, with increased attention now being directed at persons and businesses that manufacture, fabricate, transport, store, supply or otherwise facilitate access to equipment used for illegal mining. The new approach became evident during a major NAIMOS operation at Eshaem in the Nzema East Municipality of the Western Region, where enforcement personnel disrupted several illegal mining sites stretching from the Eshaem road towards the Ankobra River. During the operation, the Task Force destroyed 28 chanfang machines, 19 water pumps, and five makeshift structures used to support illegal mining. The Task Force identified several illegal mining locations along the operational corridor, including two major sites near the Ankobra River. The team observed evidence of recent excavator activity at one site, while three excavators were found at another. A monitor was recovered from one machine, while critical components had already been removed from the others. The operation took a significant turn during the Task Force's return from the area, when personnel encountered a Hyundai truck carrying 22 brand-new Chanfang machines being offloaded into a store. The truck and the 22 machines were immediately seized. An adjoining store was also found to contain a substantial quantity of equipment and spare parts associated with illegal mining operations. The premises were subsequently secured to enable further investigations into the source, ownership, and intended destination of the equipment. This development represents an important evolution in NAIMOS' enforcement strategy. NAIMOS has observed that destroying chanfang machines, pumps, and other equipment at illegal mining sites alone will not provide a lasting solution if operators can replace the machinery within days and return to the rivers. The Secretariat is therefore extending enforcement beyond the mining sites to the supply and logistics networks that enable illegal mining. Under this approach, increased attention will be directed at chanfang fabricators, equipment manufacturers and assemblers, dealers and suppliers, transporters, warehouses and stores, as well as persons who knowingly rent excavators, pumps, and other machinery for illegal mining operations. NAIMOS will also intensify intelligence-gathering to identify where illegal mining equipment is fabricated, assembled, stored and distributed. The objective is to deny illegal miners the ability to rapidly replace equipment destroyed during enforcement operations, thereby weakening the logistical system that sustains repeated illegal mining along Ghana's rivers, farms and other environmentally sensitive areas. The Eshaem operation is part of Operation WATER SHIELD, which aims to protect the Ankobra River, which remains under pressure from illegal mining in parts of the Western Region. NAIMOS will sustain operations along the river corridor while targeting the networks that supply the machinery, fuel, transport and other logistics required for illegal mining. The Secretariat serves notice that persons who knowingly manufacture, fabricate, transport, store, supply, or rent equipment for illegal mining should no longer consider themselves removed from enforcement merely because they are not physically operating at a mining site. The fight against illegal mining will no longer end at the riverbank. It will extend to the workshops where illegal mining equipment is fabricated, the stores where it is kept, the vehicles used to transport it and the networks that finance and supply it. NAIMOS will continue to work with relevant security and regulatory institutions to investigate the ownership and supply chains of equipment intercepted during operations and take appropriate action where links to illegal mining are established. The message is clear: those who provide the machines and infrastructure that enable the destruction of Ghana's rivers are part of the problem, and the enforcement net is widening to reach them
https://www.myjoyonline.com/naimos-seize.title_zh: NAIMOS在针对非法采矿供应网络的Eshaem行动中查扣22台Chanfang设备
https://www.myjoyonline.com/naimos-seize.body_zh: 国家打击非法采矿行动秘书处（NAIMOS）已发出信号，表示将大幅扩大针对非法采矿的执法战略。目前，执法重点正转向制造、加工、运输、储存、供应或以其他方式协助获取非法采矿设备的个人和企业。在西部地区恩泽马东市埃谢姆开展的NAIMOS重大行动中，这一新做法已明显显现。执法人员捣毁了从埃谢姆公路延伸至安科布拉河沿岸的多个非法采矿点。行动期间，专案小组摧毁了28台Chanfang采矿机、19台水泵和5座用于支持非法采矿的临时搭建结构。专案小组沿行动走廊确定了多个非法采矿地点，其中包括安科布拉河附近的两处大型矿点。小组在一处矿点发现了近期使用挖掘机的痕迹，并在另一处发现3台挖掘机。办案人员从一台设备中提取了一个监测装置，其他设备的关键部件则已被拆除。专案小组从该地区返回途中，行动出现了重大转折：执法人员遇到一辆现代卡车，车上正卸载22台全新Chanfang采矿机，并被运入一座仓库。卡车及这22台采矿机随即被查扣。相邻的一座仓库也被发现存放大量与非法采矿行动有关的设备和备件。随后，执法部门封锁了该场所，以便进一步调查这些设备的来源、所有权和预定目的地。这一进展标志着NAIMOS执法战略的重要转变。NAIMOS指出，如果采矿作业者能在数日内更换机械并重返河流，仅摧毁非法采矿点内的Chanfang采矿机、水泵和其他设备就无法形成持久解决方案。因此，秘书处正将执法范围从采矿点扩大至为非法采矿提供便利的供应和物流网络。根据这一做法，执法重点将转向Chanfang设备加工商、设备制造商和组装商、经销商和供应商、运输企业、仓库和商店，以及明知租赁挖掘机、水泵和其他设备用于非法采矿行动的个人。NAIMOS还将加强情报收集，查明非法采矿设备制造、组装、储存和分销的地点。其目标是剥夺非法采矿者迅速替换执法行动中被摧毁设备的能力，从而削弱维持加纳河流、农田及其他环境敏感地区反复非法采矿活动的后勤体系。埃谢姆行动是“水盾行动”的一部分，该行动旨在保护安科布拉河；目前，该河部分地区仍承受非法采矿带来的压力。NAIMOS将持续沿河流走廊开展行动，同时打击为非法采矿提供机械、燃料、运输及其他后勤保障的网络。秘书处严正警告，凡明知自己制造、加工、运输、储存、供应或出租非法采矿设备者，不得再认为自己仅因未亲自在采矿点作业就能免于执法。打击非法采矿的行动将不再止步于河岸，而将延伸至制造非法采矿设备的工坊、存放这些设备的仓库、运输它们的车辆，以及为其提供融资和供应的网络。NAIMOS将继续与有关安全和监管机构合作，调查行动中截获设备的所有权及供应链，并在确认其与非法采矿存在联系时采取适当行动。信息十分明确：那些提供机器和基础设施、促成加纳河流遭到破坏者，也是问题的一部分；执法网正不断扩大，并将追查到他们。

https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/a.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Despite significant economic progress and sustained public health efforts, anaemia — driven significantly by iron deficiency — continues to be one of India’s most pressing public health challenges. Affecting over half of Indian women and almost three-fourths of children, anaemia contributes to maternal mortality, an intergenerational cycle of malnutrition, impaired cognitive development, reduced productivity and substantial economic losses. The Government of India’s 7X7X7 Anaemia Mukt Bharat (AMB) strategy, which was launched recently, rightly recognises the multifactorial nature of anaemia through a comprehensive approach spanning prevention, screening, treatment, dietary diversification and behaviour change. Yet, one proven preventive intervention remains significantly underutilised. That intervention is Double Fortified Salt (DFS) — salt fortified with both iodine and iron. Salt offers an unparalleled opportunity to address iron deficiency. Consumed daily by virtually every household across India, in predictable quantities regardless of income or geography, it is uniquely suited to deliver a preventive nutrition intervention at population scale. DFS also addresses one of the fundamental challenges of anaemia control — sustained compliance. Delivering iron through an everyday food complements interventions such as iron supplementation and dietary diversification, whose effectiveness depends on regular adherence. India already has one of the world’s most successful public health platforms in Universal Salt Iodisation, with around 95% of households consuming iodised salt. Building on this existing infrastructure, DFS is already distributed to an estimated 76 million people across four States through government safety-net programmes. Global and Indian evidence strongly support DFS. A global review has shown that DFS can reduce anaemia by up to 21%. Randomised controlled trials in Bengaluru, Darjeeling, and Punjab, along with large-scale implementation in Uttar Pradesh, have shown improvements in iron status and confirmed that, when manufactured to validated specifications, DFS is acceptable to consumers, reduces iron deficiency, and is highly cost-effective. A DFS standard has been issued by the Government of India’s Food Safety and Standards Authority (FSSAI), and the Government of India actually mandates DFS’ inclusion in the national school feeding programme (PM POSHAN and the national early childhood development programme- Integrated Child Development Scheme, or ICDS). At an estimated cost of ₹14-₹20 per person annually, DFS represents one of the most affordable population-level nutrition interventions available, with a benefit-cost ratio of 4.2:1 for national DFS introduction, primarily driven by improved health outcomes and subsequent increases in labour productivity. India also possesses the manufacturing capacity to produce high-quality DFS at scale. Established fortification technologies, centralised salt production and existing laboratory infrastructure make quality assurance and regulatory monitoring simpler than for many other fortified foods. What has limited DFS from wider adoption? The barriers are now primarily institutional rather than technical. The next imperative is to accelerate its nationwide adoption and ensure last-mile access, particularly the Public Distribution System apart from social safety-net programmes, across all States through a central flagship scheme. Although DFS is recommended under PM POSHAN and ICDS, its integration into the largest safety net programme i.e., the Public Distribution System (PDS) — which reaches around 800 million beneficiaries — remains uneven because implementation depends largely on State governments. Greater policy commitment, dedicated financing, stronger quality assurance, wider commercial availability and consumer awareness are now needed to accelerate nationwide scale-up. These are implementation challenges — not technological ones — and are well within India’s capacity to address. Like all public health nutrition interventions, DFS should be implemented within a robust regulatory framework. It should complement existing strategies under Anaemia Mukt Bharat, align with India’s sodium reduction goals, and continue to be accompanied by screening for haemoglobinopathies such as thalassaemia and sickle cell disease. These safeguards are well recognised through experience of rice fortification programme and can be readily integrated into implementation and monitoring systems. The launch of the revised AMB strategy provides renewed momentum to strengthen the preventive pillar of India’s anaemia response and advance the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. India has already shown the world how science, policy, public systems, and public awareness can transform nutrition through Universal Salt Iodisation. By scaling DFS nationally, India can not only accelerate progress towards Anaemia Mukt Bharat but also contribute to global efforts to reduce iron deficiency by demonstrating an affordable, scalable model for other low- and middle-income countries. Unlock these with Subscription A group of 21 news publishers has challenged the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 , India’s privacy law, in court, arguing it would trample investigative work and let the government identify journalists’ sources, documents show. Also read | Supreme Court to examine impact of data protection law on RTI, investigative journalism Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government announced the implementation of the law in 2025 to protect the digital personal data of users, raising compliance requirements for platforms like Meta and Google. The publishers have said that since media outlets were not exempt, the law was an invasion of press freedom. The October 6, 2026 lawsuit, being reported for the first time and due to be heard on Tuesday (October 27, 2026), is the most high-profile challenge to the government’s privacy law. Until now, only free speech activists and a group of smaller news outlets had challenged it. It also marks an unusual challenge to the government from businesses headed by Mr. Ambani and Mr. Adani, who Opposition parties allege are close to Mr. Modi and get favourable treatment — charges the businesses and the government vehemently deny. DNPA and the media groups did not respond to requests for comment from Reuters , and neither did the IT Ministry. The publishers are demanding that most of the law’s contentious provisions, which kick in from May 2027, be quashed. They are arguing that the law could force a journalist to get prior consent from a person they want to investigate and force publishers to erase stories. They also say powers granted by the law to demand information could expose reporters’ sources. The law would “render investigative journalism a benign and neutered recorder of events,” the 698-page filing said. The provisions “constitute pre-censorship which is anathema to any democracy worth its name”. The lawsuit comes amid accusations of declining press freedom in India since Mr. Modi took office in 2014. Critics say many mainstream media outlets have not done enough to scrutinise the Modi government. India’s ranking in Reporters Without Borders’ World Press Freedom Index fell to 157 th out of 180 countries this year, from 140 th in 2014 — but the government rejects the rankings. Modi government says it respects press freedom and says India, which has a “vibrant press and media ecosystem” of hundreds of newspapers and TV channels, does not need validation from foreign bodies. DNPA’s members include Mr. Ambani’s Network18 , which has seven digital news platforms, Mr. Adani’s NDTV and other marquee media groups, including the Indian Express and Times Internet , which is part of the Times of India group, publisher of India’s largest-selling English-language daily. A key concern in the law is the requirement of consent, the group’s filing says. The law also lets people withdraw consent at any time and demand that their data be erased, without any public-interest safeguard, which DNPA says could force its members to unpublish or heavily redact a factual news report. News publishers are concerned that a federal authority created under the law can impose fines for non-compliance, and grants powers to New Delhi to block access to any information in the “interests of the general public”, which would curtail press freedom, DNPA said. In an August letter to the government attached to the lawsuit, the group said India “has chosen to grant broad exemptions to the state, while failing to extend any corresponding protection to the press”. No response was cited. From next year, the law will also let New Delhi order any organization handling personal data “to furnish such information as it may call for”, putting newsrooms at risk of having to divulge sources, the filing said. It can also deter whistleblowers from sharing information on corruption, corporate wrongdoing or electoral malpractice with reporters, the DNPA argued. 由21家新闻出版机构组成的团体已就印度隐私法《2023年数字个人数据保护法》（DPDP）向法院提起诉讼。文件显示，该团体认为，这部法律会践踏调查新闻工作，并允许政府识别记者的消息来源。

另请阅读｜最高法院将审查数据保护法对《信息权法》及调查新闻的影响

总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的政府宣布于2025年实施该法，以保护用户的数字个人数据，同时提高了Meta和Google等平台的合规要求。

出版机构表示，由于媒体机构不在豁免范围内，该法侵犯了新闻自由。这起于2026年10月6日提起、此次首次报道并定于周二（2026年10月27日）开庭审理的诉讼，是对政府隐私法最引人注目的挑战。此前，只有言论自由活动人士和一组较小型新闻机构挑战过这部法律。

这也是由阿姆巴尼先生和阿达尼先生领导的企业对政府发起的不同寻常的挑战。反对党指控这些企业与莫迪先生关系密切，并受到优待；企业和政府均强烈否认这些指控。

DNPA和媒体团体均未回应Reuters的置评请求，IT部也未回应。

出版机构要求撤销该法中大部分存在争议的条款，这些条款将从2027年5月起生效。他们认为，该法可能迫使记者在调查某个人之前取得当事人的事先同意，并迫使出版机构删除报道。他们还表示，该法授予要求提供信息的权力，可能暴露记者的消息来源。

这份长达698页的诉状称，该法将“使调查新闻沦为事件记录者中良性且被阉割的角色”。相关条款“构成预先审查，是任何名副其实的民主制度都无法接受的”。

这起诉讼出现之际，外界正指控自莫迪先生2014年就任以来，印度新闻自由不断衰退。批评者说，许多主流媒体机构未能充分审视莫迪政府。今年，印度在无国界记者组织《世界新闻自由指数》中的排名从2014年的第140位降至180个国家的第157位，但政府否认这一排名。

莫迪政府表示尊重新闻自由，并称印度拥有由数百家报纸和电视频道组成的“充满活力的新闻和媒体生态系统”，无需外国机构给予认可。

DNPA的成员包括阿姆巴尼先生旗下、拥有七个数字新闻平台的Network18，阿达尼先生旗下的NDTV，以及其他知名媒体集团，包括The Indian Express和Times Internet。后者属于Times of India集团，该集团出版印度销量最大的英文日报。

该集团提交的诉状称，同意机制是法律中的一项关键关切。该法还允许个人随时撤回同意，并要求删除其数据，而且没有任何公共利益保障措施；DNPA称，这可能迫使成员撤下事实性新闻报道，或对报道进行大幅删改。

DNPA表示，新闻出版机构担心，根据该法设立的联邦主管机构可对不合规行为处以罚款，并有权以“公共利益”为由，阻止新德里获取任何信息，这将限制新闻自由。

该集团在随诉讼提交的8月致政府信函中表示，印度“选择给予国家广泛豁免，却未能向新闻界提供任何相应保护”。报道未引用任何回应。

诉状称，从明年起，该法还将允许新德里命令任何处理个人数据的组织“提供其要求的信息”，这可能使新闻编辑部面临被迫透露消息来源的风险。DNPA辩称，这也可能阻碍吹哨人向记者分享有关腐败、企业不当行为或选举舞弊的信息。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/malawi-deleg.body: Malawi is looking to Ghana’s experience in gold production and mining-sector reforms for lessons to strengthen its own mineral governance, with a focus on responsible sourcing, artisanal mining and the financing of mineral-related businesses. The delegation, led by Malawi’s Minister of Mining, Thoko Tembo, met Ghana’s Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, as part of a learning mission supported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). The engagement focused on Ghana’s mining governance framework and ongoing efforts to improve gold purchasing, traceability, production accounting and the management of mineral revenues. Mr Buah said Ghana’s long history of mining had provided experience from which other countries could learn, while emphasising that the country was also working to improve its policies and regulatory systems. He said ongoing reforms were intended to strengthen accountability in the gold sector, protect the environment and ensure mining communities had a greater voice and benefited from resources extracted from their lands. The Lands Minister outlined proposed changes to the mining licensing regime, including clearer timelines and performance requirements for companies holding mining rights. He also highlighted plans to involve district-level mining committees in assessing proposed concessions before licences are issued. The proposed measures are intended to strengthen oversight and improve the assessment of mining proposals before they receive regulatory approval. Chief Executive Officer of the Minerals Commission, Isaac Tandoh, also presented Ghana’s mining governance framework to the delegation. He responded to questions on domestic gold purchasing, the formalisation of mineral markets and efforts to strengthen responsible sourcing systems. Malawi’s Minister of Mining, Thoko Tembo, welcomed the opportunity to learn from Ghana’s experience, including challenges encountered in developing and regulating its mining industry. He said the delegation wanted practical lessons that could help Malawi avoid similar difficulties as it develops its own sector. The discussions included artisanal and small-scale mining and access to financing for businesses operating in the minerals industry. The delegation also included representatives of Malawi’s banking sector and artisanal and small-scale mining industry, reflecting an interest in both regulatory approaches and the financial systems needed to support mineral-sector development. The engagement provided an opportunity for the two countries to exchange perspectives on mining regulation, domestic mineral markets and responsible sourcing. For Ghana, the discussions come as authorities pursue reforms aimed at improving accountability in gold purchasing and strengthening oversight of mining activities. For Malawi, the visit offers an opportunity to examine Ghana’s policy approaches and consider which lessons could inform the development of its own mining industry

https://www.myjoyonline.com/malawi-deleg.body_zh: 马拉维正借鉴加纳在黄金生产和矿业部门改革方面的经验，以加强自身矿产治理，重点关注负责任采购、手工采矿以及矿产相关企业的融资。由马拉维矿业部长托科·腾博率领的代表团会见了加纳土地与自然资源部长埃马纽埃尔·阿马-科菲·布阿。此次学习访问得到联合国开发计划署（UNDP）支持。交流重点围绕加纳的矿业治理框架，以及加纳正在推进的黄金收购、可追溯性、生产核算和矿产收入管理改进工作。布阿表示，加纳悠久的采矿历史积累了可供其他国家借鉴的经验，同时强调加纳也在努力完善政策和监管体系。他说，持续推进的改革旨在加强黄金行业问责、保护环境，并确保采矿社区拥有更大发言权，且能从其土地上开采的资源中获得更多利益。土地部长介绍了拟对矿业许可制度作出的调整，包括为持有采矿权的公司设定更明确的时间要求和绩效要求。他还强调，计划在颁发许可证之前，让地区级矿业委员会参与评估拟议的采矿特许权。这些拟议措施旨在加强监督，并改善对矿业项目在获得监管批准前的评估。矿产委员会首席执行官艾萨克·坦多赫也向代表团介绍了加纳的矿业治理框架，并就国内黄金收购、矿产市场正规化以及加强负责任采购体系的努力回答了问题。马拉维矿业部长托科·腾博对有机会借鉴加纳经验表示欢迎，其中包括开发和监管本国矿业过程中所遇到的挑战。他说，代表团希望获得切实可行的经验，以帮助马拉维在发展本国矿业时避免类似困难。讨论内容涵盖手工采矿和小规模采矿，以及矿产行业企业获得融资的问题。代表团成员还包括马拉维银行业以及手工采矿和小规模采矿行业的代表，反映出双方既关注监管方法，也关注支持矿产行业发展的金融体系。此次交流为两国提供了就矿业监管、国内矿产市场和负责任采购交换观点的机会。对加纳而言，相关讨论正值当局推进旨在提高黄金收购问责和加强对采矿活动监督的改革之际。对马拉维而言，此次访问提供了一个考察加纳政策做法，并思考哪些经验可以为本国矿业发展提供借鉴的机会

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: Alleged Certificate Forgery: UNN, NYSC disowned Nnaji’s certificates, witness tells court
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: A prosecution witness, on Monday, told the Federal High Court in Abuja that the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), and the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) disowned certificates linked to former Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Geoffrey Nnaji. The witness further told the court that UNN also responded that Nnaji failed to obtain the required grades for the award of his certificate.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 周一，一名控方证人在阿布贾联邦高等法院表示，尼日利亚大学恩苏卡分校（UNN）和国家青年服务团（NYSC）均否认签发与前创新、科技部长杰弗里·纳贾有关联的证书。该证人进一步告诉法院，UNN 还回应称，纳贾未取得授予其证书所需的成绩。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A prosecution witness, on Monday, told the Federal High Court in Abuja that the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN), and the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) disowned certificates linked to former Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Geoffrey Nnaji. The witness, who identified himself as Yakubu Ibrahim, a superintendent of police officer with the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC), made the revelation. He was led in evidence by prosecution lawyer J.A Mumini, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN). ICPC is prosecuting Mr Nnaji on certificate forgery and money laundering charges. An investigation by PREMIUM TIMES exposed the certificate forgery scandal leading to Mr Nnaji’s ouster from office last year. The former minister is the Peoples Democratic Party’s governorship candidate for the upcoming 2027 governorship candidate in Enugu State. Mr Ibrahim said his team was assigned to investigate the matter after the commission received two separate petitions alleging certificate forgery against Mr Nnaji. He said the Chairman of the Special Task Force directed an investigation, prompting the commission to request relevant documents from the National Assembly, the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (SGF), University of Nigeria, Nsukka and the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC). According to him, the Clerk of the Senate, National Assembly, forwarded Mr Nnaji’s NYSC certificate and BSc certificate in Microbiology and Biochemistry to the commission. He said NYSC responded that the certificate purportedly issued by the corps was not issued by it. The witness further told the court that UNN also responded that Nnaji failed to obtain the required grades for the award of his certificate. He said the university explained in its letter the policy governing the grades required for the award of a certificate saying if one failed four times, the person was not qualified. Mr Ibrahim said Mr Nnaji failed at two stages and did not write the examination at the third stage for medical reasons. “The witness said that, according to the letter, the defendant went ahead to write the supplementary examination for which he did not register,” he said. Mr Ibrahim further testified that UNN confirmed that the BSc certificate in Microbiology and Biochemistry attributed to the defendant was not issued by the university. He said the commission also obtained documents from the SGF’s office, including a payslip, which prompted it to request Mr Nnaji’s bank statement. According to him, the bank statement showed that Mr Nnaji received N29.5 million in salary as minister before he resigned . The witness identified letters sent to the Clerk of the Senate, the SGF, UNN, NYSC, the bank and Mr Nnaji, which were tendered in evidence. He also told the court that Mr Nnaji failed to honour the commission’s invitation to answer questions on the petitions, prompting the ICPC to contact the State Security Service (SSS). Mr Nnaji’s lawyer, Wole Olanipekun, a SAN, said he would reserve his objection to the admissibility of the documents until the appropriate stage of the proceedings, if necessary. In a ruling, Judge Joyce Abdulmalik admitted the documents in evidence but held that objections to their admissibility would be reserved until the final address. During cross-examination by Mr Olanipekun, Mr Ibrahim told the court that he did not visit UNN during his investigation. He also said he did not know how many campuses the university had or the faculty from which Mr Nnaji graduated. Asked whether he interviewed any past or present university staff member, the witness said he interviewed a registrar named Ngozi but could not recall her surname. Mr Ibrahim also told the court that he saw a letter from UNN directing the withdrawal of Mr Nnaji’s admission. Mr Olanipekun, however, drew his attention to another letter showing that the withdrawal letter dated 7 November 1984, was rescinded by a subsequent letter dated 18 March 1985. With no further questions from the defence for the witness, the prosecution requested an adjournment to enable it call another witness. Ms Abdulmalik adjourned the matter until 5 November for continuation of trial. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Nnaji was arraigned before the Federal High Court on six counts of certificate forgery, money laundering and abuse of office. The ICPC, which filed the charges, alleged that Mr Nnaji presented forged UNN degree and NYSC certificates to support his ministerial appointment in 2023. The commission also accused him of receiving about N29.58 million in salaries and allowances as minister, allegedly linked to proceeds of unlawful acts. The court granted him bail in yhe sum of N20 million with one surety and he was ordered to deposit his passport with the court. He is not to travel outside the country without permission from the court throughout the period of his trial
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 涉嫌伪造证书：证人在法庭上称UNN和NYSC否认Nnaji的证书
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 周一，一名控方证人在阿布贾联邦高等法院表示，尼日利亚大学恩苏卡分校（UNN）和国家青年服务团（NYSC）均否认签发与前创新、科技部长Geoffrey Nnaji有关联的证书。自称尼日利亚独立腐败预防及其他相关罪行委员会（ICPC）警监Yakubu Ibrahim的证人披露了此事。控方律师、尼日利亚资深大律师（J.A Mumini）引导他作证。ICPC正以伪造证书和洗钱罪名起诉Nnaji先生。PREMIUM TIMES的调查揭露了这起伪造证书丑闻，导致Nnaji先生去年被免职。这位前部长是人民民主党在埃努古州即将举行的2027年州长选举中的候选人。Ibrahim先生表示，委员会收到两份分别指控Nnaji先生伪造证书的申诉后，指派其团队调查此事。他说，特别任务组主席指示展开调查，促使委员会向国家议会、联邦政府秘书办公室（SGF）、尼日利亚大学恩苏卡分校和国家青年服务团（NYSC）索取相关文件。据他介绍，国家议会参议院书记官转交给委员会Nnaji先生的国家青年服务团证书以及微生物学和生物化学理学士学位证书。他说，NYSC回复称，声称由该团签发的证书并非其签发。证人进一步告诉法庭，UNN也回复称，Nnaji未达到获颁证书所需的成绩。他说，学校在信函中解释了取得证书所适用的成绩政策：若有4次不及格，该人士便不具备资格。Ibrahim先生说，Nnaji先生在两个阶段未能通过考试，并因医疗原因没有参加第三个阶段的考试。他说：“证人表示，根据信函，被告仍参加了补考，尽管他并未为补考报名。”Ibrahim先生进一步作证称，UNN确认 attributed to the defendant 的微生物学和生物化学理学士学位证书并非由该大学签发。他说，委员会还从SGF办公室取得了包括工资单在内的文件，并据此要求提供Nnaji先生的银行账单。据他介绍，银行账单显示，Nnaji先生担任部长期间收取了29.5 million naira薪金，之后辞职。证人确认了发给参议院书记官、SGF、UNN、NYSC、银行及Nnaji先生的信函，并将其作为证据提交。他还告诉法庭，Nnaji先生未按委员会要求接受询问、就申诉回答问题，促使ICPC联系了国家安全局（SSS）。Nnaji先生的律师、尼日利亚资深大律师Wole Olanipekun表示，如有必要，他将在诉讼程序的适当阶段再对这些文件能否采纳提出异议。法官Joyce Abdulmalik裁定准许将这些文件作为证据，但表示关于其可采性的异议将留待最终陈词阶段处理。在Olanipekun先生交叉询问期间，Ibrahim先生告诉法庭，他在调查期间没有前往UNN。他还说，自己不知道该校有多少个校区，也不知道Nnaji先生毕业于哪个学院。问他是否询问过该大学任何过去或现任工作人员，证人说，他询问过一名名为Ngozi的注册主任，但无法想起她的姓氏。Ibrahim先生还告诉法庭，他看到了一封来自UNN、要求撤销Nnaji先生入学资格的信函。然而，Olanipekun先生提请他注意另一封信，该信显示，日期为1984年11月7日的撤销入学信函已被日期为1985年3月18日的后续信函撤销。辩方没有再向该证人提问后，控方请求休庭，以便传唤另一名证人。Abdulmalik女士将案件延期至11月5日继续审理。尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）报道称，Nnaji因6项伪造证书、洗钱和滥用职权罪名被带到联邦高等法院受审。提出指控的ICPC称，Nnaji先生提交了伪造的UNN学位证书和NYSC证书，以支持其于2023年获任部长。委员会还指控他担任部长期间收取约29.58 million naira的薪金和津贴，称这些款项涉嫌与非法所得有关。法院准许其以20 million naira保释，条件是提供一名担保人，并命令他将护照交由法院保管。在整个审判期间，未经法院许可，他不得离开该国。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council has alleged that the African Democratic Congress is owing its staff salaries for more than a year, urging Nigerians to reject the party and its presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, in the 2027 elections. In a statement on Monday signed by its spokesperson, Dele Alake, the campaign council said the ADC National Working Committee, led by former Senate President David Mark as chairman and former Osun State Governor Rauf Aregbesola as secretary, had failed to pay party workers for more than 12 months. The APC described the alleged non-payment as “unconscionable,” arguing that a party seeking to govern Nigeria should first demonstrate its ability to manage its own workforce. “We find it unconscionable that a political party that has made many grandiose promises to hoodwink Nigerians owes its workers for more than 12 months,” Mr Alake said. The APC said the alleged development exposed what it described as the “emptiness and insincerity” of the ADC and its leaders, who have presented themselves as an alternative to the ruling party. The campaign council also alleged that Atiku, the ADC presidential candidate, had previously faced complaints over unpaid salaries at his businesses. “Atiku Abubakar, the ADC’s leader and presidential candidate, has a reputation for owing his employees,” Mr Alake said, alleging that workers at Gotel Communications and other businesses linked to the former vice president had gone months without pay and staged protests over unpaid salaries and other benefits. The APC also attacked Mr Aregbesola’s record as governor of Osun State, accusing his administration of failing to pay workers and pensioners regularly. Mr Alake alleged that the former governor introduced quarter- and half-salary payments for workers and left pensioners unpaid for more than four years. “As for pensioners, he abandoned them for more than four years. Many died because they could not afford the basics of life,” he said. The APC spokesperson said the alleged failure of the ADC to pay its workers matched what he described as the records of some of the party’s leading figures. “We are therefore not surprised that ADC, harbouring birds of the same feather, cannot pay its workers’ salaries,” he said. The campaign council called on Nigerians, particularly workers, to reject the ADC, Atiku and other candidates contesting elections on the party’s platform in 2027. “We are sounding a warning to Nigerians and working people now: reject ADC. Reject Atiku Abubakar and reject all ADC candidates in the next general elections,” Mr Alake said. The statement comes as the ADC positions itself as a major opposition platform ahead of the 2027 elections, with Atiku among the prominent political figures who have joined the party. PREMIUM TIMES contacted the ADC National Publicity Secretary, Bolaji Abdullahi, and its Director of Media and Publicity, Kola Ologbondiyan, for their responses to the allegations. However, neither Mr Abdullahi nor Mr Ologbondiyan had responded to the enquiries as of the time of filing this report
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: APC指责阿提库和ADC涉嫌拖欠员工工资
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh:
全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会指控非洲民主大会拖欠其工作人员一年多工资，并敦促尼日利亚人在2027年选举中拒绝该党及其总统候选人阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔。竞选委员会周一发布由发言人Dele Alake签署的声明称，由前参议院议长David Mark担任主席、前奥松州州长Rauf Aregbesola担任秘书长的非洲民主大会全国工作委员会，已拖欠党内工作人员工资超过12个月。APC称这一涉嫌欠薪行为“令人不齿”，认为一个谋求治理尼日利亚的政党，首先应证明其管理自身员工队伍的能力。

Alake先生说：“我们认为，一个作出许多夸大承诺、企图蒙骗尼日利亚人的政党，竟拖欠员工超过12个月的工资，这令人不齿。”APC表示，这一涉嫌欠薪事件暴露了其所称的非洲民主大会及其领导人的“虚伪和虚假”。这些人一直把自己塑造成执政党的替代选择。竞选委员会还指控非洲民主大会总统候选人阿蒂库此前曾因旗下企业拖欠工资而遭到投诉。

Alake先生说：“阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔是非洲民主大会的领袖和总统候选人，他素有拖欠员工工资的名声。”他声称，前副总统关联的Gotel Communications及其他企业员工曾数月拿不到工资，并为追讨拖欠的工资和其他福利举行抗议。APC还抨击了Aregbesola先生担任奥松州州长期间的政绩，指控其政府未能定期向工作人员和养老金领取者支付款项。Alake先生称，这位前州长实行按季度和半年发放工资的做法，并让养老金领取者超过4年没有拿到钱。他说：“至于养老金领取者，他抛下他们超过4年。很多人因为负担不起基本生活费用而死。”

这位APC发言人表示，非洲民主大会被指未能向员工支付工资，与其党内一些主要人物的历史记录相符。他说：“因此，对于非洲民主大会聚集着一丘之貉、无法支付员工工资，我们并不感到意外。”竞选委员会呼吁尼日利亚人，尤其是劳动者，拒绝非洲民主大会、阿蒂库以及2027年以该党名义参加选举的其他候选人。

Alake先生说：“我们现在向尼日利亚人和劳动人民发出警告：拒绝非洲民主大会。拒绝阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔，并在下一届大选中拒绝非洲民主大会的所有候选人。”

在2027年选举前夕，非洲民主大会正将自己定位为一个主要反对党平台，阿蒂库是加入该党的知名政治人物之一。《PREMIUM TIMES》联系了非洲民主大会全国宣传秘书Bolaji Abdullahi及媒体与宣传事务主管Kola Ologbondiyan，请其回应这些指控。然而，截至本报道提交时，Abdullahi先生和Ologbondiyan先生均未回应相关询问。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/jusag-threat.summary: The Judicial Service Staff Association of Ghana (JUSAG) has threatened to embark on an indefinite strike from Monday, November 2, 2026, if the government fails to approve and pay its members’ reviewed salaries and allowances. The association has given the government until the end of October to approve the recommendations of the Judicial Council on the 2026 salary review, with payment expected in November, including arrears covering January to October.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/jusag-threat.summary_zh: 加纳司法系统职员协会（JUSAG）威胁称，如果政府未能批准并支付经重新调整的薪金和津贴，该协会将从2026年11月2日星期一起无限期罢工。协会已要求政府在10月底前批准司法委员会关于2026年薪酬调整的建议，并在11月支付相关款项，其中包括1月至10月的欠款。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/jusag-threat.body: The Judicial Service Staff Association of Ghana (JUSAG) has threatened to embark on an indefinite strike from Monday, November 2, 2026, if the government fails to approve and pay its members’ reviewed salaries and allowances. The association has given the government until the end of October to approve the recommendations of the Judicial Council on the 2026 salary review, with payment expected in November, including arrears covering January to October. In a notification of industrial action dated October 23, 2026, and addressed to the Executive Secretary of the National Labour Commission, JUSAG said prolonged delays in concluding the salary review process had heightened tensions and dampened staff morale. The association said the Judicial Council had completed its work on the review and submitted its recommendations to President John Dramani Mahama for determination in line with Article 149 of the 1992 Constitution and the Judicial Service (Terms and Conditions of Service) Regulations, 2025 (C.I. 141). However, JUSAG said efforts to secure approval had yielded little progress despite several letters to the Judicial Council and Management, as well as public appeals to the government. According to the association, it wrote to the Judicial Council on January 19, 2026, to expedite the process and again raised the matter in a letter dated September 10, 2026. It also cited appeals made at its Second Quadrennial Delegates’ Conference in Tamale in August, the 45th AMJG Conference in Accra in September, and the Chief Justice’s Staff Durbar held in Tamale in September. JUSAG said the appeals had been met with assurances without any concrete action towards approving the recommendations and paying the revised salaries. “It is instructive to note that our colleagues elsewhere in the public sector had their new salaries for 2026 approved and paid in January, 2026. We are now in the tenth month of the year, and our members are still waiting — patiently, but no longer quietly,” the letter stated. The association said the delay was particularly concerning because organised labour was already negotiating the base pay for 2027 while Judicial Service staff were yet to receive their reviewed base pay and allowances for 2026. It warned that the prolonged uncertainty undermined the principles governing salary determination under the new legal framework. JUSAG said it had previously urged its members to exercise restraint because of the potential impact of industrial action on justice delivery and national security, while continuing to engage Management and the government. However, it said the hardship among members had become severe and their patience was exhausted. The association’s National Executive Council has therefore set two demands: approval of the Judicial Council’s recommendations on the 2026 salary review by the end of October, and payment of the revised salaries in November, together with arrears from January to October. JUSAG warned that if the demands are not met by Sunday, November 1, 2026, it will commence an indefinite strike on Monday, November 2, until the demands are fulfilled. The notification was copied to the Office of the President, the Judicial Secretary, the Attorney-General and Minister for Justice, the Minister of Finance, and the Minister for Jobs, Labour and Employment Relations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/jusag-threat.title_zh: 因薪资审查延迟，JUSAG威胁从11月2日起罢工
https://www.myjoyonline.com/jusag-threat.body_zh: 加纳司法部门职员协会（JUSAG）威胁称，如果政府未能批准并向其成员支付经重新调整的薪金和津贴，该协会将从2026年11月2日星期一起无限期罢工。该协会已要求政府在10月底前批准司法委员会关于2026年薪酬审查的建议，并在11月支付相关款项，包括1月至10月的欠款。在一份日期为2026年10月23日、发给全国劳工委员会执行秘书的工业行动通知中，JUSAG表示，薪酬审查程序长期拖延、迟迟无法完成，已加剧紧张局势并削弱员工士气。该协会称，司法委员会已经完成2026年薪酬审查工作，并依照1992年宪法第149条以及《2025年司法部门服务条款与条件条例》（C.I. 141），将建议提交总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马裁定。然而，JUSAG表示，尽管协会曾数次致函司法委员会和管理部门，并公开呼吁政府采取行动，但在争取批准建议方面仍进展甚微。据该协会称，其于2026年1月19日致函司法委员会，要求加快程序，并在2026年9月10日的信函中再次提出此事。协会还提到在8月于塔马利举行的第二届四年一度代表会议、9月在阿克拉举行的第45届AMJG会议，以及9月在塔马利举行的首席大法官员工大会期间提出的诉求。JUSAG表示，尽管有关方面作出了保证，但始终没有采取具体行动批准建议并支付调整后的薪金。信中称：“值得注意的是，公共部门其他岗位的同事已获批准并于2026年1月收到2026年的新薪金。如今已到了今年第十个月，我们的成员仍在等待——虽然一直耐心等待，但不再默默忍受。”该协会表示，延迟尤其令人担忧，因为有组织的劳工目前已在就2027年基本工资进行谈判，而司法部门员工尚未收到经审查的2026年基本工资和津贴。JUSAG警告称，长期的不确定性削弱了新法律框架下薪酬确定原则的落实。JUSAG表示，鉴于工业行动可能影响司法工作和国家安全，该协会此前曾敦促成员保持克制，同时继续与管理部门和政府交涉。然而，它表示成员所承受的困境已经十分严重，耐心也已耗尽。因此，该协会全国执行委员会提出两项要求：10月底前批准司法委员会关于2026年薪酬审查的建议，并在11月支付调整后的薪金，同时补发1月至10月的欠款。JUSAG警告称，如果截至2026年11月1日星期日仍未满足上述要求，该协会将从11月2日星期一开始无限期罢工，直至要求得到满足。该通知还抄送给总统办公室、司法部门秘书、总检察长兼司法部长、财政部长，以及就业、劳工和雇佣关系部长。

https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/a.title: A leadership deficit in the military
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/a.summary: This Hindutva-isation of the military is not new. Military audiences in New Delhi are no longer surprised when government-affiliated speakers pepper their speeches with Sanskrit shlokas . After the mass slaughter of World War I, a disillusioned British citizenry popularised the phrase “lions led by donkeys” to describe their military’s performance.
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/a.summary_zh: 军队的印度教化并非新现象。新德里的军队听众如今已不再感到意外，政府关联的演讲者经常在讲话中穿插梵文颂诗。第一次世界大战造成大规模屠杀后，幻灭的英国民众开始流行“由驴子领衔的狮子”这句话，以形容本国军队的表现。
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/a.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Last July, at a seminar in New Delhi on atmanirbharta, the then maintenance chief of the Indian Air Force (IAF), Air Marshal Sanjiv Ghuratia, delivered an address that contained, as one person in the audience reported “more Sanskrit than English or Hindi”. Another attendee wondered who Mr. Ghuratia was speaking to; the entrepreneurs and engineers in the audience or to the Sangh Parivar members who needed a demonstration of his Hindu credentials. For generals, admirals or air marshals looking for post-retirement employment, Hindutva pays. Last month, Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, who masterminded Operation Sindoor as the Western Air Command chief, was rewarded with the plum job of running the Ram Janmbhoomi temple . Nothing an IAF pilot learns during his career equips him for such a delicate job in such a volatile environment. This Hindutva-isation of the military is not new. On May 13, 2025 at a crucial IAF media briefing on Operation Sindoor, the IAF’s operations chief, Air Marshall A.K. Bharti, invoked the Ramayan. His briefing commenced with militaristic Hindutva overtones, the Shiva Tandava Stotram delivered in rock concert style. Military audiences in New Delhi are no longer surprised when government-affiliated speakers pepper their speeches with Sanskrit shlokas . For no apparent reason, the IAF appears to be more Sanskrit-ised than the other two services. One wag at a recent seminar commented, “it might be because they serve closer to God.” However, not every soldier is comfortable with overt displays of Hindutva. One can detect the growing disillusionment of juniors with seniors who are taking the Hindutva route to the top. After the mass slaughter of World War I, a disillusioned British citizenry popularised the phrase “lions led by donkeys” to describe their military’s performance. This encapsulated their resentment against incompetent generals who let down British soldiers by committing units into attacks that were certain to fail. This is not yet the case with the Indian military, which, as an institution, continues to enjoy the respect of the public. However on-going controversies have exacerbated murmurs among junior officers that the brass looks out only for themselves. On the other hand, generals express disappointment over the “poor quality” of young officers. There is a growing disconnect between the ends of the rank pyramid; between the lions and the donkeys. Of the greatest concern is the growing “zero error syndrome” amongst senior Indian commanders. As was seen when the Chinese intruded into Ladakh in 2020, Indian commanders shrank from immediate offensive action. Instead, of creating deterrence by displaying aggression and risk-taking ability, the modern Indian general opts to defend vulnerabilities, underscoring weakness that is echoed by commanders down the line. It is not that operational boldness has blighted many careers. In the instances where Indian generals displayed conspicuous aggression against China — as in Nathu La in 1967, Sumdorong Chu in 1986, Doklam in 2017 and in the occupation of the Kailash Range in Ladakh in 2020-21 — the commanders in charge were praised, not castigated. Contemporary conflict presents numerous examples of weaker forces stalemating, and even defeating stronger ones. Ukraine battles on against Russia, while Iran is standing up to the U.S. and Israel. The intangibles that boost their power are a mix of psychological factors. Soldiers thrive on emotional strength, belief in one’s own moral superiority, seeing justice in one’s own cause, fairness in processes and methods, and the conviction that soldierly skills will prevail over sycophancy. These moral factors are essential to national power. Even in these communally polarised times, India’s military brass has the leeway to disagree with elected governments. To uphold their convictions, they should be ready to pay the price. No better example exists than the tussle between U.S. President Harry Truman and his commander in Korea, General Douglas MacArthur. Truman wanted a “limited war”, to avoid triggering a massive Soviet or Chinese intervention. MacArthur wanted an aggressive expansion of the war into China. Truman dismissed MacArthur in 1951, citing that elected leaders, and not military generals, decide foreign policy. MacArthur returned from Korea, an American hero. There is something gravely flawed with our leadership training. Many young officers start out as gallant captains and majors. Why then, when they become generals, admirals and air marshals do so many fail to seize the moment? military equipment / armed Forces / defence equipment / defence Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 订阅还可解锁优质报道、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可享用这些内容。去年7月，在新德里一场关于“自我依赖”的研讨会上，时任印度空军（IAF） maintenance chief——空军元帅桑吉夫·古拉蒂亚——发表了一场演讲。一名与会者称，演讲中的内容“梵文多于英语或印地语”。另一名与会者则 wondered，古拉蒂亚先生究竟是在对谁说话：是对台下的企业家和工程师，还是对那些需要他证明自己印度教教徒身份的印度教志愿服务团（Sangh Parivar）成员？

对于寻求退休后就业的将军、海军上将或空军元帅来说，印度教民族主义（Hindutva）会带来回报。上个月，曾以西空军司令部 chief 身份策划“辛杜尔行动”的空军元帅吉特endra·米什拉获授管理拉姆·詹莫布米神庙这一肥差。IAF 飞行员在其职业生涯中学到的任何技能，都无法使他们胜任在如此动荡的环境中管理这样一座敏感的神庙。

军队这种 Hindutva 化并非新现象。2025年5月13日，在有关“辛杜尔行动”的一次重要 IAF 媒体简报会上，IAF 行动负责人 A.K. 巴特里空军元帅援引了《罗摩衍那》。他的简报以带有军事色彩的 Hindutva 开场，以摇滚音乐会式的演绎吟唱《湿婆坦达瓦赞美诗》。

如今，新德里的军事受众看到与政府有关联的演讲者在讲话中穿插梵文诗句时，已不再感到惊讶。不知为何，IAF 似乎比另外两个军种更加“梵文化”。最近一场研讨会上有人打趣说：“这或许是因为他们离上帝更近。”不过，并非每名军人都愿意公开展示 Hindutva。

人们可以察觉，初级军官对那些借助 Hindutva 路线一路升至高位的上级日益失望。第一次世界大战的大规模屠杀之后，幻灭的英国民众流行起“由驴带领的狮子”这句话，以描述其军队的表现。这概括了他们对无能将领的不满：这些将领明知部队注定会失败，仍将其投入进攻，令英国士兵失望。

印度军队尚未出现这种情况，作为一个机构，它目前仍享有公众尊重。不过，持续不断的争议加剧了初级军官中的不满情绪，他们认为高级将领只顾着照顾自己。另一方面，将领们也对年轻军官的“素质低下”表示失望。等级金字塔的两端之间，即“狮子”与“驴”之间，正出现日益扩大的脱节。

最令人担忧的是，印度高级指挥官中日益严重的“零失误综合征”。2020年中国进入拉达克地区时便可看出这一点，印度指挥官回避立即采取进攻行动。现代印度将军没有通过展示进攻性和冒险能力来形成威慑，而是选择防守自身弱点，凸显了这种软弱，而下级指挥官也流露着同样的情绪。

并不是说行动上的大胆会给许多职业生涯蒙上阴影。在印度将领对中国表现出明显进攻性的几次事件中——例如1967年的乃堆拉山口、1986年的桑多隆朱、2017年的多克lam，以及2020至2021年对拉达克凯拉什山脉的占领——负责指挥的将领都受到赞扬，而非受到惩罚。

当代冲突提供了众多以较弱力量拖住、甚至击败较强力量的例子。乌克兰继续与俄罗斯作战，伊朗则顶住美国和以色列。提升这些国家实力的无形因素，是多种心理因素的混合。军人依靠情感力量茁壮成长，相信自身道德上更为优越，认为自己的事业正义，笃信程序与方法公平，并确信军事技能将胜过阿谀奉承。这些道德因素是国家力量的重要组成部分。

即便在社区两极分化的当下，印度军队高层仍有空间对民选政府表达异议。为了坚守自己的信念，他们应准备付出代价。没有比美国总统哈里·杜鲁门与其朝鲜战场司令道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军之间的争执更好的例子了。杜鲁门希望进行“有限战争”，以避免触发苏联或中国的大规模干预；麦克阿瑟则主张把战争积极扩大到中国。1951年，杜鲁门解除了麦克阿瑟的职务，理由是外交政策应由民选领导人而非军事将领决定。麦克阿瑟从朝鲜返回，成为一位美国英雄。

我们的领导力培训存在严重缺陷。许多年轻军官起初都是英勇的上尉和少校。那么，为什么他们成为将军、海军上将和空军元帅后。如此多人未能抓住机会？
