https://www.myjoyonline.com/poets-only-s.body: Ghanaian poet and writer Nana Asaase has opened up about the dismissive comments he faced when he started his poetry career, including claims that poets and writers in Ghana could only make a living selling books from car boots. Speaking on The Career Trail programme aired on Joy Learning TV and Joy News, Nana Asaase recounted how such remarks made him question his decision to pursue poetry. “Someone once told me poets and Ghanaian writers, all they do is sell books in a car boot,” he recalled. According to the poet, the comments were discouraging, but his conviction that he was on the right path kept him going. “Sometimes when things get tough, I look into the mirror and think, why not just quit poetry and join my family business? Because we had a bakery. But something within me kept telling me I was on the right path. I shouldn’t give up, so I kept pushing,” he shared. After 12 years in poetry, Nana Asaase says his persistence has gradually paid off, with his work opening doors to opportunities he never imagined when he started. “This same job people looked down on me when I started has given me great opportunities. I have performed for presidents. All four presidents of this Fourth Republic, dead or alive, have been my audience,” he revealed. “Sometimes, somebody shows up, you don't know the person from anywhere and says, ‘Oh, I know this young man. Give this job to him.’ You do a fantastic job, meanwhile, I have not met this person,” he continued. Nana Asaase attributed his perseverance to his faith in God, saying his relationship with God remained the foundation of his journey. “Once you know your source, make sure you're at peace with your source. Mine is God. I have no shady dealings backing me,” he noted. He also highlighted discipline and consistency as important to developing and sustaining a career in poetry. “There's no magic. Practice, practice, practice. As I'm sitting here, I'm practicing. When I drive, I practice. When I eat, I practice. When I have conversations, I practice,” he said. After 12 years in poetry, Nana Asaase is preparing to release his first book this year. “By God's grace, I'm releasing my first book this year, and I will not sell my book out of a car boot. My books will be sold all over the world on very prominent counters,” he disclosed with excitement. And having experienced the challenges of building a career in poetry, Nana Asaase is also using his Sankofa Sessions, which include the Mental Pictures initiative, to nurture other talents and encourage a greater appreciation for literary arts, storytelling, oratory and self-expression
https://www.myjoyonline.com/poets-only-s.title_zh: “诗人只从汽车后备箱卖书”——Nana Asaase讲述诗歌生涯中遭受的轻视
https://www.myjoyonline.com/poets-only-s.body_zh: 加纳诗人兼作家纳纳·阿萨亚斯讲述了自己刚开始诗歌创作时遭到贬低评论的经历，其中包括有人声称，加纳的诗人和作家只能靠从汽车后备箱里卖书维持生计。在Joy Learning TV和Joy News播出的《职业之路》节目中，纳纳·阿萨亚斯回忆说，这些言论一度让他怀疑自己选择诗歌创作是否正确。他回忆道：“曾经有人对我说，诗人和加纳作家所做的全部事情，就是在汽车后备箱里卖书。”据这位诗人表示，这些评论令人气馁，但他坚信自己走在正确的道路上，因此坚持了下来。他分享道：“有时候，当事情变得艰难时，我会照着镜子想，为什么不干脆放弃诗歌，加入家里的生意？因为我们家里有一家面包店。但我内心有某种声音一直告诉我，自己走在正确的道路上。我不应该放弃，所以我继续努力。”从事诗歌创作12年后，纳纳·阿萨亚斯表示，自己的坚持逐渐得到了回报，作品为他打开了起初始料未及的机会。他透露：“刚开始时，人们瞧不起的这份工作，为我带来了许多机会。我曾为总统们表演。这个第四共和国的四位总统，无论已经去世还是健在，都曾是我的观众。”他继续说道：“有时候，有人突然出现，你根本不认识他，却会说：‘哦，我认识这个年轻人。把这份工作交给他吧。’你把事情做得非常出色，而这时我甚至还没见过这个人。”纳纳·阿萨亚斯将自身的坚韧归功于对上帝的信仰，称自己与上帝的关系始终是这段人生历程的根基。他指出：“一旦你知道了自己的源头，就要确保自己与源头和谐相处。我的源头就是上帝。没有任何见不得人的勾当在支持我。”他还强调，纪律和坚持对于培养并维持诗歌事业至关重要。他说：“这里没有什么魔法。练习、练习、再练习。我坐在这里时就在练习，开车时在练习，吃饭时在练习，与人交谈时也在练习。”从事诗歌创作12年后，纳纳·阿萨亚斯正准备在今年出版他的第一本书。他兴奋地透露：“承蒙上帝恩典，我将在今年出版第一本书，而且我不会从汽车后备箱里卖书。我的书将在世界各地最显眼的柜台出售。”在经历建立诗歌事业的挑战之后，纳纳·阿萨亚斯还通过其Sankofa Sessions（包括Mental Pictures倡议）培养其他人才，并推动人们更加欣赏文学艺术、故事讲述、演讲和自我表达

https://www.politico.eu/article/european.body: PARIS — Top European defense ministers and EU representatives said Ukraine faces challenging months ahead, insisting they must keep supporting Kyiv despite the U.S. bid for talks with Russia. Kallas, along with European Commissioner for Defence and Space Andrius Kubilius, joined a meeting with defense ministers from the E5 group made up of France, the U.K., Germany, Poland and Italy, hosted at the French armed forces ministry. The meeting came amid a renewed U.S. effort to push Ukraine into peace talks with Russia and growing doubts about Washington's support for Kyiv. U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff said last week he would offer Russia's Vladimir Putin direct talks with President Donald Trump and Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy to secure a ceasefire. "No results whatsoever comes for those who want to negotiate with Putin," German defense minister Boris Pistoripus said. "The results are what? It doesn't lead to anything. https://www.politico.eu/article/european.body_zh: 巴黎——欧洲多国国防部长及欧盟代表表示，乌克兰未来数月将面临严峻挑战；尽管美国试图推动与俄罗斯谈判，他们仍坚持必须继续支持基辅。欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯与欧盟国防与太空事务委员安德柳斯·库布柳斯一同参加了由法国武装部队部承办的E5集团国防部长会议。E5集团由法国、英国、德国、波兰和意大利组成。此次会议召开之际，美国正加大 efforts 推动乌克兰与俄罗斯展开和平谈判，华盛顿对基辅的支持也日益受到质疑。美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫上周表示，他将促成俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与唐纳德·特朗普总统及乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基直接会谈，以实现停火。德国国防部长博里斯·皮斯托里普斯说：“任何想要与普京谈判的人都得不到任何结果。”“结果是什么？这种做法不会带来任何成果。完全没有迹象表明普京在寻求和平。”英国卫生与社会关怀大臣韦斯·斯特里廷补充说：“虽然我们当中没有人寻求与俄罗斯对抗……但我们必须意识到俄罗斯构成的威胁。”法国代表卡特琳·沃特兰在对美国承诺“完全透明”的同时表示，E5成员国将“开展具体合作”，重点推进武器生产和互操作性。沃特兰说：“多生产，加快生产，生产适合当今冲突的装备——但我们必须提前规划明天的冲突。”“在这方面，欧盟的财政举措可以帮助我们朝这个方向迈进。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/teacher-trai.body: The Teacher Trainees’ Association of Ghana (TTAG) has attributed delays in the payment of allowances to students at three colleges of education to outstanding clearance requirements. According to the association, Savannah College of Education, Christ the Teacher College of Education and Ghana Muslim Mission College of Education have yet to receive the necessary clearance to facilitate payment. In a statement issued on Monday, October 26, TTAG said its leadership had engaged the Student Loan Trust Fund (SLTF) following complaints from trainees who did not receive their allowances during the recent disbursement. “It was identified that clearance had not been granted for Savannah College of Education, Christ the Teacher College of Education, and Ghana Muslim Mission College of Education,” the statement explained. The association further disclosed that trainees of Al-Faruq College of Education who missed the recent disbursement are expected to receive their allowances before the end of October 2026. TTAG consequently urged students across the country's 49 public colleges of education to verify their registration details and Ghana Commercial Bank (GCB) account status to avoid further payment delays. “All trainees are encouraged to verify their registration details and Ghana Commercial Bank (GCB) account status and promptly rectify any errors or outstanding requirements to facilitate payment happening any moment from now,” the statement said. The association assured affected trainees that it would continue engaging the SLTF and other relevant stakeholders to resolve outstanding payment challenges. It reiterated its commitment to ensuring that all eligible trainees receive their allowances as soon as possible

https://www.myjoyonline.com/from-knust-t.body: Dr Daniel Baba Abiliba has become the first Ghana-trained veterinarian to enrol at the Yale School of the Environment (YSE). He is also the first Ghanaian to receive the MSD Animal Health/World Veterinary Association (WVA) Veterinary Student Scholarship. "KNUST and its social environment gave me my foundation. Everything I bring to Yale, I learned first in Ghana, in our classrooms, on our farms and from our farmers," Dr Abiliba remarked. In 2018, while pursuing his studies at the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), Dr Abiliba received the MSD/WVA Veterinary Student Scholarship. The international scholarship recognises veterinary students who demonstrate outstanding leadership and dedication to the profession. "Receiving that scholarship reaffirmed that the work we are doing in Ghana has a place on the global stage. This inspired me to pursue greater ambitions, ultimately leading me to the Yale School of the Environment. It also instilled in me a sense of responsibility to pave the way for the next generation of students," he said. He obtained his Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree from the KNUST School of Veterinary Medicine in 2022. At Yale, Dr Abiliba is studying the intersection of food systems, public health and the environment. His work draws on the One Health approach, which recognises that the health of people, animals and ecosystems is closely interconnected. "How we raise animals affects the land, the water and our own health. Veterinarians have an important role to play in environmental decision-making, and I want to help bring that perspective into the rooms where decisions are made," he said. Before joining Yale, Dr Abiliba founded the Animal Welfare League (AWL), a non-profit organisation focused on improving farmed animal welfare in Ghana and across Africa. Dr Abiliba hopes his journey will encourage Ghanaian veterinary students to explore broader career opportunities beyond traditional veterinary practice. "Veterinary medicine is not only about treating sick animals, it is about food security, disease prevention, and protecting the environment we all depend on. The next generation of Ghanaian vets can lead in all of these spaces," Dr Abiliba said. He credits his family, particularly his parents, and his mentors at the KNUST School of Veterinary Medicine for supporting him throughout his journey
https://www.myjoyonline.com/from-knust-t.title_zh: 从KNUST到Yale：加纳兽医学者在耶鲁大学环境学院创造历史
https://www.myjoyonline.com/from-knust-t.body_zh: 丹尼尔·巴巴·阿比利巴博士成为首位在耶鲁大学环境学院（YSE）就读的加纳本土培养兽医。他也是首位获得MSD动物健康/世界兽医协会（WVA）兽医学生奖学金的加纳人。阿比利巴博士表示：“KNUST及其社会环境为我的成长奠定了基础。我带到耶鲁的一切，最初都是在加纳学习的，来自我们的课堂、我们的农场以及我们的农民。”2018年，阿比利巴博士在夸梅·恩克鲁玛科技大学（KNUST）攻读学业期间，获得MSD/WVA兽医学生奖学金。这项国际奖学金表彰那些展现出卓越领导力并对兽医事业高度奉献的兽医学生。他说：“获得该奖学金再次印证了我们在加纳开展的工作能够在全球舞台上占据一席之地。这激励我追求更宏大的理想，并最终引领我来到耶鲁大学环境学院。它也让我萌生了一种责任意识，要为下一代学生铺平道路。”2022年，他从KNUST兽医学院取得兽医学博士学位。在耶鲁，阿比利巴博士研究食物系统、公共卫生与环境之间的交叉领域。他的工作借鉴“同一健康”理念，该理念承认人类、动物和生态系统的健康彼此密切相关。他说：“我们饲养动物的方式会影响土地、水资源以及我们自身的健康。兽医在环境决策中发挥着重要作用，我希望帮助将这一视角带入作出决策的各个场合。”加入耶鲁之前，阿比利巴博士创立了动物福利联盟（AWL），这是一个致力于改善加纳及全非洲养殖动物福利的非营利组织。阿比利巴博士希望自己的经历能够鼓励加纳兽医学生探索传统兽医执业之外的更广阔职业机会。他说：“兽医学不仅仅是治疗患病动物，还涉及粮食安全、疾病预防，以及保护我们共同依赖的环境。下一代加纳兽医能够在所有这些领域发挥领导作用。”他将自己的整个求学和成长历程归功于家人，尤其是父母，以及KNUST兽医学院导师们的支持。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title: Under Buhari, Tinubu, Cash Transfer Office failed to identify beneficiaries of N33.75 billion
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary: The National Cash Transfer Office (NCTO) reported paying N33.75 billion to 3.29 million households and beneficiaries across 35 states in 2023 but failed to provide complete records identifying the recipients. However, the payment vouchers did not contain complete details of the beneficiaries, the audit report said.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 国家现金转移办公室（NCTO）报告称，2023年向35个州的329万户家庭和受益者支付了337.5亿奈拉，却未能提供用于确认受款人的完整记录。审计报告称，支付凭证也没有载明受益人的完整信息。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: The National Cash Transfer Office (NCTO) reported paying N33.75 billion to 3.29 million households and beneficiaries across 35 states in 2023 but failed to provide complete records identifying the recipients. The agency’s accounts staff also denied auditors access to bank statements needed to verify the payments, according to analysis of the Auditor General of the Federation’s latest report by the UDEME project of the Centre for Journalism Innovation and Development (CJID). The finding is one of eight audit queries against the NCTO in the auditor general’s 2024 Annual Report on Non-compliance and Internal Control Weaknesses in MDAs, covering the period from 1 January to 31 December 2023. NCTO did not respond to some of the audit queries, and in the cases they responded to, the auditor found their response to be unsatisfactory. The auditor general consequently said the findings remained valid until the commission implemented the recommendations. The NCTO runs the conditional cash transfer component of the National Social Safety Nets Project, a World Bank-financed programme that provides payments to poor households identified on the National Social Register. The office operates under the National Social Investment Programme Agency, which reports to the Federal Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction. The transfers happened under former Ministers Sadiya Farouk (under the Muhammadu Buhari presidency) and Betta Edu (under the Bola Tinubu presidency), who headed the ministry at different times in 2023. The programme’s operations came under scrutiny in January 2024 when President Bola Tinubu suspended the agency’s chief executive, Halima Shehu, over alleged financial misappropriation. Ms Shehu had previously served as national coordinator of the conditional cash transfer programme. Ten days later, Mr Tinubu suspended all four programmes run by the agency for an initial six weeks, citing “operational lapses and improprieties surrounding payments to the programme beneficiaries”. Paragraph 613 of the Financial Regulations 2009 requires payments to be made only to the persons named in payment vouchers or their properly authorised representatives. Paragraph 603(i) also requires vouchers to contain full particulars of the services provided so they can be checked without reference to other documents. The NCTO reported making electronic transfers totalling N33.75 billion to 3.2 million households and beneficiaries across 35 states in 2023. However, the payment vouchers did not contain complete details of the beneficiaries, the audit report said. The office also failed to present the Remita statement that would have enabled auditors to compare the payments with the beneficiaries listed on the National Social Register and establish who actually received the funds. The auditors said the missing statement prevented them from authenticating the payments and determining whether the recipients were genuine beneficiaries. “All efforts to obtain access to the REMITA statement were obstructed and denied by NCTO accounts staff, thereby frustrating the audit process,” the auditor general said. He warned that the failure to verify the payments exposed public funds to the risk of loss and raised the possibility that ineligible or fictitious persons had received the money. The auditor general recommended that the National Programme Manager, Abdullahi Imam, be required to account for the N33.75 billion and recover and remit the amount to the Treasury. He also directed that evidence showing that the beneficiaries received the funds be submitted to the Public Accounts Committees of the National Assembly. Failure to comply could attract sanctions under paragraph 3106 of the Financial Regulations, the report said. In another query, the report identified 215 payment vouchers totalling N36.74 billion for “SS, IDA & output base” transactions in December 2023 that were paid without internal audit checks or prepayment audits. None of the 215 vouchers underwent the required checks before payment. Instead, the Internal Audit Unit examined them after the payments had been made, contrary to the regulations, the auditors found. The report noted that the World Bank’s November 2021 Project Appraisal Document for the programme’s scale-up provided for the Internal Audit Unit to conduct compliance and operational audits without adopting a prepayment audit system. The auditor general nevertheless said the practice contravened Nigeria’s Financial Regulations. He recommended that the N36.74 billion be fully accounted for and recovered, with those responsible sanctioned for gross misconduct under paragraph 3129 of the regulations. The auditors also found that the NCTO made 101 payments totalling ₦4.62 billion from the “S&S/IDA Cash Book,” without presenting the corresponding payment vouchers for examination. The absence of the vouchers prevented the auditors from verifying the payments and the expenditures they were intended to cover. The report said this breached Section 85(2) of the Constitution, which provides for the auditor general’s access to public account records. It also contravened paragraph 601 of the Financial Regulations, which states that “under no circumstances shall a cheque be raised or cash paid for services for which a voucher has not been raised.” The auditors warned that the missing records exposed public funds to misapplication and diversion. They recommended that the entire N4.62 billion be recovered from the NCTO. The auditors further identified 32 payments totalling N3.09 billion from the “NASSP SCALE-UP Cash Book” to states for the enrolment of unbanked, poor and vulnerable households. Although the NCTO presented documents covering N2.74 billion disbursed to 34 states, N350.18 million remained unaccounted for, according to the report. The auditors also faulted the supporting vouchers, describing them as vague and inadequate to establish how the funds were used or which activities they financed. The records lacked beneficiary lists, photographs of enrolment exercises, signed attendance registers, activity reports and the names of people who received payments during the exercises, the report said. In a separate query, the auditors examined N393.71 million that nine State Cash Transfer Units reportedly returned to the Treasury in 2023 after failing to conduct enrolment exercises. The NCTO attributed the failure to “insecurity, disasters, and other factors”. However, the office did not provide Remita inflow statements or payment slips showing that the refunds had been credited to the Consolidated Revenue Fund. It also failed to provide evidence that the affected states subsequently enrolled the intended beneficiaries. The NCTO paid N280.42 million to payment service providers as a 30 per cent advance for implementing a “last-mile solution” for beneficiaries, the report said. The payments were made without advance payment guarantees, contrary to Section 71 of the Finance Act 2020, which requires such guarantees for mobilisation fees. The auditors also found no evidence that the providers were selected through due process. Their contract files lacked prequalification documents, bidding records and technical and financial evaluations to justify the selections and payments. Across the eight queries, the Auditor-General called for the NCTO’s National Programme Manager to account for the funds in question, recover and remit the amounts due to the Treasury, and submit evidence of the remittances to the Public Accounts Committee of the National Assembly. The report cites paragraph 3106 of the Financial Regulations, which gives an officer responsible for an irregular payment 21 days to explain the transaction before the amount may be recovered personally from the officer and the officer removed from the schedule. It also cites paragraph 3129, which provides for sanctions for gross misconduct. In its broader analysis, the report ranked the NCTO first among federal agencies flagged for making payments without supporting documents, failing to conduct prepayment audits and failing to present paid vouchers for examination. In March 2026, Mr Imam, the NCTO’s programme manager, said the cash transfer initiative had increased its target from 10.4 million to 15 million beneficiaries. Worried about the auditor general’s report, the Socio-Economic Rights and Accountability Project (SERAP) sued the federal government at the ECOWAS Community Court of Justice over the alleged diversion, irregular expenditure and failure to account for ₦78.8 billion allocated to cash-transfer and social-protection programmes. In the suit, filed last week, SERAP is seeking an order compelling the government to account for the funds and ensure proper financial oversight of programmes meant to support vulnerable households. The suit follows concerns raised by SERAP over findings involving the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, the National Cash Transfer Office (NCTO) and the National Social Safety Nets Coordinating Office (NASSCO). The group has called for investigations into ₦76.24 billion in questionable and unaccounted-for expenditure at NCTO and ₦2.55 billion at NASSCO, as well as the recovery of any funds found to have been misappropriated. In September, SERAP had urged President Bola Tinubu to direct the relevant agencies to account for the funds, including ₦33.751 billion in 2023 cash transfers for which it said beneficiary records and payment documentation should be published. It also called for explanations for payments made without prepayment audits, unsupported expenditure and other questionable transactions
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: Buhari执政时期，Tinubu的现金转移办公室未能查明335亿奈拉资金的受益人
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh:
国家现金转移办公室（NCTO）报告称，2023年向35个州的329万户家庭和受益者支付了N33.75 billion，但未提供能够识别收款人的完整记录。据新闻创新与发展中心（CJID）UDEME项目对联邦审计长最新报告的分析，该机构的账目人员还拒绝审计人员查阅核实付款所需的银行对账单。审计长在其《2024年度政府机构不合规与内部控制薄弱情况报告》中针对NCTO提出八项审计质询，这是其中之一；报告涵盖2023年1月1日至12月31日。NCTO没有回应其中一些审计质询，而对于作出回应的质询，审计人员认为其答复不能令人满意。因此，审计长表示，在委员会落实相关建议之前，这些审计发现仍然有效。

NCTO负责国家社会安全网项目下设的条件现金转移部分。该项目由世界银行资助，向列入国家社会登记册的贫困家庭支付款项。该办公室隶属于国家社会投资计划署，而该计划署向联邦人道事务与减贫部报告。相关款项是在前部长Sadiya Farouk（在穆罕马杜·布哈里总统任内）和Betta Edu（在博拉·蒂努布总统任内）任内发放的，两人曾于2023年不同时段主持该部工作。

2024年1月，该项目的运作受到审查。当时，博拉·蒂努布总统因涉嫌挪用公款，暂停了该机构首席执行官Halima Shehu的职务。Shehu女士此前曾担任条件现金转移项目全国协调员。10天后，蒂努布先生暂停了该机构负责的全部四个项目，初始期限为6周，理由是“为项目受益者付款存在运营失误和相关不当行为”。

《2009年财务条例》第613段规定，只能向付款凭证上列明的人员或其获正式授权的代表付款。第603(i)段还要求付款凭证载明所提供服务的完整详情，以便无需查阅其他文件即可进行核查。

NCTO报告称，2023年通过电子转账向35个州的320万户家庭和受益者支付了合计N33.75 billion。然而，审计报告称，这些付款凭证没有载明受益者的完整资料。该办公室也未提交Remita对账单，因而审计人员无法将付款与国家社会登记册所列受益者进行比对，也无法确定实际收到资金的人。审计人员表示，缺少该对账单使其无法核实付款，也无法判断收款人是否为真正的受益者。

审计长表示：“NCTO账目人员阻碍并拒绝提供查阅REMITA对账单的一切努力，导致审计工作无法进行。”他警告称，未能核实付款使公共资金面临损失风险，也不排除不符合资格或虚构人员收取资金的可能性。审计长建议责成全国项目负责人Abdullahi Imam对N33.75 billion作出说明，追回并上缴该款项。他还要求向国民议会公共账户委员会提交证据，证明受益者已收到相关资金。报告称，未遵守相关要求可能依据《财务条例》第3106段受到制裁。

在另一项质询中，报告认定，2023年12月“SS, IDA & output base”交易的215张付款凭证涉及N36.74 billion，这些款项在未经内部审计核查或付款前审计的情况下即已支付。审计人员发现，这215张凭证在付款前均未接受规定核查。相反，内部审计单位是在款项支付完毕后才对其进行审查，违反了相关条例。报告指出，世界银行2021年11月为扩大项目规模发布的项目评估文件规定，由内部审计单位开展合规和运营审计，并未要求建立付款前审计制度。尽管如此，审计长仍表示这种做法违反尼日利亚《财务条例》。他建议对N36.74 billion进行完整说明并予以追回，同时依据相关条例第3129段对责任人以严重失职行为予以制裁。

审计人员还发现，NCTO从“S&S/IDA Cash Book”支付了101笔款项，总额为₦4.62 billion，但未提交相应付款凭证供审查。缺少付款凭证使审计人员无法核实付款及其拟涵盖的支出。报告称，这违反了《宪法》第85(2)项关于审计长有权查阅公共账户记录的规定，也违反了《财务条例》第601段，即“在任何情况下，未开具付款凭证的服务，均不得签发支票或以现金支付”。审计人员警告称，缺失记录使公共资金面临被挪用和转移 diversion 的风险。他们建议从NCTO追回全部N4.62 billion。

审计人员进一步认定，NCTO从“NASSP SCALE-UP Cash Book”向各州支付了32笔款项，总额N3.09 billion，用于无银行账户的贫困和弱势家庭登记。尽管NCTO提交了涵盖向34个州拨付N2.74 billion的文件，但据报告，仍有N350.18 million去向不明。审计人员还批评了支持性付款凭证，称其内容含糊且不充分，无法确定资金用途或所资助的活动。报告称，这些记录缺少受益者名单、登记活动照片、签名的出席登记册、活动报告，以及在登记活动中收到付款人员的姓名。

在另一项质询中，审计人员核查了据称9个州现金转移单位在未能开展登记活动后于2023年退回国库 treasury 的N393.71 million。NCTO将未能开展登记活动归因于“治安不稳、灾害和其他因素”。然而，该办公室没有提供Remita入账对账单或付款单据，证明退款已计入统一收入基金，也未提供证据证明相关州此后登记了原定受益者。

报告称，NCTO向支付服务提供商支付了N280.42 million，作为为受益者实施“最后一公里解决方案”的30%预付款。这些付款没有预付款担保，违反了《2020年财政法》第71项关于动员费必须提供担保的规定。审计人员还发现，没有证据表明这些提供商是通过适当程序选定的。其合同档案缺少资格预审文件、投标记录以及技术和财务评估结果，无法证明遴选和付款的合理性。

在八项质询中，审计长要求NCTO全国项目负责人对相关资金作出说明，追回并上缴应付国库的款项，并将上缴凭证提交国民议会公共账户委员会。报告援引《财务条例》第3106段，该段规定，对负责违规付款的工作人员给予21天时间解释交易，之后可向该工作人员个人追回款项，并将其从薪资发放名单中除名。报告还援引第3129段，该段规定对严重失职行为予以制裁。

在更广泛的分析中，报告将NCTO列为联邦机构之首，指出其在没有支持文件、未开展付款前审计以及未提交已付款凭证供审查等方面受到点名。2026年3月，NCTO项目负责人Imam先生表示，现金转移计划已将目标受益者数量从1,040万提高至1,500万。

鉴于对审计长报告的担忧，社会经济权利与问责项目（SERAP）就涉嫌转移挪用资金、不合规支出以及未能说明分配给现金转移和社会保护计划的₦78.8 billion，向西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）共同体司法法院起诉联邦政府。SERAP上周提交起诉书，要求法院下令强制政府说明资金情况，并确保对旨在支持弱势家庭的计划实施适当的财务监督。

该诉讼源于SERAP此前对涉及人道事务与减贫部、国家现金转移办公室（NCTO）以及国家社会安全网协调办公室（NASSCO）的调查结果提出关切。该组织要求调查NCTO的₦76.24 billion可疑且去向不明的支出，以及NASSCO的₦2.55 billion可疑且去向不明的支出，并追回任何被查明遭挪用或转移 diversion 的资金。9月，SERAP曾敦促博拉·蒂努布总统指示相关机构说明资金情况，其中包括2023年现金转移的₦33.751 billion，并称应公布受益者记录和付款文件。SERAP还要求解释未经过付款前审计即支付的款项、无凭据支持的支出及其他可疑交易

https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.title: Why inclusion is key to the RTE Act
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.summary: A study of nine mid-to-high-cost Delhi private schools revealed that inclusion is rarely black-and-white; structural nourishment plays out differently for each child, but success stories consistently emerge where inclusion is a core institutional value. Conversely, schools with conscious structural intent cultivate an ‘invisible inclusion’. Authentic inclusion does not require massive additional material or financial resources.
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.summary_zh: 对德里 9 所中高成本私立学校的一项研究显示，融合很少是非黑即白的；结构性滋养对每个孩子产生的作用各不相同，但在将融合视为核心机构价值观的地方，成功案例始终不断出现。相反，具有明确结构性办学的学校会培育一种“无形融合”。真正的融合并不需要大量额外物资或资金。
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription E very morning, 10-year-old Ria walks from her working-class Delhi neighbourhood to a premium private school with quiet pride. As her friends head to a government school, Ria continues her longer walk, feeling lucky to have won a free seat under the Right to Education (RTE) Act quota. Yet, inside the school gates, a transformation occurs. Her stride becomes subdued, and she quietly slips into a back-row seat. For the rest of the day, she and a fellow quota student operate in survival mode: meticulously copying notes while avoiding the teacher’s gaze. After receiving a C-minus on a math assignment and a harsh reprimand from her teacher, she carries the disappointment for days. Her immense effort remains unseen, and her teachers label her as ‘struggling to meet grade expectations’. Across the city, Sahil, admitted to another private school through the same provision, experiences a strikingly different day. His father works as an industrial labourer and his mother takes on local domestic work. Yet his school feels inviting. His engagement has attracted teachers and peers, and his sincerity is reflected in his grades, participation in sports and confidence on the stage. Private schools object to extension of RTE Act up to class 10 for SC/ST students without amendment Ria and Sahil (names changed to protect identities) secured free seats via Section 12(1)(c) of the RTE Act, 2009 to drive social cohesion. The provision provides access to 50 lakh disadvantaged students to private schools nationwide via a mandatory 25% classroom quota. However, mere entry alone does not guarantee social integration. While many face low grades and class-based alienation, success stories such as Sahil’s prove that intentional school practices can overcome superficial integration. Lacking an institutional blueprint for diverse classrooms, private schools must actively innovate. A study of nine mid-to-high-cost Delhi private schools revealed that inclusion is rarely black-and-white; structural nourishment plays out differently for each child, but success stories consistently emerge where inclusion is a core institutional value. In typical classrooms, RTE students often drift to the periphery, isolated by organic social segregation and low participation in collaborative tasks. Burdened and undertrained teachers frequently view them through a deficit lens, as demanding ‘more effort’, while ignoring their emotional distress. Conversely, schools with conscious structural intent cultivate an ‘invisible inclusion’. In Sahil’s school, the day begins with an empathy-driven learning circle where vulnerability is shared safely. Assigned mixed seating and a ‘zero period’ let peers collaborate on unfinished homework. Lessons rely on collaborative learning with ample scope for student-led discussions with the teacher ensuring that all students participate. While addressing an area problem, the math teacher encouraged an RTE student to share about his family’s paddy fields, which validated his lived experience. By noon, teachers co-plan support strategies, preparing for monthly open houses where parents can also exchange insights. Authentic inclusion does not require massive additional material or financial resources. It depends on consistent practices that promote equal participation, recognise diverse lived experiences, and build meaningful connections among students, teachers and families. Under Section 12(1)(c), the responsibility of fostering an inclusive classroom falls entirely on schools and teachers. Navigating this structural support forces educators to rely solely on personal motivation. In a heavily burdened system, inclusion risks becoming an afterthought. An essential tenet of educational development is that what gets measured gets valued. Inclusion remains deeply undervalued because India lacks the metrics to track it. Unlike academic performance, it never appears on a report card, yet it shapes a student’s entire journey. State governments and parent networks must collaborate to monitor benchmarks. Quality elementary teachers crucial to children, nation-building: Supreme Court Equality in society has to start in school, says Supreme Court Schools must institutionalise inclusive values through collaborative learning, rotated leadership, dignified and equitable participation of RTE students, and by supporting teachers with specialised resources. For governments, the mandate is to create enabling conditions through financial reimbursements, public recognition of inclusive schools, and cross-state feedback loops. To ensure that every Ria and Sahil can thrive, inclusion must be pursued with the same deliberate rigour, tracking, and daily practice that we dedicate to academic outcomes. https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.title_zh: 为何包容是落实RTE法案的关键
https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/w.body_zh:
除Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions等精彩内容外，订阅还可享受更多权益。每天清晨订阅后解锁这些内容。10岁的Ria走在上班族的德里社区，前往一所高端私立学校。她和朋友们不同，朋友们前往公立学校，而Ria还要走更长的路。她很幸运，因为通过《受教育权法案》（RTE Act）配额获得了免费学位。

然而，走进校门后，她发生了变化。她放轻了脚步，悄悄坐进最后一排。此后一整天，她和另一名享受配额的学生都处于“生存模式”：一丝不苟地抄笔记，同时避开老师的目光。数学作业得了C-后，她还受到严厉斥责，失望情绪持续了好几天。她付出的巨大努力无人看见，老师们将她归为“难以达到年级预期”。

在全市范围内，同样通过这项规定被另一所私立学校录取的Sahil，经历了截然不同的一天。他的父亲是工业工人，母亲承接附近的家务活。然而，他的学校让人感到亲切。他的参与吸引了老师和同学，他的真诚也体现在成绩、体育活动参与度以及舞台上的自信中。

私立学校反对在未经修订的情况下，将《受教育权法案》的适用范围延长至SC/ST学生就读的10年级。Ria和Sahil（为保护身份而更名）依据2009年《受教育权法案》第12(1)(c)条获得了免费学位，旨在促进社会融合。该条款通过强制25%的班级配额，为全国私立学校向50万名弱势学生提供入学机会。然而，仅获得入学机会并不能保证社会融合。许多学生成绩低迷，并因班级差异而遭到疏离，但Sahil等成功案例证明，有意识采取的学校措施能够克服表面上的融合。

私立学校缺乏针对多元课堂的制度化方案，因此必须积极创新。一项针对德里9所中高收费私立学校的研究显示，融合很少是非黑即白的；结构性滋养对每个孩子都有不同的表现形式，但只要融合成为核心制度价值，成功案例就会持续出现。

在普通课堂中，RTE学生常游离于边缘，因自然形成的社会隔离而陷于孤立，参与协作任务的程度也很低。负担沉重且培训不足的老师往往以缺陷视角看待他们，要求他们“付出更多努力”，却忽视他们的情绪困扰。

相比之下，具有明确结构意识的学校会培育一种“无形的融合”。在Sahil的学校，一天从以同理心驱动的学习圈开始，大家可以安全地分享各自的不安。学校安排混合座位，并设置“零时课程”，让同学协作完成尚未做完的作业。课程采用协作学习，为学生主导的讨论留出充足空间，同时确保所有学生参与。在讲解一道应用题时，数学老师鼓励一名RTE学生讲述家里的稻田，肯定了他的生活经验。

到了中午，老师们共同制定支持策略，为每月一次的开放日做准备，家长也可在开放日中交流见解。

真正的融合并不需要大量额外物资或资金，而取决于持续落实相关做法，推动平等参与，认可多样的生活经验，并在学生、老师和家庭之间建立有意义的联系。

根据第12(1)(c)条，营造包容课堂的责任完全由学校和老师承担。要驾驭这种结构性支持，教育工作者只能依靠个人动力。在负担沉重的体系中，融合很容易沦为事后才考虑的事项。

教育发展的一个基本原则是，受到衡量的事物才会受到重视。由于印度缺乏追踪融合情况的指标，融合长期未得到充分重视。与学业表现不同，融合从不会出现在成绩单上，却会影响学生的学习全程。邦政府和家长网络必须协作监督相关基准。

优质小学教师对儿童和国家建设至关重要：最高法院称，社会平等必须从学校开始。最高法院表示，学校必须通过协作学习、轮值领导、让RTE学生有尊严且公平地参与，以及为教师提供专业资源等方式，将包容价值观制度化。

对各邦政府而言，其职责是通过财政补助、公开表彰包容性学校，以及建立跨邦反馈机制，为融合创造有利条件。为了确保每一位Ria和Sahil都能茁壮成长，我们必须以追求学业成果时同样的严谨态度、追踪力度和日常实践去推动融合。

Atiku, the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, called on President Bola Tinubu and the Presidency to explain the source of funding for the vehicles, reportedly 2026 models valued at more than N150m each.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/luxu.summary_zh: 前副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔称，据报道，向全进步大会（APC）青年领袖分发豪华运动型多用途车，是对比喻饥饿、生活成本不断上涨的尼日利亚人的侮辱。阿蒂库是非洲民主大会（ADC）的总统候选人，他呼吁总统博拉·蒂努布和总统府解释这些车辆的经费来源。据称，这些车辆是2026年款，每辆价值超过1.5亿奈拉。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/luxu.body: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has described the reported distribution of luxury sport utility vehicles to All Progressives Congress (APC) youth leaders as an insult to Nigerians grappling with hunger and rising living costs. Atiku, the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, called on President Bola Tinubu and the Presidency to explain the source of funding for the vehicles, reportedly 2026 models valued at more than N150m each. In a statement on Monday issued by Phrank Shaibu, Director of Strategic Communication of the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Atiku questioned the reported donation of the vehicles by First Lady Oluremi Tinubu, saying Nigerians deserved to know who paid for them. “The APC National Youth Leader says these vehicles were donated by First Lady Oluremi Tinubu. Nigerians deserve to know where the money came from to buy and distribute so many 2026 model SUVs, each worth more than N150 million, for political mobilisation,” he said. Atiku asked whether the vehicles were purchased with the First Lady’s personal funds, donations or public resources, demanding that the Presidency disclose the total cost and source of the money. “The First Lady holds no elected or executive office. She is only a domestic appendage of the office of President. Were these vehicles bought with her personal funds, donations or public resources? Who paid for them? What was the total cost? The Presidency must provide a clear account,” the former vice-president said. He argued that the reported gifts were inappropriate at a time when many Nigerians were struggling to afford food, transportation and other basic necessities. “At a time families cannot afford food, transport and other basic necessities, these gifts are a brazen insult to the people. The government has found a way to provide luxury SUVs for APC youth leaders, yet millions of Nigerians are still waiting for meaningful relief from the cost of living crisis,” he said. Atiku also questioned the timing of the reported vehicle distribution, alleging that APC women leaders had previously received luxury vehicles and that the earlier gifts came shortly before the abduction of schoolchildren in Oyo State. He said the latest reported distribution raised concerns about the government’s spending priorities amid economic hardship and insecurity. “While Nigerians continue to ask where the savings from subsidy removal have gone, the Presidency must explain how such costly gifts are being funded. If the vehicles were paid for privately, the source of the funds should be disclosed. If public resources were used, the government must identify who authorised the spending and under what legal authority,” he said. The ADC presidential candidate further alleged that the scale of the reported gifts raised questions about whether wealth and public resources were being used to secure political loyalty. He also criticised what he described as displays of privilege among individuals associated with the President, citing reports that the APC National Youth Leader travelled by private jet. Atiku extended his criticism to the President’s son, Seyi Tinubu, referring to widely circulated photographs said to show him wearing a Richard Mille RM 67-02 Sébastien Ogier wristwatch reportedly valued at about $500,000. “A worker on the national minimum wage would need several lifetimes to earn what the President’s son wears on one wrist. When the household of the President and the youth leader of his party flaunt such wealth in a season of hunger, insecurity and joblessness, they are not merely displaying poor taste; they are telling Nigerians, in the plainest possible terms, how little their suffering registers in the corridors of power,” Atiku said. He asked why Nigerians were being made to endure economic hardship while people close to the administration allegedly enjoyed lavish privileges. “Nigerians need answers, not another display of wealth for political mobilisation,” he said. Atiku pledged to investigate any public funds found to have been spent illegally if elected president. “When I am sworn in as president, every naira found to have been spent illegally will be thoroughly investigated, and everyone found culpable will be brought to justice,” he said. He added, “Tinubu made life difficult. I will make life affordable again.” Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/luxu.title_zh: 为尼日利亚进步大会党青年配备豪华SUV，是对处境艰难的尼日利亚人的侮辱
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/luxu.body_zh:
前副总统阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔将有关向全进步大会党（APC）青年领袖分发豪华运动型多用途车的消息形容为对正在与饥饿和生活成本上涨作斗争的尼日利亚人的侮辱。非洲民主大会（ADC）总统候选人阿蒂库呼吁总统博拉·蒂努布及总统府说明这些车辆的的资金来源；据报，这些车辆均为2026款，每辆价值超过1.5亿奈拉。ADC总统竞选委员会战略传播主任弗兰克·沙伊博于周一发表声明称，阿蒂库质疑有关第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布捐赠这些车辆的消息，称尼日利亚人有权知道是谁为车辆买单。

他说：“全进步大会党全国青年领袖称，这些车辆由第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布捐赠。尼日利亚人有权知道，购买并分发如此多2026款运动型多用途车的钱从哪里来；这些车每辆价值超过1.5亿奈拉，目的是用于政治动员。”

阿蒂库追问，这些车辆究竟是用第一夫人的个人资金、捐款还是公共资源购买的，并要求总统府披露总成本和资金来源。

这位前副总统说：“第一夫人没有担任任何经选举产生的公职或行政职务。她只是总统办公室的家庭附属人员。这些车辆是用她的个人资金、捐款还是公共资源买的？是谁付的钱？总成本是多少？总统府必须给出清楚的说明。”

他主张，在许多尼日利亚人连食物、交通和其他基本生活用品都难以负担的情况下，赠送这些豪华车辆并不合适。

他说：“在许多家庭买不起食物、交通用品和其他基本必需品的时候，这些礼物对民众而言就是公然侮辱。政府已经想办法为全进步大会党青年领袖提供豪华运动型多用途车，但数百万尼日利亚人仍在等待政府采取切实措施，缓解生活成本危机带来的影响。”

阿蒂库还质疑了此次车辆分发的时间，称全进步大会党女性领袖此前曾获赠豪华车辆，而且上一次赠车发生在奥约州学童遭绑架前不久。他说，最新有关车辆分发的消息引发了人们对政府支出优先事项的担忧，因为在经济困境和不安全局势持续之际，政府本应更加关注民生。

他说：“在尼日利亚人不断追问取消补贴节省下来的资金去了哪里的时候，总统府必须说明如此昂贵的礼物是如何获得资金支持的。如果车辆由私人支付，就应披露资金来源；如果使用了公共资源，政府就必须说明是谁批准了这笔支出，以及依据何种法律授权。”

这位非洲民主大会总统候选人进一步指称，如此大规模的礼物引发了外界疑问：财富和公共资源是否正被用于换取政治忠诚。他还批评了与总统有关联的 individuals 所展现的特权作风，并援引报道说，全进步大会党全国青年领袖乘坐私人飞机出行。阿蒂库也将批评延伸至总统之子塞伊·蒂努布，称广泛流传的照片显示他佩戴了一款Richard Mille RM 67-02 Sébastien Ogier腕表，据称价值约50万美元。

阿蒂库说：“一名领取全国最低工资的工人，需要耗费好几辈子，才能赚到总统儿子一只手腕上所戴腕表的价值。当总统的家庭和其政党的青年领袖在饥饿、不安全和失业的季节里炫耀这样的财富时，他们不只是品味拙劣；他们是在用最直白不过的方式告诉尼日利亚人，他们的苦难在权力核心眼中根本无足轻重。”

他质问，为什么尼日利亚人不得不忍受经济困境，而据称与本届政府关系密切的人却在享有奢华特权。

他说：“尼日利亚人需要的是答案，而不是又一次为了政治动员而进行的财富展示。”

阿蒂库承诺，如果当选总统，他将调查任何被发现遭非法使用的公共资金。

他说：“等我宣誓就任总统，每一笔被发现遭非法使用的奈拉都将得到彻底调查，所有被认定负有责任的人都将被绳之以法。”

他还补充道：“蒂努布让生活变得艰难。我会再次让生活变得负担得起。”

https://punchng.com/army-arrests-fake-so.body: Troops of Operation Enduring Peace have arrested a suspected fake soldier in Jos North Local Government Area of Plateau State for alleged phone snatching and public disturbance. The arrest was confirmed on Monday in an interview with our correspondent in Jos, the state capital, by the Media Information Officer of the Joint Task Force, Operation Enduring Peace, Capt. Chinonso Oteh. “Yes, it is true. That one happened in the Jos North area,” Oteh affirmed. He further said the troops arrested the suspect, identified as Salim Idris, at about 11:30 am on October 25 at Filin Sukuwa in Jos North LGA. According to him, the arrest followed credible intelligence about the suspect’s alleged criminal activities in the area. Army clarifies encounter with police in Plateau, seeks public cooperation Kwankwaso faults Tinubu on insecurity, poverty 2027: Police promise adequate security in Plateau He said the troops trailed the suspect and apprehended him while dressed in a military camouflage uniform. “Preliminary interrogation reportedly revealed that the suspect had been involved in a series of alleged criminal activities, including public disturbance, phone snatching and impersonation of security agencies,” he stated. It was learnt that the suspect is currently in the custody of troops while further investigation continues James Abraham
https://punchng.com/army-arrests-fake-so.title_zh: 军方在普拉托州逮捕一名抢夺手机的假士兵
https://punchng.com/army-arrests-fake-so.body_zh:
“持久和平行动”部队在普拉托州乔斯北地方政府区逮捕了一名涉嫌冒充士兵的人员，原因是其涉嫌抢手机和扰乱公共秩序。

联合特遣部队“持久和平行动”媒体信息官钦农索·奥特上尉周一在接受本台驻州府乔斯记者采访时确认了此次逮捕。他表示：“是的，情况属实。事件确实发生在乔斯北地区。”

他进一步说，部队于10月25日上午11时30分左右，在乔斯北地方政府区的菲林苏库瓦逮捕了嫌犯。此人已被确认为萨利姆·伊德里斯。据他介绍，此次逮捕源于有关该嫌犯在当地涉嫌犯罪活动的可靠情报。

陆军澄清与普拉托州警察发生冲突事件，呼吁公众合作
夸恩克瓦索指责蒂努布未能解决安全与贫困问题
2027年：警方承诺在普拉托州提供充分安全保障

他说，部队一路跟踪嫌犯，最终将其抓获，当时该嫌犯身穿军事迷彩服。

他表示：“据初步审讯显示，该嫌犯曾参与一系列涉嫌犯罪活动，包括扰乱公共秩序、抢手机以及冒充安全机构。”

据了解，该嫌犯目前仍被部队拘押 Further investigation continues James Abraham

https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.title: 2027 elections: 103m voters, 35m votes and the 68% who may decide the presidency
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.summary: The electorate is bigger than ever and the field more fragmented, but the outcome may turn less on what voters think than on which of them actually vote. Hold preferences constant – Tinubu voters stay with Tinubu, Atiku’s with Atiku, Obi’s with Obi and Kwankwaso’s with Kwankwaso – and change only turnout. Apply the 2023 national turnout of 26.71% uniformly to the new register and the arithmetic gives Mr Tinubu 9.60m votes, an Obi–Kwankwaso ticket 8.97m and Mr Atiku 7.23m.
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.summary_zh: 选民人数比以往任何时候都多，阵营也更加分散，但最终结果与其说取决于选民怎么想，不如说取决于他们实际上谁会投票。假设选民偏好保持不变——廷努布的支持者继续支持廷努布，阿提库的继续支持阿提库，奥比的继续支持奥比，夸恩克瓦索的继续支持夸恩克瓦索——仅改变投票率。将2023年全国投票率26.71%统一套用于新选民名册，计算结果显示，廷努布先生获得960万票，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合获得897万票，阿提库先生获得723万票。
https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.body: If Nigerians vote as they did in 2023 but more of them turn up, the race for Aso Rock looks very different. Turnout in the South-East, Kano’s Kwankwaso machine, four state reversals and a regional upstart may matter more than any change of heart. Nigerians will choose a president in fewer than 100 days, most of them preoccupied with insecurity and the soaring cost of living. Yet the election holds a paradox. The electorate is bigger than ever and the field more fragmented, but the outcome may turn less on what voters think than on which of them actually vote. Start with the numbers. The register has swollen to 103.4m, from 93.5m in 2023. State-by-state results from the last election, compiled by Vanguard and Stears , supply the map. Hold preferences constant – Tinubu voters stay with Tinubu, Atiku’s with Atiku, Obi’s with Obi and Kwankwaso’s with Kwankwaso – and change only turnout. The map starts to misbehave. A caveat: this is a scenario, not a forecast or a poll. It combines the 2026-27 register with 2023 state-level vote shares, then layers on assumptions – constructed turnout rates, an Obi–Kwankwaso merger, swapped vote shares in Plateau, Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa, and a hypothetical Makinde–Bala ticket on the APM platform in Bauchi and Oyo. Later sections test direct switches between Mr Tinubu and Mr Atiku. Nor does the model adjust for rigging. It does not need to: the 2023 results were challenged all the way to the Supreme Court on grounds of irregularities and upheld. Whatever irregularities occurred are therefore already built into the legally settled baseline on which these projections rest. In 2023 Mr Peter Obi ran up huge margins in parts of the South, but many of his strongholds turned out only modestly. Mr Bola Tinubu and Mr Abubakar Atiku, by contrast, drew heavily on high-turnout states. Apply the 2023 national turnout of 26.71% uniformly to the new register and the arithmetic gives Mr Tinubu 9.60m votes, an Obi–Kwankwaso ticket 8.97m and Mr Atiku 7.23m. The merger alone transforms the race. The more interesting question is what happens if low-turnout areas start behaving like high-turnout ones. Take Anambra and Kano. Suppose Anambra’s voters, instead of repeating their lacklustre 2023 showing, turned out at roughly Kano’s rate. Extend that across Mr Obi’s 2023 winning states: a turnout floor of 31.7%, with higher historical rates kept wherever they already exceeded it. The result flips. Obi–Kwankwaso edges ahead with 10.14m votes to Mr Tinubu’s 10.06m, with Mr Atiku on 7.51m – a margin of barely 85,000. That should unsettle every party headquarters. Mr Obi may not need to win in 2027 over millions of 2023 Tinubu voters; he may first need to get more of his own sympathisers to the polls. Two can play that game. Give Mr Atiku’s states the same treatment, however, and the advantage evaporates. Higher turnout in Adamawa, Bauchi, Gombe, Kaduna, Katsina, Kebbi, Osun, Sokoto, Taraba, Yobe and the rest of his territory does not help him alone, because his rivals also polled heavily there. Mr Tinubu returns to the lead with about 11.05m votes, against 10.50m for Obi–Kwankwaso and 8.83m for Mr Atiku. Do the same for Mr Tinubu’s states and turnout climbs towards 34.7m, roughly 33.6% of the register: Mr Tinubu 12.16m, Obi–Kwankwaso 10.79m, Mr Atiku 9.51m. The incumbent’s structural advantage reasserts itself. The lesson: mobilisation cannot be judged in isolation. If everyone gets out the vote equally well, the advantage returns to the coalition with the best mix of geographical spread, big-state strength and respectable second places. Elections are not reruns, so introduce some movement. Suppose Plateau, which Mr Obi won in 2023, swings to Mr Tinubu; rather than invent a swing, simply swap the two men’s 2023 vote shares. Do the same for three of Mr Atiku’s states – Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa – drifting towards Mr Tinubu. Mr Tinubu rises to about 12.48m; Obi–Kwankwaso slips to 10.62m and Mr Atiku to 9.35m. His lead stretches to some 1.86m. Four states have changed the complexion of the race. Enter the spoiler. Now add a Makinde–Bala ticket on the APM platform that concentrates on just two states: Bauchi, Mr Atiku’s in 2023, and Oyo, Mr Tinubu’s. In each, the previous winner is demoted to runner-up and the newcomer takes the winning share. That gives the APM about 584,000 votes in Bauchi and 601,000 in Oyo – some 1.18m from two states alone. A four-way race. Under the full scenario, turnout reaches about 35m. Mr Tinubu wins 11.69m votes (33.67%), Obi–Kwankwaso 10.62m (30.58%), Mr Atiku 8.96m (25.79%) and Makinde–Bala 1.18m (3.41%); other candidates share the remaining 2.2m (6.55%). Mr Tinubu still leads, but by only a little more than one million. Note what did not happen. Nobody conjured an electoral revolution. The exercise merely enlarged the electorate, nudged turnout, merged two camps, moved four states and added a regional challenger. Yet the lead changed hands, and the winning margin ranged from 85,000 to 1.86m. Much hinges on turnout, nowhere more than in the South-East, whose five states hold about 11.98m registered voters. But registration confers no clout by itself: a voter who stays at home counts for exactly as much as one who never registered. Turnout may be the great hidden variable of 2027. Lagos has nearly 7.5m registered voters. At 31.7% turnout that means almost 2.4m ballots. On 2023 shares, Obi–Kwankwaso takes about 1.05m to Mr Tinubu’s 1.02m – a statistical dead heat. A shift of a few tens of thousands could tip the national result. Lagos is worth not merely winning, but winning well. The art of losing well. Perhaps the least intuitive lesson is that the presidential race is not 37 winner-takes-all contests. A candidate who loses a state 45 to 40 still banks his 40. Winning more states is a different strategy from maximising the national vote while keeping enough geographical spread. Kingmakers, not kings. With 1.18m votes, Makinde–Bala is nowhere near first place. Yet its effect could be outsized, because it does not draw votes evenly: in Bauchi it hurts mainly Mr Atiku, in Oyo mainly Mr Tinubu. A small fourth candidate concentrated in the right states can wield influence out of all proportion to its national share. Whoever comes fourth could help decide who comes first. The model boils the election down to four linked contests. The first is over turnout: can low-participation strongholds vote in greater numbers without their rivals doing the same? The second is over coalitions: Obi–Kwankwaso looks formidable because it pairs strength in the South-East, the Middle Belt and Lagos with Mr Kwankwaso’s following in Kano. The third concerns defecting states: Plateau, Osun, Taraba and Bayelsa show how a handful of plausible shifts can move hundreds of thousands of net votes. The fourth is the spoiler contest, in which a Makinde–Bala-style ticket matters without ever being nationally competitive. A frightening number. Mr Tinubu’s final lead of a little more than one million is roughly 1% of a register of more than 103m. With only about a third of registered voters turning out, modest changes among today’s non-voters could easily swamp it. Keep the swaps and turnout alone cannot do it. The break-even rate against Mr Tinubu rises to about 121% – a mathematical impossibility. Even at 100% turnout in all 12 states, Mr Tinubu polls 18.02m to Mr Atiku’s 17.37m, a lead of some 656,000.Why is the bar so high? First, extra turnout is shared: with 2023 shares fixed, Mr Tinubu and Obi–Kwankwaso also gain, notably in Katsina, Kebbi, Sokoto, Osun and Bauchi, where Mr Tinubu was a competitive runner-up. Second, with the APM taking the winning share in Bauchi, a higher turnout there helps Makinde–Bala more than it does Mr Atiku. Third, in Bayelsa, Osun and Taraba, Mr Tinubu now holds the larger share, so every extra voter there widens his lead. At 1m switches, Mr Tinubu and Obi–Kwankwaso are separated by about 75,000 votes, with Mr Atiku still third. Only at around 2m does he move clear, leading Obi–Kwankwaso by about 339,000 and Mr Tinubu by about 1.26m. The crucial word is net. Every southern Atiku voter who drifts to Mr Tinubu adds one to the northern requirement: lose 500,000 in the South, and he needs about 2.16m converts (38.6% of Mr Tinubu’s 2023 northern vote); lose 1m, and he needs 2.66m (47.5%). Even with no southern losses, a comfortable 500,000-vote victory would take about 2.16m switches. It is tempting to split Nigeria into a northern Atiku constituency and a southern Tinubu one. The arithmetic is messier. In 2023 Mr Tinubu led Mr Atiku across the 19 northern states and the FCT by only about 365,000 votes, against roughly 1.46m in the South. Split the North further, and the picture sharpens. Across the North-West and North-East – the Core North – Mr Atiku actually won, by about 234,000. That conceals two contests: Mr Tinubu took the North-West by some 323,000, Mr Atiku the North-East by about 556,000. In other words, “Atiku takes the North, Tinubu takes the South” largely happened in 2023. Mr Atiku’s problem was scale: Mr Tinubu’s southern margin was more than six times his Core North advantage. Between the two blocs sits the North-Central, which should not be treated as an appendage of the Core North. In 2023 it split three ways: Mr Tinubu won about 1.76m votes, Mr Obi and Mr Kwankwaso together about 1.48m and Mr Atiku about 1.16m. Mr Tinubu carried Benue, Kogi, Kwara and Niger; Mr Obi took Nasarawa, Plateau and the FCT. With APC-leaning territory, old PDP constituencies, strong Obi support and ethnically and religiously mixed electorates, it is a genuine swing belt. A 10% transfer of Mr Tinubu’s North-Central vote to Mr Atiku would move about 176,000 votes and swing their head-to-head margin by about 352,000 – meaningful, but not decisive alone. Its leverage lies in amplifying a Core North recovery or protecting a southern lead. Now strip out the turnout boosts, swaps and spoiler and return to the plain baseline: 26.71% turnout applied to each state’s share of the 103.4m register, with 2023 vote shares held state by state. About 27.6m votes are cast across three theatres. The 2023 pattern survives, but its scale changes. Mr Atiku’s Core North lead shrinks to about 132,000, while Mr Tinubu’s southern lead swells to almost 1.9m – more than fourteen times as large. And the North-Central is far from neutral: it hands Mr Tinubu a further 610,000. Before a single southern vote is counted, he is about 479,000 ahead across the North and the FCT. Now test a reciprocal realignment: a share of Mr Tinubu’s Core North voters switches to Mr Atiku, while the same share of Mr Atiku’s southern voters switches to Mr Tinubu, with the North-Central unchanged. Equal percentages are not equal numbers. Mr Tinubu’s Core North pool (3.88m) is nearly twice Mr Atiku’s southern one (2.10m), so at 10% about 388,000 northern voters move to Mr Atiku and only about 210,000 southern voters to Mr Tinubu. The paradox is that both men grow stronger, in different halves of the country. At 15%, Mr Atiku leads the Core North by almost 1.3m, yet Mr Tinubu leads the South by about 2.52m and the country by about 1.84m. Drawing from the larger pool, Mr Atiku closes the gap, but slowly: across the two blocs, break-even comes at about 49.4% – nearly half of Mr Tinubu’s Core North support defecting while the same share of Mr Atiku’s southern vote goes the other way. That is not a swing but a realignment, and it would still leave Mr Tinubu’s 610,000 North-Central cushion intact. A northern recovery is therefore necessary for Mr Atiku but not sufficient: he must also stop the PDP’s residual southern vote in Rivers, Oyo, Ogun, Akwa Ibom and beyond from shrinking. That makes the North-West arguably the decisive battlefield. Mr Atiku already beat Mr Tinubu in the North-East; the bigger, harder prize lies in Kano, Kaduna, Katsina, Jigawa, Kebbi, Sokoto and Zamfara.

https://dailytrust.com/2027-elections-10.body_zh: 如果尼日利亚人像2023年那样投票，但有更多人出来投票，Aso Rock之争就会呈现截然不同的面貌。东南部、Kano的Kwankwaso政治机器、4个州逆转选情，以及一位地区新秀的影响，可能比任何选民心意的改变都更重要。不到100天，尼日利亚人将选出一名总统，其中大多数人正为不安全局势和不断飙升的生活成本所困扰。然而，此次选举存在一个悖论。选民人数比以往任何时候都多，候选人格局也更加分散，但结果可能更少取决于选民怎么想，而更多取决于他们中究竟谁真正投了票。先从数字说起。选民名册已从2023年的9350万增至1.034亿。《Vanguard》和《Stears》整理的上一次选举各州结果提供了基本图景。假定选民偏好不变——Tinubu选民仍投Tinubu，Atiku选民仍投Atiku，Obi选民仍投Obi，Kwankwaso选民仍投Kwankwaso——只改变投票率，这张图景便开始偏离实际情况。需要说明的是：这是一个情景推演，不是预测或民调。它把2026—27年的选民名册与2023年的各州得票率结合起来，再叠加一系列假设——设定投票率、Obi—Kwankwaso合并、互换Plateau、Osun、Taraba和Bayelsa的得票率，以及假设Makinde—Bala以APM平台参选Bauchi和Oyo。后文还会检验Tinubu先生与Atiku先生之间的直接转投。该模型也没有对选举舞弊进行调整。它无需调整：2023年的结果曾以存在违规行为为由一路诉至最高法院，并获维持。因此，无论当时发生了何种违规行为，都已经包含在这些推演所依据、且依法尘埃落定的基准结果之中。2023年，Peter Obi先生在南部部分地区取得巨大优势，但他的许多票仓最终仅是温和领先。相比之下，Bola Tinubu先生和Abubakar Atiku先生则在投票率很高的州吸引了大量选票。若将2023年全国投票率26.71%统一套用于新选民名册，算术结果显示，Tinubu先生获得960万票，Obi—Kwankwaso组合获得897万票，Atiku先生获得723万票。仅合并这一项就足以改变选情。更有意思的问题是，如果低投票率地区开始表现得像高投票率地区，会发生什么。以Anambra和Kano为例。假设Anambra选民不再重复2023年的低迷表现，而是达到大致与Kano相当的投票率。把这一情况推广至Obi先生2023年获胜的各州：设定31.7%的投票率下限，而在历史投票率本已高于这一水平的地区，则继续保留较高比率。结果发生逆转。Obi—Kwankwaso以1014万票略微领先Tinubu先生的1006万票，Atiku先生为751万票——领先优势仅约8.5万票。这应会让所有政党总部感到不安。Obi先生未必需要在2027年从数百万2023年支持Tinubu的选民中夺走胜果；他首先或许需要让自己的更多支持者走进投票站。双方都可以打这张牌。然而，如果对Atiku先生的各州也作同样处理，优势就会消失。Adamawa、Bauchi、Gombe、Kaduna、Katsina、Kebbi、Osun、Sokoto、Taraba、Yobe及其地盘内其他地区的投票率提高，对他并无单独帮助，因为他的对手在那里也获得了大量选票。Tinubu先生重新以约1105万票领先，Obi—Kwankwaso为1050万票，Atiku先生为883万票。对Tinubu先生的各州作同样处理，投票总数将升至3470万票左右，约占选民名册的33.6%：Tinubu先生1216万票，Obi—Kwankwaso 1079万票，Atiku先生951万票。执政者的结构性优势再次显现。教训在于：不能孤立地评估动员效果。如果所有人都能以同等程度参与投票，优势就会回到那个在地域覆盖、大州实力和体面的第二名成绩方面拥有最佳组合的联盟。选举并非简单重演，因此再加入一些选情变动。假设Obi先生2023年获胜的Plateau转向Tinubu先生；不凭空设定转投幅度，只互换两人的2023年得票率。对Atiku先生的3个州——Osun、Taraba和Bayelsa——也作同样处理，让它们向Tinubu先生偏移。Tinubu先生升至约1248万票，Obi—Kwankwaso降至1062万票，Atiku先生降至935万票。他的领先优势扩大到约186万票。4个州改变了整场选情的面貌。接下来是搅局者。再加入Makinde—Bala以APM平台参选，重点只在两个州布局：Bauchi，即Atiku先生2023年获胜的州，以及Oyo，即Tinubu先生的州。在这两个州，原胜者都降至第二，新入场者取得胜者份额。这使APM在Bauchi获得约58.4万票，在Oyo获得约60.1万票——仅凭两个州便获得约118万票。这变成了一场四方角逐。在完整情景下，投票总数达到约3500万票。Tinubu先生以1169万票获胜（33.67%），Obi—Kwankwaso获1062万票（30.58%），Atiku先生获896万票（25.79%），Makinde—Bala获118万票（3.41%）；其他候选人分得剩余的220万票（6.55%）。Tinubu先生仍然领先，但优势只略高于100万票。注意没有发生什么。没有人变出了一场选举革命。这项推演只是扩大了选民群体，略微推高了投票率，合并了两个阵营，移动了4个州，并增加了一名地区挑战者。然而，领先优势却易主，获胜差距也从8.5万票到186万票不等。很大程度上取决于投票率，东南部尤其如此。该地区5个州拥有约1198万名登记选民。但登记本身并不赋予任何影响力：待在家里的选民，与从未登记的选民影响完全相同。投票率可能才是2027年最关键的隐藏变量。Lagoos拥有近750万名登记选民。若投票率为31.7%，就意味着将投出近240万张选票。按2023年的得票率计算，Obi—Kwankwaso获得约105万票，Tinubu先生获得约102万票—— statistically两 statistically几乎持平。几万张选票的转移，就可能改变全国结果。Lagoos值得争取的不仅是胜利，而且是大幅获胜。这是如何输得漂亮的一门艺术。或许最反直觉的教训是，总统竞选并不是37场赢者通吃的竞争。一个候选人即使在某个州以45%对40%落败，仍能保留那40%的选票。赢得更多州，与在保持足够地域分布的同时把全国得票最大化，是两种不同的策略。造王者，而非王中之王。Makinde—Bala凭118万票远非位居第一，但其影响可能远超选票本身，因为这些选票并非平均分散：在Bauchi，它主要打击Atiku先生；在Oyo，它主要打击Tinubu先生。一名聚焦于恰到好处州份的小型第四候选人，能够施加与其全国份额远不相称的影响。最终位居第四的人，可能帮助决定谁位居第一。这个模型把选举归结为4场相互关联的较量。第一场围绕投票率：低参与率票仓能否在不引发对手同样增加投票的情况下投出更多选票？第二场围绕联盟：Obi—Kwankwaso之所以看似强大，是因为它把东南部、中部地带和Lagos的实力，与Kwankwaso先生在Kano的追随者结合起来。第三场涉及倒戈的州：Plateau、Osun、Taraba和Bayelsa表明，少量看似合理的选情转移，就可能净移动数十万张选票。第四场是搅局者之争，Makinde—Bala式组合虽在全国层面毫无竞争力，却能产生关键影响。这个数字令人不寒而栗。Tinubu先生最终略高于100万票的领先优势，只相当于1亿多选民名册的约1%。在登记选民中仅有约三分之一出来投票的情况下，如今不投票者中哪怕比例不高的人改变选择，也很容易淹没这点优势。仅靠互换选票和投票率变化无法做到这一点。令Tinubu先生无法被追平的临界比率会升至约121%——在数学上不可能实现。即使12个州的投票率都达到100%，Tinubu先生仍会以1802万票领先Atiku先生的1737万票，优势约65.6万票。为什么门槛如此之高？第一，新增投票是共享的：在2023年得票率固定不变的情况下，Tinubu先生和Obi—Kwankwaso也会增加得票，尤其是在Katsina、Kebbi、Sokoto、Osun和Bauchi，Tinubu先生在那里是颇具竞争力的第二名。第二，在APM于Bauchi取得胜者份额后，当地投票率越高，对Makinde—Bala的帮助就大于对Atiku先生的帮助。第三，在Bayelsa、Osun和Taraba，Tinubu先生如今拥有更大得票率，因此当地每多一名投票者，都会扩大他的领先优势。在发生100万张选票转移时，Tinubu先生与Obi—Kwankwaso之间的差距约为7.5万票，Atiku先生仍居第三。只有转移规模达到约200万票，他才能明确领先，届时领先Obi—Kwankwaso约33.9万票，领先Tinubu先生约126万票。关键在于“净”字。每一名从南部转投Tinubu先生的Atiku选民，都会使北部的追赶要求增加一人：若在南部失去50万票，他就需要约216万张选票完成转换，相当于Tinubu先生2023年北部选票的38.6%；若失去100万票，就需要266万张（47.5%）。即使没有南部失票，要取得一场稳稳当当的50万票胜利，也需要约216万张选票发生转换。把尼日利亚划分为北部的Atiku选区和南部的Tinubu选区颇具诱惑，但算术结果要复杂得多。2023年，Tinubu先生在北部19个州及联邦首都领区仅领先Atiku先生约36.5万票，而在南部的领先约为146万票。再把北部进一步拆分，情况就会更鲜明。在西北部和东北部——即“核心北部”——Atiku先生实际上以约23.4万票获胜。这掩盖了两场不同的较量：Tinubu先生在西北部领先约32.3万票，Atiku先生在东北部领先约55.6万票。换言之，“Atiku拿下北部、Tinubu拿下南部”在很大程度上就是2023年的实际格局。Atiku先生的问题在于规模：Tinubu先生在南部的领先优势超过其核心北部优势的6倍。两个阵营之间横亘着北中部，这里不应被视为核心北部的附属地区。2023年，该地区选票由三方瓜分：Tinubu先生获约176万票，Obi先生和Kwankwaso先生合计约148万票，Atiku先生约116万票。Tinubu先生拿下Benue、Kogi、Kwara和Niger；Obi先生赢得Nasarawa、Plateau和联邦首都领区。这里既有倾向APC的地区、PDP的传统票仓、强大的Obi支持者基础，也有族裔和宗教构成多元的选民群，因此是真正的摇摆地带。如果Tinubu先生在北中部的选票有10%转投Atiku先生，将移动约17.6万张选票，并把两人正面对决的差距改变约35.2万票——意义显著，但单凭这一变化仍不足以决定胜负。它的杠杆作用在于放大核心北部的收复，或保护南方领先优势。现在剔除投票率提升、选票互换和搅局者，回到最简单的基准情景：按各州在1.034亿选民名册中的份额套用26.71%的投票率，同时维持2023年各州得票率。三个战场合计投出约2760万张选票。2023年的格局依然存在，但规模发生变化。Atiku先生在核心北部的领先缩小至约13.2万票，而Tinubu先生在南部的领先扩大至近190万票——是前者的14倍以上。北中部也远非中立：它又为Tinubu先生贡献了61万票。在南部尚未投出任何一票之前，他已在北部和联邦首都领区领先约47.9万票。现在测试一种对称的重新结盟：Tinubu先生在核心北部的一部分选民转投Atiku先生，同时Atiku先生在南部同样比例的选民转投Tinubu先生，北中部保持不变。相同的百分比并不意味着相同的人数。Tinubu先生的核心北部选民池（388万）几乎是Atiku先生南部选民池（210万）的两倍，因此10%的转投意味着约38.8万名北部选民转投Atiku先生，而只有约21万名南部选民转投Tinubu先生。悖论在于，两人在国家的不同半区都会变得更强。转投比例达到15%时，Atiku先生以近130万票领先核心北部，但Tinubu先生仍以约252万票领先南部，并以约184万票领先全国。凭借规模更大的选民池，Atiku先生缩小了差距，但速度缓慢：在两个阵营之间，持平所需的转投比例约为49.4%——这意味着Tinubu先生核心北部近一半支持者倒戈，同时Atiku先生在南部相同比例的选票转向另一边。这不是选情摇摆，而是阵营重组；即便如此，Tinubu先生在北中部拥有的61万票缓冲仍将保留。因此，北部收复对Atiku先生是必要的，却还不充分：他还必须阻止PDP在Rivers、Oyo、Ogun、Akwa Ibom及其他地区残留的南方选票流失。由此，北西部可以说才是决定性战场。Atiku先生已经在东北部击败Tinubu先生；规模更大、更难攻取的目标则在Kano、Kaduna、Katsina、Jigawa、Kebbi、Sokoto和Zamfara。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.summary_zh: 教育部长哈鲁纳·伊德里苏誓言，奥布阿西高级中学技术学校（SHTS）所涉性侵指控在得到解决之前，不会淡出公众视线。部长于2026年10月26日星期一在阿克拉举行的新闻发布会上表示，此案不会重蹈其他重大公共争议的模式：这些争议先在媒体上引发广泛关注，随后逐渐从全国公众讨论中消失。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body: Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu has vowed that the sexual abuse allegations at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) will not be allowed to fade from public attention without a resolution. Speaking at a press conference in Accra on Monday, October 26, 2026, the Minister said the case would not follow the pattern of other major public controversies that attract intense media attention before gradually disappearing from the national conversation. “Amid the calls from various sections of society for a full-scale investigation of similar malpractices in other educational institutions in the country, this scandal won't suffer the same fate as other burning issues which are normal to be discussed with gusto in the media over a period and then go out with a whimper. That won't happen in respect of this matter,” he said. Mr Iddrisu assured the public that the Ministry of Education would follow through on the case and work to ensure that justice is served. “The Ministry of Education would follow through and ensure that justice is done and justice will be done and will be seen to have been done,” he said. He also urged all parties involved to respect the legal process, stressing that the investigation must proceed in accordance with the law. “But due process will be followed and observed. So all parties must respect due process, and all parties must uphold the tenets and values and let the law take its course,” he added. The case has triggered national outrage, with 19 students reported to have made allegations of sexual abuse involving the school's headmaster, Zakaria Abdulai. The Ghana Education Service (GES) has suspended Mr Abdulai pending investigations, while the Ministry of Education has directed the Criminal Investigations Department of the Ghana Police Service to investigate the allegations. The controversy has also prompted calls for a wider inquiry into similar allegations in other educational institutions across the country
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.title_zh: 奥布阿西SHTS丑闻不会淡出公众视线
https://www.myjoyonline.com/obuasi-shts-.body_zh: 教育部长哈鲁纳·伊德里苏誓言，奥布阿西高级中学技术学校（SHTS）的性侵指控在得到解决之前，绝不会任其淡出公众视线。部长于2026年10月26日星期一在阿克拉举行的新闻发布会上表示，此案不会重蹈其他重大公共争议的模式：这些争议先在媒体上受到广泛关注，随后逐渐从全国公众讨论中消失。他说：“鉴于社会各界均呼吁对全国其他教育机构的类似不当行为展开全面调查，这起丑闻不会遭遇其他热点议题的命运——这些议题通常会在媒体上受到热烈讨论一段时间，随后便悄无声息地淡出。就此事而言，这种情况不会发生。”伊德里苏先生向公众保证，教育部将跟进此案，并确保正义得到伸张。他说：“教育部将采取后续行动，确保正义得到伸张，而且正义必将得到伸张，人们也将看到正义已经得到伸张。”他还敦促所有相关各方尊重法律程序，强调调查必须依法进行。他补充道：“但正当程序将得到遵循和遵守。因此，所有各方都必须尊重正当程序，所有各方都必须维护基本原则和价值观，让法律自行发挥作用。”此案引发了全国公愤。据报道，19名学生指控该校校长扎卡里亚·阿卜杜莱涉及性侵行为。加纳教育局（GES）在调查期间已暂停阿卜杜莱先生职务；教育部则指示加纳警察局刑事调查局调查这些指控。这场争议还促使人们呼吁，对全国其他教育机构中的类似指控展开更广泛的调查

https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.summary_zh: 该项目正与土地和自然资源部、林业委员会及环境保护局合作开展。根据一份谅解备忘录，林业委员会将提供技术专长并监督恢复项目的实施。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.body: The project is being undertaken in collaboration with the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, the Forestry Commission and the Environmental Protection Authority. The initiative aims to restore degraded forest land, support biodiversity conservation and promote sustainable natural resource management in Ghana’s mining areas. Under a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), the Forestry Commission will provide technical expertise and oversee the implementation of the restoration project. Dubbed “Support of Forest Rehabilitation in Mining Regions and Promotion of Sustainability in Mining,” the project will be implemented over a two-year period and seeks to rehabilitate degraded portions of the Subri River Forest Reserve through targeted reforestation and restoration activities. Commenting on the initiative, the Chief Executive Officer of MIIF, Justina Nelson, said the project reflects MIIF’s commitment to ensuring that the benefits of Ghana’s mineral resources are pursued alongside responsible environmental management. “As an institution entrusted with managing Ghana’s mineral income and State interests in the mining sector, MIIF recognises that value creation must go hand in hand with environmental responsibility. “Restoring degraded forest landscapes is not only about planting trees; it is about protecting biodiversity and ensuring that communities can continue to benefit from our natural resources for generations to come,” she said. Mrs. Nelson added that the partnership demonstrates the importance of collaboration among government institutions and mining companies as well as local communities in addressing environmental challenges in mining regions adding: “We believe that meaningful partnerships such as this can make a lasting difference”. The scope of work will include site preparation, seedlings and other inputs, tree planting, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder and community engagement, as well as Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) reporting. The project is expected to contribute to the restoration of degraded forest ecosystems, improve biodiversity, strengthen climate resilience and promote sustainable forest management in one of Ghana’s important forest reserves. It will also provide opportunities for local communities and other stakeholders to participate in forest restoration and conservation activities, reinforcing the importance of community involvement in protecting Ghana’s natural resources. On his part, the Chief Executive Officer of Zijin Golden Ridge Limited, Leon Zhang added: "We approach forest restoration as a long-term responsibility, not a one-time gesture. Our own biodiversity offset programme at Atewa reflects that. This partnership with MIIF and the Forestry Commission to restore the Subri River Forest Reserve carries that same commitment and focus."
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.title_zh: 加纳基础设施投资基金与林业委员会合作，为苏布里森林保护区重新造林
https://www.myjoyonline.com/miif-forestr.body_zh: 该项目与土地与自然资源部、林业委员会及环境保护局合作开展，旨在恢复退化的林地、支持生物多样性保护，并促进加纳矿区自然资源的可持续管理。根据一份谅解备忘录（MoU），林业委员会将提供技术专长并监督恢复项目的实施。该项目名为“支持矿区森林修复并促进采矿业可持续性”，计划在两年内实施，旨在通过有针对性的植树造林和生态修复活动，恢复Subri河森林保护区部分退化区域。MIIF首席执行官Justina Nelson在评论该项目时表示，该项目体现了MIIF的承诺，即在合理开发加纳矿产资源收益的同时，切实承担环境管理责任。她说：“作为一家受托管理加纳矿产收入以及采矿业国家利益的机构，MIIF深知，创造价值必须与环境责任并行。恢复退化的森林景观不仅是植树的问题；还关系到保护生物多样性，并确保社区能够世代继续从我们的自然资源中获益。”Nelson女士补充说，这一合作关系证明，政府机构、采矿企业和当地社区协作解决矿区环境挑战具有重要意义，并指出：“我们相信，此类富有意义的合作能够带来持久的改变”。工作范围包括场地准备、树苗及其他投入品采购、植树、监测与评估、利益相关方和社区参与，以及环境、社会和治理（ESG）报告。该项目预计将有助于恢复退化的森林生态系统、改善生物多样性、增强气候韧性，并促进加纳一处重要森林保护区的可持续森林管理。项目还将为当地社区和其他利益相关方参与森林恢复与保护活动提供机会，进一步凸显社区参与保护加纳自然资源的重要性。Zijin Golden Ridge Limited首席执行官Leon Zhang表示：“我们将森林恢复视为一项长期责任，而非一次性的姿态。我们在Atewa开展的生物多样性补偿计划就体现了这一点。我们与MIIF及林业委员会合作恢复Subri河森林保护区，同样体现了这一承诺和重点。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.body: The organisers of the Best of Nollywood (BON) Awards have announced Enugu State as the host of the 18th edition of the ceremony, scheduled for November, but kept the date and venue under wraps. In a statement sent to PREMIUM TIMES on Monday, the organisers said the event would attract filmmakers, actors and other entertainment industry stakeholders to the South-east for the annual celebration of Nigerian cinema. They said guests would arrive via the newly launched Enugu Air, which the state government has positioned as part of a major transport overhaul to improve domestic and international access to Akanu Ibiam International Airport. The organisers said the awards would do more than celebrate film and entertainment, describing the event as a chance to present Governor Peter Mbah’s $30 billion tourism economy to a global audience. They further said the ceremony would put six major tourism sites under development in the state in the international spotlight through global television coverage. The organisers said: “As November approaches, the anticipation is palpable. Nollywood’s biggest stakeholders, actors, and producers are preparing to descend on Enugu. “November in Enugu is shaping up to be an economic masterclass. Just as the BON Awards wrap up, the state will transition into hosting the 23rd National Sports Festival, the “Coal City Games,” beginning 27 November.” The organisers said delegates and nominees would visit Awhum Waterfall and Monastery, one of the event’s attractions. They said the 5.32km Okpatu-Awhum Cable Car, described as one of Africa’s longest, would provide access to the site. The itinerary also features the canopy walkways at the Nsude Pyramids, the Lejja Ancient Iron-Smelting Site and the Ngwo Pine Forest, which boasts Nigeria’s first 400-metre zipline. Other destinations include the Landmark Nike Lake Resort, which features West Africa’s second Upside-Down House, and the Centre for Memories (Ncheta Ndigbo), which showcases Igbo history and heritage. BON founder Seun Oloketuyi led a delegation to the state in August to present the hosting rights to the governor, this newspaper gathered. The delegation comprised Feranmi Olaoye, the awards’ executive producer; Tomi Falade; actor Enyinna Nwigwe; and Olukizzy Michael. In July, this newspaper reported that veteran actor Pete Edochie, actress and filmmaker Ruth Kadiri, actress Peju Ogunmola and filmmaker Steve Sodiya would receive Special Recognition Awards at the ceremony. According to the organisers, the four personalities earned the honours through their contributions to the film industry, long-standing careers, mentorship and impact on filmmakers and audiences. Edochie’s award recognises his decades in acting and his portrayal of authoritative, wise characters rooted in African culture. Kadiri would be honoured for her work as an actress, producer, and screenwriter, as well as her contributions to YouTube-based filmmaking. Ogunmola’s recognition reflects her work in Yoruba- and English-language films and her efforts to promote indigenous culture through theatre and cinema. Sodiya would receive the honour for his contributions as a filmmaker, editor and director, including his work in talent development and production. The Best of Nollywood Awards, founded in 2009 by the publisher of Nigerian Entertainment Today (NET), recognises excellence across Nigeria’s film industry. Its categories cover acting, directing, screenwriting and technical filmmaking in English and indigenous languages. The awards also present annual Special Recognition Awards to individuals whose contributions have helped advance the industry. The organisers said this year’s recipients represent different generations of Nollywood and have influenced its development through their work and mentorship
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.title_zh: 埃努古州将于11月主办BON奖颁奖典礼
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/entertain.body_zh:
Nollywood最佳作品（BON）奖主办方宣布，恩古州将承办第18届颁奖典礼，典礼定于11月举行，但具体日期和地点尚未公布。主办方周一发给《PREMIUM TIMES》的声明称，这场活动将吸引电影制片人、演员及娱乐行业其他相关人士来到尼日利亚东南部，参加这一尼日利亚电影年度盛会。

他们表示，来宾将通过新开通的Enugu Air抵达。恩古州政府将该航空服务定位为交通大改造的一部分，旨在改善通往Akanu Ibiam国际机场的国内和国际交通连接。

主办方表示，本届颁奖礼将不只是庆祝电影和娱乐事业，而是要借机向全球观众展示州长Peter Mbah推动的$30 billion旅游经济。他们进一步表示，典礼将通过全球电视报道，使该州正在开发的六大旅游胜地登上国际舞台。

主办方表示：“随着11月日益临近，人们的期待清晰可感。Nollywood最具影响力的相关人士、演员和制片人正准备齐聚恩古。

“恩古的11月正在成为一场经济盛宴。就在BON奖落下帷幕之际，该州将转入 hosting 第23届全国体育节——‘煤炭城运动会’，赛事将于11月27日开幕。”

主办方表示，代表和提名人士将参观Awhum瀑布及修道院，后者是活动亮点之一。他们表示，长5.32公里的Okpatu-Awhum索道被称为非洲最长的索道之一，将为前往该景点提供交通。行程还包括Nsude金字塔树冠步道、Lejja古铁冶炼遗址和Ngwo松林，后者拥有尼日利亚首条400米高空滑索。其他目的地包括Landmark Nike Lake度假村和记忆中心（Ncheta Ndigbo）；前者设有西非第二座倒置屋，后者展示伊博人的历史与文化遗产。

据《PREMIUM TIMES》了解，BON创始人Seun Oloketuyi于8月率领代表团访问该州，将主办权移交给州长。代表团成员包括该奖执行制片人Feranmi Olaoye、Tomi Falade、演员Enyinna Nwigwe和Olukizzy Michael。

《PREMIUM TIMES》曾在7月报道，资深演员Pete Edochie、演员兼电影制片人Ruth Kadiri、演员Peju Ogunmola以及电影制片人Steve Sodiya将在典礼上获得特别表彰奖。

主办方表示，这四位人士凭借对电影行业的贡献、长期职业生涯、导师作用以及对电影制片人和观众的影响而获此殊荣。Edochie获奖是为了表彰他数十年的表演生涯，以及他对植根于非洲文化的权威睿智角色的塑造。Kadiri将因其演员、制片人和编剧身份下的工作，以及对基于YouTube的电影制作的贡献而受到表彰。Ogunmola获得的认可体现了她在约鲁巴语和英语电影中的工作，以及她通过戏剧和电影推广本土文化的努力。Sodiya将因其作为电影制片人、剪辑师和导演的贡献而获奖，其中包括在人才培养和作品制作方面的工作。

Nollywood最佳作品奖由《Nigerian Entertainment Today》（NET）的出版人于2009年创办，旨在表彰尼日利亚电影行业各领域的杰出成就。奖项类别涵盖英语及本土语言电影中的表演、导演、编剧和技术制作。主办方表示，该奖还设有年度特别表彰奖，授予那些为推动行业发展作出贡献的人士。

主办方表示，今年的获奖者来自Nollywood的不同世代，并通过各自的工作和导师作用影响了行业发展……

https://www.inquirer.net/493907/westminc.body: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A Chinese Navy carrier fleet was spotted passing through waters off Mindanao last week, the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ (AFP) Western Mindanao Command (WestMinCom) disclosed on Monday. In a statement, WestMinCom said its Maritime Situational Awareness Center (MSAC-WM) and other maritime units tracked the People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) Liaoning Carrier Group as it transited the Zamboanga Peninsula region last Thursday, Oct. 22. Military tracking initially spotted the aircraft carrier fleet northwest of Talulu Point in Siocon, Zamboanga del Norte. The fleet was later monitored southwest of Maitum, Sarangani, as it moved southeastward toward the Celebes Sea, which the country shares with Indonesia and Malaysia. READ: Chinese aircraft carrier, escorts monitored in N. Luzon water s In response, the Philippine Navy deployed frigates and patrol ships to shadow the Chinese fleet. BRP Diego Silang (FFG-7) and BRP Emilio Jacinto (PS-35) conducted shadowing operations, joined by the Philippine Coast Guard vessel BRP Sarangani. The Philippine Air Force provided aerial reconnaissance and maritime surveillance using an S-70i Black Hawk helicopter and an NC-212i light transport aircraft. WestMinCom noted that the Liaoning Carrier Group’s transit was “continuous and expeditious.” Based on its monitored course and speed, the carrier group was estimated to have exited the Western Mindanao area of operations around 11 p.m. on Oct. 22. Military units maintained active coordination and continuous reporting throughout the operation to enhance maritime domain awareness and safeguard regional waters, the WestMinCom said
https://www.inquirer.net/493907/westminc.title_zh: WestMinCom：中国籍船队被发现在棉兰老岛附近海域航行
https://www.inquirer.net/493907/westminc.body_zh: 菲律宾海军航母编队上周被发现经过棉兰老岛附近海域。菲律宾武装部队西棉兰老司令部（WestMinCom）周一披露了这一消息。WestMinCom在一份声明中表示，其海上态势感知中心（MSAC-WM）及其他海上部队追踪到中国人民解放军海军（PLAN）辽宁舰航母编队于10月22日星期四经过赞比加半岛地区。军方追踪时最初在东米沙鄢锡奥孔的塔卢卢角西北方向发现该航母编队。随后，该编队向东南驶往苏拉威西海时，军方在萨兰加尼省迈图姆西南方向对其进行了监控。苏拉威西海由菲律宾、印度尼西亚和马来西亚共同拥有。阅读：中国航母及护航舰队在北吕宋海域受到监控。作为回应，菲律宾海军派出护卫舰和巡逻舰监视中国舰队。BRP Diego Silang（FFG-7）和BRP Emilio Jacinto（PS-35）执行了跟踪行动，菲律宾海岸警卫队船艇BRP Sarangani也加入其中。菲律宾空军使用S-70i“黑鹰”直升机和NC-212i轻型运输机开展空中侦察与海上监视。WestMinCom表示，辽宁舰航母编队的航行“连续且迅速”。根据监测到的航向和速度，预计该航母编队于10月22日晚11时左右驶离西棉兰老行动区域。WestMinCom称，整个行动期间，各军事单位保持密切协调和持续报告，以提升海上态势感知能力并维护区域水域安全。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Tami Overby is a veteran U.S. business executive and trade advocate who played a key role in strengthening economic ties between Korea and the United States, including efforts to advance the Korea-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (KORUS FTA) and expand travel access for Korean citizens.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Tami Overby是美国资深商业高管和贸易倡议者，在加强韩国与美国经济关系方面发挥了关键作用，包括推动韩美自由贸易协定（KORUS FTA）以及扩大韩国公民赴美旅行便利。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Tami Overby is a veteran U.S. business executive and trade advocate who played a key role in strengthening economic ties between Korea and the United States, including efforts to advance the Korea-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (KORUS FTA) and expand travel access for Korean citizens. During her tenure as president and CEO of the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea (AMCHAM) from 1995 to 2009, Overby was directly involved in bilateral trade discussions and advocated policies aimed at improving market access and business conditions for U.S. companies operating in Korea. In 2009, former President Lee Myung-bak personally presented Overby with the Silver Tower Order of Industrial Service Merit in recognition of her contributions to attracting foreign investment to Korea over more than two decades and advancing the bilateral trade pact. The honor reflected her longstanding efforts to promote Korea as an investment destination for American businesses and deepen commercial ties between the two countries. She also contributed to efforts that led to Korea's inclusion in the U.S. visa waiver program, which took effect in November 2008 and allowed eligible Korean travelers to visit the U.S. for tourism and business without a visa for stays of up to 90 days. Overby's work has spanned trade policy, investment promotion and business diplomacy, positioning her as a longtime participant in efforts to strengthen the commercial relationship between Seoul and Washington.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 塔米·欧弗比是美国资深企业高管和贸易倡导者，她在加强韩国与美国经济关系方面发挥了关键作用，包括推动韩美自由贸易协定（KORUS FTA）以及扩大韩国公民赴美旅行便利。1995年至2009年担任美国商会驻韩国分会（AMCHAM）总裁兼首席执行官期间，欧弗比直接参与双边贸易谈判，并倡导改善美国企业在韩国经营的市场准入和商业环境的政策。2009年，时任总统李明博亲自向欧弗比授予工业服务功绩银塔勋章，以表彰她二十多年来为吸引外国投资进入韩国以及推动双边贸易协定所作的贡献。这项荣誉体现了她长期致力于将韩国打造为美国企业的投资目的地，并深化两国商业联系。她还参与推动韩国纳入美国免签证计划的工作。该计划于2008年11月生效，允许符合条件的韩国旅客免签证赴美旅游和商务访问，停留时间最长可达90天。欧弗比的工作涵盖贸易政策、投资促进和商业外交，使她成为推动首尔与华盛顿加强商业关系的长期参与者。
