https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.summary_zh: 联邦政府已确保联邦高等法院阿布贾分庭判定653名被控涉恐怖主义边缘行为者有罪。法格贝米在检视已进入第11阶段的审判进展时表示，今年开展的第三阶段审判共有1,060名嫌疑人被带上法庭受审。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.body: The federal government has secured the conviction of 653 persons charged with offences bordering on acts of terrorism before the Federal High Court, Abuja. Attorney General of the Federation (AGF) and Minister of Justice, Prince Lateef Fagbemi, SAN, made the disclosure on Friday, while speaking with journalists in Abuja. Fagbemi, who gave the update while reviewing the progress of the trials, which is on its 11th phase, observed that 1,060 suspects were brought before the courts for trial, which is the third phase conducted this year. He disclosed that as at noon on Friday, 880 cases had been tried, resulting in 653 convictions, seven acquittals and 27 discharges. The AGF, however, said the exercise was still ongoing and that the final figures would be announced upon its conclusion, describing the current phase as apparently the largest, since the federal government commenced the special terrorism trials, attributing the progress to judicial cooperation, effective prosecution and inter-agency collaboration. Fagbemi expressed appreciation to the judges handling the cases, particularly under the leadership of Justice Binta Nyako, who has been acting on behalf of the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court, Justice John Tsoho. He also commended prosecution and defence counsel, as well as relevant security and justice institutions, for their contributions to the exercise. Among the agencies acknowledged were the Office of the National Security Adviser (NSA), the Department of State Services (DSS), the military, the police, correctional centres and the Legal Aid Council. Fagbemi noted that the collaboration among the institutions has been critical to advancing the prosecution of terrorism, terrorism financing and related offences in the country. The AGF also thanked journalists for informing the public about the federal government’s efforts to address terrorism and related security challenges in the country. On the representation of defendants by lawyers from the Legal Aid Council, the AGF explained that the council was fulfilling its responsibility of providing legal assistance to eligible defendants and clarified, however, that private legal practitioners were also representing some of the suspects. According to him, defence lawyers had been engaging with their clients before the court proceedings, including visiting detention facilities and preparing them for their defence. He noted that some of these preparatory activities could not be subjected to public scrutiny because of the sensitive security considerations surrounding the cases. On the issue of deradicalisation of suspects recommended by the court, Fagbemi said the process remained an important component of the overall exercise, explaining that deradicalisation was intended to help eligible individuals understand and regret their actions, enabling them to reintegrate into society and resume their daily lives. The AGF maintained that rehabilitation and reintegration were necessary to complement the judicial process and reduce the risk of individuals returning to extremist activities. The ongoing trials form part of the federal government’s efforts to prosecute terrorism-related offences and strengthen accountability in the country’s response to insecurity. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府通过最新大规模审判成功定罪653名恐怖分子
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/23/f.body_zh: 联邦政府已促使阿布贾联邦高等法院对653名被控犯有接近恐怖主义行为罪行的人作出定罪判决。联邦总检察长兼司法部长Lateef Fagbemi、SAN于周五在阿布贾接受记者采访时披露了这一情况。Fagbemi在审议已进入第11阶段的审判进展时表示，共有1060名嫌疑人被带上法庭受审；这是今年开展的第三阶段审判。他透露，截至周五中午，已审理880起案件，其中653人被定罪、7人无罪释放、27人撤销指控。联邦总检察长表示，这项工作仍在进行，最终数字将在结束时公布，并将当前阶段描述为联邦政府启动特别恐怖主义审判以来规模最大的一阶段。他将审判进展归功于司法部门的配合、有效起诉以及各机构之间的协作。Fagbemi感谢了负责审理案件的法官，尤其是在Justice Binta Nyako的带领下；她一直代表联邦高等法院首席法官Justice John Tsoho履职。他还赞扬了控辩双方律师，以及相关安全和司法机构对这项工作的贡献。获得致谢的机构包括国家安全顾问办公室（NSA）、国家情报局（DSS）、军方、警察、惩教机构和法律援助委员会。Fagbemi指出，各机构之间的协作对于推进对国内恐怖主义、恐怖主义融资及相关罪行的起诉至关重要。联邦总检察长还感谢记者向公众报道联邦政府为应对国内恐怖主义及相关安全挑战所做的努力。关于法律援助委员会律师为被告人提供代理的问题，联邦总检察长解释说，该委员会正在履行向符合条件的被告提供法律援助的责任，同时澄清私人执业律师也在代理部分嫌疑人。他说，辩护律师在法院审理程序开始前一直与当事人接洽，包括前往拘留场所探视并帮助他们准备应诉。他指出，由于这些案件涉及敏感的安全考量，其中一些准备工作无法接受公众监督。关于法院建议对嫌疑人进行去激进化处理的问题，Fagbemi表示，这一过程仍是整个行动的重要组成部分。去激进化的目的在于帮助符合条件的人理解并悔悟自己的行为，使他们能够重新融入社会并恢复日常生活。联邦总检察长强调，康复和重新融入社会是补充司法程序、降低个人再次参与极端主义活动风险所必需的。正在进行的审判是联邦政府努力起诉恐怖主义相关罪行并加强全国应对不安全局势问责机制的一部分。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政界、商界、专业人士和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有志青年和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术交汇的平台。本报是一项公共信任事业，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.title: Xenophobia: FG condemns attacks, evacuates 114 more Nigerians from South Africa
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.summary: The Federal Government has condemned xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities against Nigerians and other foreign nationals in South Africa, as it evacuated another 114 distressed citizens from the country. The ministry said the latest operation was the 16th consular evacuation since the exercise began on June 10, 2026, bringing the total number of Nigerians evacuated from South Africa to 2,151.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.summary_zh: 联邦政府谴责南非针对尼日利亚人及其他外国公民的仇外和反非敌意行为，并再次从该国撤离114名陷入困境的公民。该部门表示，此次行动是自2026年6月10日启动撤离工作以来的第16次领事撤离行动，使从南非撤离的尼日利亚公民总数达到2,151人。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.body: The Federal Government has condemned xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities against Nigerians and other foreign nationals in South Africa, as it evacuated another 114 distressed citizens from the country. In a statement on Friday evening, the latest batch of returnees comprised 57 men, 23 women and 34 children who arrived in Lagos aboard South African Airways Flight SA060 at about 8:30 p.m. on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The returnees were received by officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the National Emergency Management Agency, the Nigeria Immigration Service and other relevant Federal Government agencies. The ministry said the latest operation was the 16th consular evacuation since the exercise began on June 10, 2026, bringing the total number of Nigerians evacuated from South Africa to 2,151. It explained that the Redeemed Christian Church of God, RCCG, under the leadership of Pastor Enoch Adejare Adeboye, funded the one-way tickets for the latest batch from its $265,854 donation to support the evacuation of 500 distressed Nigerians. With the latest evacuation, the church has funded the return of 432 Nigerians, while the Federal Government has fully funded the evacuation of 1,388 citizens. The Federal Government expressed appreciation to the RCCG for its financial support towards the humanitarian exercise. Condemning the attacks, the government called on the relevant South African authorities to take decisive measures to protect all persons, irrespective of nationality, and ensure that perpetrators of violence against foreign nationals are held accountable. It said it would continue engaging relevant stakeholders, including South African authorities, to address xenophobia and Afrophobia and promote the safety and welfare of Nigerians residing in South Africa. The statement in parts, “The latest operation marks the sixteenth (16th) consular evacuation since the commencement of the ongoing exercise on 10th June, 2026, bringing the total number of Nigerian nationals evacuated from South Africa to 2,151. Of this number, the Federal Government of Nigeria fully funded the return of 1,388 nationals. “The Federal Government reiterates its unequivocal condemnation of all forms of xenophobic and Afrophobic hostilities directed at foreign nationals, including Nigerians, in South Africa. It further calls on the relevant South African authorities to take decisive measures to protect all persons, irrespective of nationality, and ensure that perpetrators of violence against foreign nationals are held accountable. The government also advised Nigerians in the country to obey local laws, remain vigilant and prioritise their personal safety. It urged them to maintain regular contact with the Nigerian High Commission in Pretoria and the Consulate General in Johannesburg for consular assistance whenever necessary. The Federal Government reaffirmed its commitment to safeguarding Nigerians in the diaspora and providing timely consular assistance as the need arises. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.title_zh: 仇外情绪：尼日利亚联邦政府谴责袭击事件，再从南非撤离114名尼日利亚人
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/xeno.body_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府谴责了南非针对尼日利亚人和其他外国人的排外及反非敌意行为，同时又从该国撤离了114名陷入困境的公民。尼日利亚联邦政府周五晚发表声明称，最新一批返乡人员包括57名男性、23名女性和34名儿童，他们于2026年10月22日星期四晚上8时30分左右乘坐南非 Airways SA060航班抵达拉各斯。返乡人员受到外交部、国家紧急事务管理局、尼日利亚移民局及其他相关联邦政府机构官员的接待。大使馆表示，自2026年6月10日启动有关行动以来，这次最新行动是第16次领事撤离，累计已有2,151名尼日利亚人从南非撤离。声明解释称，在牧师Enoch Adejare Adeboye领导下，救赎基督教会（RCCG）从其265,854美元的捐款中拨出资金，为最新一批人员购买了单程机票；这笔捐款原本用于支持500名陷入困境的尼日利亚人撤离。随着最新一次撤离，该教会已出资帮助432名尼日利亚人返乡，尼日利亚联邦政府则全额资助了1,388名公民的撤离。尼日利亚联邦政府感谢RCCG为这项人道主义行动提供的资金支持。在谴责袭击事件时，政府呼吁南非相关当局采取果断措施，保护所有人，不论其国籍，并确保针对外国人的暴力行为实施者受到问责。政府表示，将继续与南非当局等相关利益攸关方沟通，以处理排外和反非问题，并促进居住在南非的尼日利亚人的安全与福祉。声明部分内容如下：“自2026年6月10日启动当前行动以来，这次最新行动是第16次领事撤离，累计已有2,151名尼日利亚国民从南非撤离。其中，尼日利亚联邦政府全额资助了1,388名国民返乡。“尼日利亚联邦政府再次坚决谴责南非境内针对外国人（包括尼日利亚人）的各种排外和反非敌意行为，并进一步呼吁南非相关当局采取果断措施，保护所有人，不论其国籍，并确保针对外国人的暴力行为实施者受到问责。政府还建议身在当地的尼日利亚人遵守当地法律、保持警惕，并优先保障个人安全。声明敦促他们定期与驻比勒陀利亚大使馆和驻约翰内斯堡总领事馆联系，在必要时寻求领事协助。尼日利亚联邦政府重申，将致力于保护海外尼日利亚人，并在有需要时及时提供领事协助。本文所发表的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.summary_zh: 第一层 2027年尼日利亚民主大会党（贝努埃州南区参议员候选人丹尼尔·奥涅赫同志已告知该党总统候选人彼得·奥比先生，他预计奥比将在2027年总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州。奥涅赫是在率领贝努埃州民主大会党全国议会候选人代表团对前阿南布拉州州长进行战略访问时说出这番话的。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body: Layer 1 The 2027 Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) Benue South Senatorial Candidate, Comrade Daniel Onjeh, has told the party’s presidential candidate, Mr Peter Obi, that he expects him to win Benue State by a landslide in the 2027 presidential election. Onjeh said this when he led a delegation of Benue State NDC National Assembly candidates on a strategic visit to the former Anambra State Governor. Asked about the purpose of the visit, Onjeh said the delegation had gone to meet Obi to review what happened in the 2023 presidential election, look at the political situation in Benue and discuss what lies ahead in 2027. He described Obi’s performance in Benue State during the 2023 presidential election as impressive and outstanding, adding that he expects the former Anambra State Governor to receive even greater support in 2027. Onjeh said the delegation also discussed the state’s voting strength and the interest being shown in voter registration. He maintained that the support Obi received in 2023 reflected a desire for political change among sections of the electorate. The former President of the National Association of Nigerian Students (NANS) said the delegation also appealed to Obi to make Benue State a priority, especially after what he described as the deliberate obstruction of his previous attempts to visit the state. Onjeh questioned why a Nigerian citizen should be prevented from travelling freely within his own country, describing such interference as unacceptable. He said the candidates encouraged Obi to put those experiences behind him and assured him that the concerns previously raised to stop his visits would be adequately addressed. They also urged him to return and complete his humanitarian mission to Benue and spend sufficient time with the people during his proposed presidential campaign tour. Obi, according to Onjeh, assured the delegation that Benue remained dear to his heart and that he would return to spend ample time with the people. He said the former Anambra State Governor spoke about equity and justice, stressing that no part of Nigeria should be left out of his engagements with the people. Beyond the discussions about Benue, Onjeh said Obi had an important message for the National Assembly candidates: they must prepare, organise themselves and their supporters, and ensure that the votes cast by Nigerians are protected. He explained that Obi placed particular emphasis on the need for Nigerians not only to vote but also to ensure that their votes count. According to Onjeh, Obi linked this to the country’s future, arguing that unless Nigerians can freely choose their leaders and have those choices respected, the country will continue to struggle with poverty and the other challenges holding back its development. He said Obi also spoke about the need for Nigeria to make progress in technology and other sectors, noting that credible elections and accountable leadership were essential to moving the country forward. Onjeh, a former Chairman of the Governing Board of the Projects Development Institute (PRODA), Enugu, said the meeting also allowed the Benue candidates to discuss their preparations and exchange views with Obi on developments in the state. The former President of the West African Students’ Union (WASU) said the delegation left with a clear message about the importance of preparing early, working together and ensuring that voters are able to exercise their rights without interference. He maintained that the 2027 election would provide another opportunity for the people of Benue to make their choice through the ballot. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.title_zh: 2027年：你将以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/2027.body_zh: 第一层：2027年尼日利亚民主大会党（benue South）参议院候选人丹尼尔·翁耶赫同志已告知该党总统候选人彼得·奥比先生，他预计奥比将在2027年总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得贝努埃州。翁耶赫带领贝努埃州民主大会党国民议会候选人代表团对前阿南布拉州州长进行战略访问时说出了这番话。被问及此次访问的目的时，翁耶赫说，代表团前来会见奥比，是为了回顾2023年总统选举中发生的情况，了解贝努埃的政治局势，并讨论2027年前的前景。他形容奥比在2023年总统选举中于贝努埃州的表现令人印象深刻且十分出色，并补充说，他预计这位前阿南布拉州州长在2027年将获得更加广泛的支持。翁耶赫说，代表团还讨论了该州的投票力量以及选民登记工作受到的关注。他坚称，奥比在2023年获得的 reflects 了部分选民对政治变革的愿望。尼日利亚全国学生协会（NANS）前主席说，代表团还呼吁奥比优先关注贝努埃州，尤其是在他此前试图访问该州却遭到他所说的故意阻挠之后。翁耶赫质疑，为什么一名尼日利亚公民应被阻止在本国境内自由旅行，并称此类干涉不可接受。他说，这些候选人鼓励奥比把那些经历抛在脑后，并向他保证，先前为阻止他访问而提出的各种顾虑将得到妥善解决。他们还敦促奥比返回贝努埃州，完成其人道主义使命，并在他拟进行的总统竞选巡回活动中花足够时间与当地民众相处。据翁耶赫说，奥比向代表团保证，贝努埃州始终在他心中占据重要位置，他会回来与当地民众共度充足时光。他说，这位前阿南布拉州州长谈到公平与正义，强调在Nigeria任何地区都不应被排除在他与民众接触的范围之外。除有关贝努埃州的讨论外，翁耶赫说，奥比还向国民议会候选人传达了一项重要信息：他们必须做好准备，组织好自己和支持者，并确保尼日利亚人投下的选票得到保护。他解释说，奥比特别强调，尼日利亚人不仅要投票，还要确保自己的选票能够产生效力。据翁耶赫说，奥比把这一点与国家未来联系起来，认为除非尼日利亚人能够自由选择领导人，并让选择得到尊重，否则国家将继续在贫困以及其他阻碍发展的挑战中挣扎。他说，奥比还谈到尼日利亚需要在技术及其他领域取得进展，并指出，可信的选举和负责任的领导是推动国家前进的关键。翁耶赫曾任 Projects Development Institute（PRODA）恩古努主管委员会主席，他说，此次会面还让贝努埃州候选人得以讨论各项准备工作，并就州内局势与奥比交换意见。西非学生联盟（WASU）前主席说，代表团带着一项明确的信息离开：尽早准备、携手合作，以及确保选民能够在不受干涉的情况下行使权利的重要性。他说，2027年选举将为贝努埃州人民提供另一个通过选票作出选择的机会。本文所表达的意见不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://x.com/tgethglobaleye/status/2114.title: #BREAKING | 🇩🇿 🇳🇪 — Algeria’s parliament unanimously approved forward deployment of military forces into Niger.
https://x.com/tgethglobaleye/status/2114.snippet:
#BREAKING | 🇩🇿 🇳🇪 — Algeria’s parliament unanimously approved forward deployment of military forces into Niger. 

This expands Algeria’s presence at Air Base 101 (Niamey International Airport), established after the August 29 attempted coup. Forces will deploy to key oil infrastructure and Madama Air Base (21.9554711, 13.6470986) in the northeast.

Algeria has softened its stance toward Mali and Burkina Faso while backing the Niamey junta, recently supplying military helicopters. This shift counters the growing influence of Saddam Haftar and eastern Libyan factions, whom Niamey accuses of supporting Tuareg separatists and the anti-junta Patriotic Liberation Front (FPL). Some junta members blame the FPL for the August 29 attacks.

The deployment positions Algerian forces near FPL operational areas and the Libyan border, specifically Fezzan, which is controlled by remnants of Haftar’s 128th Brigade.

https://x.com/tgethglobaleye/status/2114.snippet_zh:
#突发 | 🇩🇿 🇳🇪 — 阿尔及利亚议会一致批准向尼日尔部署军事力量。

这将扩大阿尔及利亚在第101航空基地（尼亚美国际机场）的驻军。该基地是在8月29日未遂政变后建立的。部队将部署到关键石油设施以及东北部的马达马空军基地（21.9554711, 13.6470986）。

阿尔及利亚在支持尼亚美军政府的同时 softening 了对马里和布基纳法索的立场，最近还向其供应了军用直升机。这一转变抵消了萨-dam·哈夫塔尔及利比亚东部派系日益增强的影响力。尼亚美指控这些势力支持图阿雷格分离分子和反军政府的爱国解放阵线党（FPL）。一些军政府成员将8月29日发生的袭击归咎于FPL。

此次部署使阿尔及利亚军队靠近FPL的作战区域和利比亚边境，尤其是费赞地区。该地区由哈夫塔尔第128旅残余力量控制。

https://x.com/muhdbarma/status/211427623.snippet:
Dambazau, Business Leaders Put Payments, Export Finance, Investment At Centre of CBN Roundtable. 

Nigeria’s Ambassador to China, Lt Gen Abdulrahman Bello Dambazau (rtd), has outlined practical financial priorities for deeper bilateral ties, including reliable cross-border payments, export finance and long-term investment.

Speaking at the Central Bank of Nigeria’s ‘Strengthening the Nigeria–China Financial Corridor’ roundtable in Beijing, Dambazau said financial cooperation should deliver measurable benefits for businesses and citizens in both countries.
“For businesses, financial cooperation has a practical meaning. It means paying a supplier reliably, receiving export earnings promptly, securing affordable working capital, and obtaining long-term finance for a viable investment,” he said.

“Our task is to make these transactions easier, more transparent and more accessible.”
The Ambassador’s contribution opened a discussion in which Nigerian and Chinese businesses connected the financial corridor’s wider ambitions with their experience of settlement, investment and access to financial services.

Dambazau emphasised the importance of clear information on payment channels, transaction costs and settlement times. Stronger commercial-bank relationships, supported by effective engagement between regulators, could help resolve operational difficulties and reduce uncertainty, he said.

“Payment delay can become a shipment delay, a production interruption or a lost business opportunity,” he said.

On local-currency settlement, he said the bilateral swap framework’s value to businesses depended on access, adequate liquidity, competitive pricing and a clear understanding of how the arrangements worked. Settlement in local currencies should remain a commercial choice supported by transparent terms and sound risk management.

He also called for financial cooperation that supported Nigerian production and exports.

“Export finance, letters of credit, credit insurance, and working capital facilities can help businesses turn market opportunities into completed transactions,” he said.

Dambazau advocated stronger financial flows in both directions, connecting finance with the practical requirements of supplying the Chinese market. 

He also highlighted patient capital for productive investment and safeguards that protected legitimate commerce while allowing smaller businesses to participate.

The embassy, he said, stood ready to facilitate connections and bring commercial concerns to the appropriate institutions.

CIG Motors Chairman Diana Chen reinforced the importance of predictability from the perspective of a Chinese business with an established operating presence in Nigeria.

She described the company’s factories and employment of Nigerian engineers, technicians and managers as evidence of a relationship extending beyond imports into production and skills development.

“What we ask for today is not grand architecture. It is continuity, predictability, and the right confidence that when we commit capital, we will one day be able to bring our returns home in good order,” she said.

Chen said the financial system should keep pace with Chinese businesses’ evolution in Nigeria, including their need for patient capital alongside short-term trade finance.

Nigerian businessman, Festus Mbisiogu, welcomed the opportunity for operators in China to explain payment difficulties directly to the CBN leadership. 

He described uncertainty over settlement routes, suppliers requesting RMB payments and transactions delayed within banking channels.

Flutterwave CEO, Olugbenga Agboola, credited improvements in Nigeria’s compliance infrastructure and international credibility with strengthening the environment in which Nigerian financial businesses engaged foreign counterparts. 

He commended CBN Governor Olayemi Cardoso and his team for implementing their policy direction.

赞巴扎乌：商界领袖将支付、出口融资和投资置于尼日利亚中央银行圆桌会议核心

尼日利亚驻华大使阿卜杜拉曼·贝洛·赞巴扎乌退役上将提出了深化双边关系的务实金融优先事项，包括可靠的跨境支付、出口融资和长期投资。

在北京举行的尼日利亚中央银行“加强尼日利亚—中国金融走廊”圆桌会议上，赞巴扎乌表示，金融合作应为两国企业和公民带来可衡量的益处。

他说：“对企业而言，金融合作具有实实在在的意义。这意味着能够可靠地支付供应商款项、及时收到出口收益、获得成本较低营运资金，并为可行投资取得长期融资。”

他说：“我们的任务是让这些交易更加便捷、透明和便利。”

大使的发言开启了相关讨论。尼日利亚和中国企业将金融走廊的更广泛愿景与各自在结算、投资和获取金融服务方面的经验相结合。

赞巴扎乌强调，支付渠道、交易成本和结算时间的信息清晰至关重要。加强商业银行关系，并由监管机构开展有效协作，有助于解决操作难题并减少不确定性，他说。

他说：“付款延误可能造成发货延误、生产中断或错失商业机会。”

谈及本币结算，他说，双边互换框架对企业的价值取决于资金渠道的可及性、充足流动性、有竞争力的价格，以及对这些安排运作方式的清晰理解。本币结算应继续作为一项商业选择，并得到透明条款和稳健风险管理的支持。

他还呼吁推动支持尼日利亚生产和出口的金融合作。

他说：“出口融资、信用证、信用保险和营运资金安排，可以帮助企业将市场机会转化为完成的交易。”

赞巴扎乌主张加强双向资金流动，使融资与向中国市场供货的实际需求相衔接。

他还强调，需要为生产性投资提供耐心资本，并建立保障措施，在保护合法商业的同时，让中小企业也能参与其中。

他说，大使馆随时准备促进各方联系，并将商业诉求提交给适当的机构。

CIG Motors董事长戴安娜·陈从一家在尼日利亚已有成熟经营业务的中国企业的角度，进一步强调了可预测性的重要性。

她表示，公司在尼日利亚设有工厂并雇用尼日利亚工程师、技术人员和管理人员，这表明双方关系已超越单纯进口，延伸至生产和技能培养。

她说：“我们今天所要求的并非宏大的架构，而是延续性、可预测性，以及充分的信心，确保当我们投入资本时，最终能够顺利将收益带回国内。”

陈表示，金融体系应跟上中国企业在尼日利亚不断发展的步伐，包括满足其对耐心资本和短期贸易融资的需求。

尼日利亚商人费斯图斯·姆比西奥古对在华经营者能够直接向尼日利亚中央银行领导层说明支付难题表示欢迎。

他提到，结算路径存在不确定性，供应商要求使用人民币付款，银行渠道内的交易也出现延误。

Flutterwave首席执行官奥卢格本加·阿格博拉表示，尼日利亚合规基础设施的改善和国际信誉的提升，为尼日利亚金融企业与外国交易对手开展业务营造了更有利的环境。

他赞扬尼日利亚中央银行行长奥拉耶米·卡多索及其团队落实政策部署。

"Mali insurgents consist primarily of two coordinated factions: the Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), an Al-Qaeda-linked group seeking to impose strict Islamic rule, and the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), a Tuareg-led separatist movement fighting for independence in northern Mali. These groups have significantly escalated violence in 2026, capturing key strategic locations including Kidal, Anefis, and parts of Gao after a major joint offensive in April that killed Mali’s defense minister.

Recent developments include a July 4, 2026, coordinated attack on at least five locations, including a prison in Kenieroba near the capital, and ongoing clashes in the north where rebels have captured dozens of Malian soldiers. In October 2026, a separate faction, the Islamic State in the Sahel Province (ISSP), killed at least 48 civilians in Ménaka in retaliation for abuses by pro-government militias and Russia’s Africa Corps. Human Rights Watch has reported that both insurgent groups and the Malian military, alongside its Russian allies, are committing grave violations, including the execution of surrendered soldiers and indiscriminate drone strikes against civilians."

____

马里叛乱分子主要由两个协调派系组成：支持伊斯兰与穆斯林组织（JNIM），这是一个与基地组织有关联的团体，寻求强加严格的伊斯兰统治；以及阿扎瓦德解放阵线（FLA），这是一个由图阿雷格人领导的分离主义运动，为马里北部的独立而战。这些团体在2026年大幅升级了暴力行动，在4月发动大规模联合进攻后，占领了包括基达尔、阿内菲斯和高的一部分等关键战略地点，那次进攻导致马里国防部长死亡。

最近的事态发展包括2026年7月4日对至少五个地点发动的协同攻击，其中包括首都附近的凯涅罗巴监狱，以及北部持续的冲突，叛乱分子在那里俘获了数十名马里士兵。2026年10月，另一个派系，即萨赫勒省伊斯兰国（ISSP），在梅纳卡杀害了至少48名平民，以报复亲政府民兵和俄罗斯非洲军团的暴行。人权观察组织报告称，叛乱团体和马里军队及其俄罗斯盟友都在犯下严重侵犯行为，包括处决投降士兵和对平民进行不分青红皂白的无人机袭击。

https://x.com/dcnr4g/status/211393569756.title: NIGERIA CUSTOMS, TMPL TEST CUTTING-EDGE CARGO SCANNERS IN CHINA AHEAD OF DEPLOYMENT The Nigeria Customs Service and Trade Modernisation Proj
https://x.com/dcnr4g/status/211393569756.snippet:
NIGERIA CUSTOMS, TMPL TEST CUTTING-EDGE CARGO SCANNERS IN CHINA AHEAD OF DEPLOYMENT

The Nigeria Customs Service and Trade Modernisation Project Limited have completed factory acceptance tests for newly acquired non-intrusive inspection equipment and an electronic cargo tracking system in China.

The two-week exercise, led by Deputy Comptroller-General Oluyomi Adebakin, took place at the facility of Nuctech Company Limited.

The team conducted technical verification of the high-tech scanners and tracking system designed to enhance cargo examination and enable real-time monitoring from ports to destinations.

Deputy Comptroller-General Adebakin reaffirmed the commitment of Comptroller-General Adewale Adeniyi to leveraging technology for trade facilitation, revenue optimisation and national security.

She described the tests as a crucial quality assurance process to ensure the systems meet global operational standards before shipment to Nigeria.

She added that deploying the scanners would reduce physical examinations, curb cargo diversion, minimise human contact and improve operational efficiency across Customs formations.

https://x.com/dcnr4g/status/211393569756.title_zh: 尼日利亚海关与贸易现代化项目在中国测试尖端货物扫描仪以备部署 尼日利亚海关总署和贸易现代化项目
https://x.com/dcnr4g/status/211393569756.snippet_zh:
尼日利亚海关与Trade Modernisation Project Limited在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试

尼日利亚海关与贸易现代化项目有限公司已在中国对最新采购的非侵入式检查设备及电子货物追踪系统完成工厂验收测试。

为期两周的测试由副税务总监Oluyomi Adebakin牵头，在Nuctech Company Limited的设施内进行。

测试团队对高科技扫描设备和追踪系统进行了技术验证。这些设备和系统旨在加强货物查验，并实现从港口至目的地之间的实时监控。

副税务总监Adebakin重申，税务总监Adewale Adeniyi致力于利用技术促进贸易、优化税收收入并维护国家安全。

她表示，此次测试是一项关键的质量保证流程，旨在确保相关系统符合全球运营标准，然后才能运往尼日利亚。

她补充说，部署这些扫描设备将减少人工开箱查验、遏制货物转移、尽量减少人员接触，并提高海关各机构的运营效率。

https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.title: CHINA DEMANDS A MASSIVE PRICE FROM PUTIN FOR HELPING END THE WAR IN UKRAINE — BEIJING WANTS ALMOST UNLIMITED ACCESS TO RUSSIA’S NATURAL RESO
https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.snippet:
CHINA DEMANDS A MASSIVE PRICE FROM PUTIN FOR HELPING END THE WAR IN UKRAINE — BEIJING WANTS ALMOST UNLIMITED ACCESS TO RUSSIA’S NATURAL RESOURCES IN EXCHANGE FOR GUARANTEES OF A PEACE DEAL WITH TRUMP.

According to alleged Kremlin insiders, Xi Jinping is prepared to become the main international guarantor of a future peace agreement on Ukraine. However, Chinese leaders have reportedly presented Moscow with a series of economic demands.

Beijing wants to turn its participation in the peace negotiations into long-term advantages for Chinese businesses. The Kremlin is reportedly discussing just how many concessions it will have to make to secure Xi’s support in negotiations with Trump.

China is primarily interested in deposits of rare-earth metals, copper, gold, and other natural resources in Siberia and the Russian Far East.

Beijing is reportedly demanding priority access for Chinese companies to major extraction projects, long-term contracts for raw materials at preferential prices, and special privileges for Chinese investors. Expanding Chinese involvement in Russia’s forestry and energy industries is also reportedly under discussion.

China wants these agreements finalized before any official announcement ending Russia’s war against Ukraine.

Beijing fears that once American sanctions are potentially lifted, Russia could resume extensive cooperation with Western companies, threatening the privileged position Chinese investors have gained in recent years.

Xi therefore wants binding guarantees that would remain in force regardless of any future rapprochement between Moscow and Washington.

For Putin, this creates a serious dilemma.

On one hand, China's participation could significantly increase the chances of reaching an agreement with Trump to end the fighting and gradually lift sanctions.

On the other hand, accepting Beijing’s demands could mean that a substantial share of Russia’s future natural-resource revenues would effectively be tied to Chinese interests for decades.

In other words, Putin may have to mortgage Russia’s natural wealth to China in exchange for a way out of the war he started.

https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.title_zh: 中国要求普京为帮助结束乌克兰战争付出高昂代价——北京希望几乎不受限制地获取俄罗斯天然气资源
https://x.com/olenarohoza/status/2113920.snippet_zh:
中国就普京协助结束乌克兰战争提出巨额代价——北京希望以几乎不受限制地获取俄罗斯自然资源为交换，换取与特朗普达成和平协议的保证。

据所谓克里姆林宫内部人士透露，习近平准备成为未来乌克兰和平协议的主要国际担保人。不过，据报道，中国领导层向莫斯科提出了一系列经济要求。

北京希望把参与和平谈判转化为中国企业的长期优势。据报道，克里姆林宫正在讨论，为确保习近平支持与特朗普谈判，必须作出多少让步。

中国主要看重西伯利亚和俄罗斯远东地区蕴藏的稀土、铜、黄金及其他自然资源。

据报道，北京要求中国企业优先参与大型开采项目，签订以优惠价格供应原材料的长期合同，并给予中国投资者特殊特权。据报道，扩大中国对俄罗斯林业和能源行业的参与也在讨论之中。

中国希望在任何正式宣布结束俄罗斯对乌克兰战争之前敲定这些协议。

北京担心，一旦美国有可能解除制裁，俄罗斯就可能恢复与西方企业的广泛合作，从而威胁近年来中国投资者所取得的优势地位。

因此，习近平希望获得具有约束力的保证，无论未来莫斯科与华盛顿关系如何改善，这些保证都继续有效。

对普京而言，这造成了一个严峻的难题。

一方面，中国参与谈判可能显著增加与特朗普达成协议、结束战斗并逐步解除制裁的可能性。

另一方面，接受北京的要求，可能意味着俄罗斯未来相当大一部分自然资源收入将在未来数十年里实际上与中国利益绑定。

换言之，普京可能不得不把俄罗斯的自然财富抵押给中国，以换取摆脱他亲手发动的战争的一条出路。

https://x.com/ehimenpaul/status/21137638.title: How Can Armed Groups Move So Freely While Communities Remain Under Threat?
https://x.com/ehimenpaul/status/21137638.snippet:
How Can Armed Groups Move So Freely While Communities Remain Under Threat?

Reports that heavily armed men arrived in convoys at a wedding ceremony in Zamfara State, allegedly linked to a wanted bandit kingpin, have once again raised serious questions about Nigeria’s security system.

Eyewitnesses reportedly said some of the men wore military-style uniforms, while others carried sophisticated weapons. The incident has reignited public concerns over how armed groups continue to operate openly in communities already struggling with insecurity.

Where is the government’s security strategy, and why do residents continue to live in fear? Nigerians deserve answers, not just repeated assurances. When heavily armed groups can reportedly move in convoys without fear, citizens are justified in demanding stronger intelligence, effective security operations, and accountability from those entrusted with protecting lives and property.

For the people of Zamfara, security is not a political slogan. It is the difference between living in peace and going to bed wondering what tomorrow may bring.

How much longer must ordinary Nigerians wait for the safety they deserve?💯😔😈🇳🇬📌

https://x.com/ehimenpaul/status/21137638.snippet_zh:
武装团体为何能如此肆无忌惮地行动，而 communities仍处于威胁之下？

据报道，大批武装人员乘车队抵达扎姆法拉州的一场婚礼，据称他们与一名被通缉的土匪头目有关，这再次引发了对尼日利亚安全体系的严重质疑。

目击者称，其中一些人员身穿军装样式制服，另一些人则携带先进武器。这一事件再次激起了公众的担忧：在已经饱受不安全局势困扰的社区，武装团体为何仍能公开活动？

政府的安全战略在哪里？居民为何仍要继续生活在恐惧之中？尼日利亚人民理应得到答案，而不应只有反复的保证。当据称重武装团体能够毫无顾忌地乘车队行动时，公民完全有理由要求更强大的情报能力、有效的安全行动，以及追究那些受托保护生命和财产安全者的责任。

对扎姆法拉州人民而言，安全不是政治口号，而是安宁生活与每晚入睡时不知明天会发生什么之间的区别。

普通尼日利亚人民还要等待多久，才能获得他们应得的安全？💯😔😈🇳🇬📌

目击者称，其中一些人员身穿军装样式制服，另一些人则携带先进武器。这一事件再次激起了公众的担忧：在已经饱受不安全局势困扰的社区，武装团体为何仍能公开活动？

政府的安全战略在哪里？居民为何仍要继续生活在恐惧之中？尼日利亚人民理应得到答案，而不应只有反复的保证。当据称重武装团体能够毫无顾忌地乘车队行动时，公民完全有理由要求更强大的情报能力、有效的安全行动，以及追究那些受托保护生命和财产安全者的责任。

对扎姆法拉州人民而言，安全不是政治口号，而是安宁生活与每晚入睡时不知明天会发生什么之间的区别。

普通尼日利亚人民还要等待多久，才能获得他们应得的安全？💯😔😈🇳🇬📌
